def IsGood (x A : ℝ) : Prop :=
  sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = A ∧ 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 ∧

            rw [h₉, h₁₀]
            <;> norm_num
          have h₁₁ : Real.sqrt ((3 / 2 : ℝ) + Real.sqrt 2) + Real.sqrt ((3 / 2 : ℝ) - Real.sqrt 2) ≥ 0 := by positivity

theorem usa1974_p2 :
    ∀ (a b c : ℝ), a > 0 → b > 0 → c > 0 → a^a * b^b * c^c ≥ (a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3) := by 
  intro a b c ha hb hc
  have h_main : Real.log (a^a * b^b * c^c) ≥ Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) := by
    have h₁ : Real.log (a^a * b^b * c^c) = a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c := by
      have h₁₁ : Real.log (a^a * b^b * c^c) = Real.log (a^a) + Real.log (b^b) + Real.log (c^c) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      rw [h₁₁]
      have h₁₂ : Real.log (a^a) = a * Real.log a := by
        rw [Real.log_rpow ha]
      have h₁₃ : Real.log (b^b) = b * Real.log b := by
        rw [Real.log_rpow hb]
      have h₁₄ : Real.log (c^c) = c * Real.log c := by
        rw [Real.log_rpow hc]
      rw [h₁₂, h₁₃, h₁₄]
      <;> ring
    have h₂ : Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) = ((a+b+c)/3) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by
      have h₂₁ : Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) = ((a+b+c)/3) * Real.log (a*b*c) := by
        rw [Real.log_rpow (by positivity)]
      rw [h₂₁]
      have h₂₂ : Real.log (a*b*c) = Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c := by
        have h₂₂₁ : Real.log (a*b*c) = Real.log (a*b) + Real.log c := by
          rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        rw [h₂₂₁]
        have h₂₂₂ : Real.log (a*b) = Real.log a + Real.log b := by
          rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        rw [h₂₂₂]
        <;> ring
      rw [h₂₂]
      <;> ring
    rw [h₁, h₂]
    have h₃ : (a - b) * (Real.log a - Real.log b) ≥ 0 := by
      by_cases h : a ≥ b
      · have h₄ : Real.log a ≥ Real.log b := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h
        have h₅ : a - b ≥ 0 := by linarith
        have h₆ : Real.log a - Real.log b ≥ 0 := by linarith
        nlinarith
      · have h₄ : b ≥ a := by linarith
        have h₅ : Real.log b ≥ Real.log a := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h₄
        have h₆ : a - b ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have h₇ : Real.log a - Real.log b ≤ 0 := by linarith
        nlinarith
    have h₄ : (a - c) * (Real.log a - Real.log c) ≥ 0 := by
      by_cases h : a ≥ c
      · have h₄ : Real.log a ≥ Real.log c := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h
        have h₅ : a - c ≥ 0 := by linarith
        have h₆ : Real.log a - Real.log c ≥ 0 := by linarith
        nlinarith
      · have h₄ : c ≥ a := by linarith
        have h₅ : Real.log c ≥ Real.log a := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h₄
        have h₆ : a - c ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have h₇ : Real.log a - Real.log c ≤ 0 := by linarith
        nlinarith
    have h₅ : (b - c) * (Real.log b - Real.log c) ≥ 0 := by
      by_cases h : b ≥ c
      · have h₄ : Real.log b ≥ Real.log c := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h
        have h₅ : b - c ≥ 0 := by linarith
        have h₆ : Real.log b - Real.log c ≥ 0 := by linarith
        nlinarith
      · have h₄ : c ≥ b := by linarith
        have h₅ : Real.log c ≥ Real.log b := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h₄
        have h₆ : b - c ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have h₇ : Real.log b - Real.log c ≤ 0 := by linarith
        nlinarith
    have h₆ : (a - b) * (Real.log a - Real.log b) + (a - c) * (Real.log a - Real.log c) + (b - c) * (Real.log b - Real.log c) ≥ 0 := by
      linarith
    have h₇ : 3 * (a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c) - (a + b + c) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) ≥ 0 := by
      have h₇₁ : (a - b) * (Real.log a - Real.log b) + (a - c) * (Real.log a - Real.log c) + (b - c) * (Real.log b - Real.log c) = 3 * (a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c) - (a + b + c) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by
        ring_nf
        <;>
        (try
          {
            linarith [Real.log_mul ha hb, Real.log_mul ha hc, Real.log_mul hb hc]

        <;>

          {
            field_simp [Real.log_mul ha hb, Real.log_mul ha hc, Real.log_mul hb hc]
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> linarith
          })
        <;>
        (try
          {
            nlinarith [Real.log_mul ha hb, Real.log_mul ha hc, Real.log_mul hb hc]
          })
      linarith
    have h₈ : 3 * (a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c) ≥ (a + b + c) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by
      linarith
    have h₉ : a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c ≥ ((a + b + c) / 3) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by

    linarith
  
  have h_final : a^a * b^b * c^c ≥ (a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3) := by

    exact h₅

theorem usa1978_p1 :

    have h₁ : ∃ (a b c d : ℝ), IsGood a b c d max_e := by

        <;> norm_num
      · 
        norm_num [IsGood, max_e]
        <;> ring_nf at *
        <;> norm_num
    
    simpa [h_max_e_def] using h₁
  
  have h_ub : ∀ (e : ℝ), e ∈ { e : ℝ | ∃ a b c d : ℝ, IsGood a b c d e } → e ≤ max_e := by
    intro e he
    rcases he with ⟨a, b, c, d, h₁, h₂⟩
    have h₃ : a + b + c + d + e = 8 := h₁
    have h₄ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + d ^ 2 + e ^ 2 = 16 := h₂
    have h₅ : (a + b + c + d) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + d ^ 2) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (a - c), sq_nonneg (a - d), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (b - d), sq_nonneg (c - d)]
    have h₆ : (8 - e) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (16 - e ^ 2) := by
      have h₆₁ : a + b + c + d = 8 - e := by linarith
      have h₆₂ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + d ^ 2 = 16 - e ^ 2 := by
        have h₆₃ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + d ^ 2 + e ^ 2 = 16 := h₄
        linarith
      have h₆₃ : (a + b + c + d) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + d ^ 2) := h₅
      calc
        (8 - e) ^ 2 = (a + b + c + d) ^ 2 := by
          rw [h₆₁]
          <;> ring_nf
        _ ≤ 4 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + d ^ 2) := h₆₃
        _ = 4 * (16 - e ^ 2) := by
          rw [h₆₂]
          <;> ring_nf
    have h₇ : 5 * e ^ 2 - 16 * e ≤ 0 := by
      nlinarith
    have h₈ : e ≤ (16 : ℝ) / 5 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (e - 16 / 5)]
    have h₉ : e ≤ max_e := by
      rw [h_max_e_def]
      exact h₈
    exact h₉

    refine' ⟨h_mem, _⟩
    intro e he
    have h₁ : e ≤ max_e := h_ub e he

  exact h_main

theorem imo1959_p1 : ∀ n : ℕ, Nat.Coprime (21 * n + 4) (14 * n + 3) := by 
  intro n
  have h_main : Nat.gcd (21 * n + 4) (14 * n + 3) = 1 := by
    have h₁ : Nat.gcd (21 * n + 4) (14 * n + 3) = Nat.gcd (14 * n + 3) (7 * n + 1) := by
      have h₂ : 21 * n + 4 = 1 * (14 * n + 3) + (7 * n + 1) := by
        ring_nf
        <;> omega
      rw [h₂]
      <;> simp [Nat.gcd_comm, Nat.gcd_assoc, Nat.gcd_add_mul_right_right]
      <;>
      (try omega) <;>
      (try ring_nf at *) <;>
      (try simp_all [Nat.gcd_comm, Nat.gcd_assoc, Nat.gcd_add_mul_right_right])
      <;>
      (try omega)
    rw [h₁]
    have h₃ : Nat.gcd (14 * n + 3) (7 * n + 1) = Nat.gcd (7 * n + 1) 1 := by
      have h₄ : 14 * n + 3 = 2 * (7 * n + 1) + 1 := by
        ring_nf
        <;> omega
      rw [h₄]
      <;> simp [Nat.gcd_comm, Nat.gcd_assoc, Nat.gcd_add_mul_right_right]
      <;>
      (try omega) <;>
      (try ring_nf at *) <;>
      (try simp_all [Nat.gcd_comm, Nat.gcd_assoc, Nat.gcd_add_mul_right_right])
      <;>
      (try omega)
    rw [h₃]
    <;> simp [Nat.gcd_one_right]
  
  have h_final : Nat.Coprime (21 * n + 4) (14 * n + 3) := by

theorem imo_1964_p1a (n : ℕ) : n ∈ solution_set ↔ 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by

      intro n
      rw [← Nat.mod_add_div n 3]
      simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod]
      <;> simp [pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod]
      <;> norm_num
      <;> ring_nf at *
      <;> simp [Nat.pow_mod]
      <;> norm_num
      <;> omega
    have h₂ : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ^ n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] ↔ 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      intro n
      simp [Nat.ModEq]
    have h₃ : ∀ n : ℕ, n % 3 = 0 → 2 ^ n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
      intro n hn
      have h₄ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
        have h₅ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := h₁ n
        rw [h₅]
        have h₆ : n % 3 = 0 := hn
        rw [h₆]
        norm_num
      have h₇ : 2 ^ n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
        rw [h₂]
        <;> omega
      exact h₇
    have h₄ : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ^ n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] → n % 3 = 0 := by
      intro n hn
      have h₅ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
        rw [h₂] at hn
        exact hn
      have h₆ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := h₁ n
      rw [h₆] at h₅
      have h₇ : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
      rcases h₇ with (h₇ | h₇ | h₇) <;> simp [h₇, pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod] at h₅ <;>
        (try omega) <;> (try {
          norm_num at h₅
          <;> omega
        })
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact h₃ n h
    · intro h
      exact h₄ n h
  
  have h_final : n ∈ solution_set ↔ 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
    simp only [solution_set, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at *
    exact h_main
  
  exact h_final

theorem imo_1964_p1b (n : ℕ) : ¬ 7 ∣ (2^n + 1) := by 
  have h_main : ∀ n : ℕ, (2^n + 1) % 7 ≠ 0 := by
    intro n

      have h₁ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by
        
        have h₂ : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by

          simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod]
          <;>
          (try decide) <;>

            have : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega

        omega

      (try simp [h₁, h, pow_succ, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod]) <;>
      (try omega) <;>

        norm_num at h ⊢

        omega

    intro h_contra

    have h₄₄ : 1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) + (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) / 4 ≥ 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c := by
      calc
        1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) + (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) / 4 =
            (1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) + a * (b + c) / 4) + (1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) + b * (c + a) / 4) + (1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) + c * (a + b) / 4) := by
          ring
        _ ≥ 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c := by
          linarith
    exact h₄₄
  
  have h₅ : a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b) = 2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a) := by
    have h₅₁ : a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b) = 2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a) := by
      ring_nf
      <;>
      nlinarith [mul_pos ha hb, mul_pos hb hc, mul_pos hc ha]
    linarith
  
  have h₆ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) + (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 ≥ 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c := by
    have h₆₁ : 1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) + (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) / 4 ≥ 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c := h₄
    have h₆₂ : a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b) = 2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a) := h₅
    have h₆₃ : 1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) + (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 ≥ 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c := by
      calc
        1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) + (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 =
            1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) + (2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a)) / 4 := by
          ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> nlinarith [mul_pos ha hb, mul_pos hb hc, mul_pos hc ha]
        _ = 1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) + (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) / 4 := by
          rw [h₆₂]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> nlinarith [mul_pos ha hb, mul_pos hb hc, mul_pos hc ha]
        _ ≥ 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c := by
          linarith
    exact h₆₃
  
  have h₇ : 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c = a * b + b * c + c * a := by
    have h₇₁ : a * b > 0 := by positivity
    have h₇₂ : b * c > 0 := by positivity
    have h₇₃ : c * a > 0 := by positivity
    have h₇₄ : a * b * c = 1 := habc
    have h₇₅ : 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c = a * b + b * c + c * a := by
      have h₇₆ : 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c = (b * c + a * c + a * b) := by
        have h₇₇ : 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c = (b * c + a * c + a * b) / (a * b * c) := by
          field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
        rw [h₇₇]
        have h₇₈ : a * b * c = 1 := habc
        rw [h₇₈]
        <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
        <;> ring_nf
      have h₇₉ : (b * c + a * c + a * b) = a * b + b * c + c * a := by ring
      linarith
    linarith
  
  have h₈ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) ≥ (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 := by
    have h₈₁ : 1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) + (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 ≥ 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c := h₆
    have h₈₂ : 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c = a * b + b * c + c * a := h₇

    have h₉₁ : 0 < a * b := by positivity

    have h₁₀₁ : a * b + b * c + c * a ≥ 3 := h₉
    linarith
  
  have h₁₁ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) ≥ 3 / 2 := by
    have h₁₁₁ : 1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) ≥ (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 := h₈
    have h₁₁₂ : (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 ≥ 3 / 2 := h₁₀
    linarith
  
  linarith

theorem imo1969_p2
    (x₁ x₂ : ℝ)
    (n : ℕ)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (h₁ : ∀ x, f x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x)) / (2^i))
    (h₂ : f x₂ = 0)
    (h₃ : f x₁ = 0)
    (h₄: ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 ^ i)) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by 
  have h_C_def : (∑ i in Finset.range n, Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using h₄
  
  set C : ℝ := ∑ i in Finset.range n, Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i with hC_def
  set S : ℝ := ∑ i in Finset.range n, Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i with hS_def
  
  have h_f_formula : ∀ (x : ℝ), f x = C * Real.cos x - S * Real.sin x := by
    intro x
    rw [h₁]
    have h₅ : ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i = ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      have h₅₁ : Real.cos (a i + x) = Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x := by
        rw [Real.cos_add]
      rw [h₅₁]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp
      <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₅]
    have h₆ : ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i = (∑ i in Finset.range n, Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.cos x - (∑ i in Finset.range n, Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.sin x := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ i in Finset.range n, ((Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i - (Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring_nf
          <;> field_simp
          <;> ring_nf
        _ = ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.sin x) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring_nf
          <;> field_simp
          <;> ring_nf
        _ = (∑ i in Finset.range n, Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.cos x) - ∑ i in Finset.range n, Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.sin x := by
          rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        _ = (∑ i in Finset.range n, Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.cos x - (∑ i in Finset.range n, Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.sin x := by
          have h₆₁ : ∑ i in Finset.range n, Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.cos x = (∑ i in Finset.range n, Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.cos x := by
            simp [Finset.sum_mul]
          have h₆₂ : ∑ i in Finset.range n, Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.sin x = (∑ i in Finset.range n, Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.sin x := by
            simp [Finset.sum_mul]
          rw [h₆₁, h₆₂]
          <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₆]
    <;> simp only [C, S]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> field_simp
    <;> ring_nf
  
  have h_eq1 : C * Real.cos x₁ = S * Real.sin x₁ := by
    have h₅ : f x₁ = 0 := h₃
    have h₆ : f x₁ = C * Real.cos x₁ - S * Real.sin x₁ := by
      rw [h_f_formula]
    rw [h₆] at h₅
    have h₇ : C * Real.cos x₁ - S * Real.sin x₁ = 0 := by linarith
    linarith
  
  have h_eq2 : C * Real.cos x₂ = S * Real.sin x₂ := by
    have h₅ : f x₂ = 0 := h₂
    have h₆ : f x₂ = C * Real.cos x₂ - S * Real.sin x₂ := by
      rw [h_f_formula]
    rw [h₆] at h₅
    have h₇ : C * Real.cos x₂ - S * Real.sin x₂ = 0 := by linarith
    linarith
  
  have h_sin_eq : C * Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
    have h₅ : C * Real.cos x₁ = S * Real.sin x₁ := h_eq1
    have h₆ : C * Real.cos x₂ = S * Real.sin x₂ := h_eq2
    have h₇ : C * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) = 0 := by
      calc
        C * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) = C * Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - C * Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁ := by ring
        _ = S * Real.sin x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - S * Real.sin x₂ * Real.sin x₁ := by
          have h₇₁ : C * Real.cos x₁ = S * Real.sin x₁ := h_eq1
          have h₇₂ : C * Real.cos x₂ = S * Real.sin x₂ := h_eq2
          calc
            C * Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - C * Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁ = (S * Real.sin x₁) * Real.sin x₂ - (S * Real.sin x₂) * Real.sin x₁ := by
              rw [h₇₁, h₇₂]
              <;> ring
            _ = S * Real.sin x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - S * Real.sin x₂ * Real.sin x₁ := by ring
        _ = 0 := by ring
    have h₈ : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = Real.sin x₂ * Real.cos x₁ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁ := by
      rw [Real.sin_sub]
      <;> ring
    have h₉ : C * Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = C * (Real.sin x₂ * Real.cos x₁ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) := by
      rw [h₈]
      <;> ring
    have h₁₀ : C * (Real.sin x₂ * Real.cos x₁ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) = C * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) := by
      ring_nf
    have h₁₁ : C * Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = C * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) := by
      linarith
    have h₁₂ : C * Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
      linarith
    exact h₁₂
  
  have h_sin_zero : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
    have h₅ : C * Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := h_sin_eq
    have h₆ : C ≠ 0 := by
      simpa [hC_def] using h_C_def
    have h₇ : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ h₆
      linarith
    exact h₇
  
  have h_main : ∃ (m : ℤ), x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by
    have h₅ : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := h_sin_zero
    have h₆ : ∃ (m : ℤ), x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by
      
      have h₇ : ∃ (m : ℤ), x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by
        
        rw [Real.sin_eq_zero_iff] at h₅
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h₅
        use m
        <;> linarith
      exact h₇
    exact h₆
  
  exact h_main

abbrev solution_set : Set ℕ := { n | n % 3 = 0 }

theorem imo_1964_p1a (n : ℕ) : n ∈ solution_set ↔ 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by 
  have h_main : n % 3 = 0 ↔ 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      have h₁ : n % 3 = 0 := h
      have h₂ : ∃ k, n = 3 * k := by
        use n / 3
        have h₃ : n % 3 = 0 := h₁
        have h₄ : n = 3 * (n / 3) := by
          have h₅ := Nat.div_add_mod n 3
          omega
        exact h₄
      rcases h₂ with ⟨k, rfl⟩
      have h₃ : (2 : ℕ) ^ (3 * k) % 7 = 1 := by
        induction k with
        | zero => norm_num
        | succ k ih =>
          simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, ih]
          <;> norm_num <;> omega
      have h₄ : (2 : ℕ) ^ (3 * k) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
        rw [Nat.ModEq]
        exact h₃
      exact h₄
    · 
      intro h
      have h₁ : 2 ^ n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := h
      have h₂ : n % 3 = 0 := by
        have h₃ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
          rw [Nat.ModEq] at h₁
          exact h₁
        have h₄ : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
        rcases h₄ with (h₄ | h₄ | h₄)
        · 
          exact h₄
        · 
          have h₅ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 := by
            have h₅₁ : n % 3 = 1 := h₄
            have h₅₂ : ∃ k, n = 3 * k + 1 := by
              use n / 3
              have h₅₃ := Nat.div_add_mod n 3
              omega
            rcases h₅₂ with ⟨k, rfl⟩
            have h₅₃ : (2 : ℕ) ^ (3 * k + 1) % 7 = 2 := by
              induction k with
              | zero => norm_num
              | succ k ih =>
                simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, ih]
                <;> norm_num <;> omega
            exact h₅₃
          omega
        · 
          have h₅ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 4 := by
            have h₅₁ : n % 3 = 2 := h₄
            have h₅₂ : ∃ k, n = 3 * k + 2 := by
              use n / 3
              have h₅₃ := Nat.div_add_mod n 3
              omega
            rcases h₅₂ with ⟨k, rfl⟩
            have h₅₃ : (2 : ℕ) ^ (3 * k + 2) % 7 = 4 := by
              induction k with
              | zero => norm_num
              | succ k ih =>
                simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, ih]
                <;> norm_num <;> omega
            exact h₅₃
          omega
      exact h₂
  
  have h_solution_set : n ∈ solution_set ↔ n % 3 = 0 := by
    simp only [solution_set, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    <;>
    aesop
  
  have h_final : n ∈ solution_set ↔ 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
    rw [h_solution_set]
    rw [h_main]
    <;>
    aesop
  
  exact h_final

theorem usa1990_p2 (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : x ∈ solution_set n ↔ f n x = 2 * x := by 
  have h_main : x = 4 ↔ f n x = 2 * x := by
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      have h₁ : x = 4 := h
      rw [h₁]
      have h₂ : ∀ (n : ℕ), f n (4 : ℝ) = 8 := by
        intro n
        induction n with
        | zero =>
          norm_num [f]
        | succ n ih =>
          rw [f]
          have h₃ : Real.sqrt ((4 : ℝ) ^ 2 + 6 * f n (4 : ℝ)) = 8 := by
            rw [ih]
            have h₄ : Real.sqrt ((4 : ℝ) ^ 2 + 6 * (8 : ℝ)) = 8 := by
              rw [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq] <;> norm_num
            simpa using h₄
          rw [h₃]
      have h₃ : f n (4 : ℝ) = 8 := h₂ n
      have h₄ : (2 : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) = 8 := by norm_num
      linarith
    · 
      intro h
      have h₁ : f n x = 2 * x := h
      by_contra h₂
      
      have h₃ : x ≠ 4 := h₂
      
      have h₄ : x > 4 ∨ x < 4 := by
        cases' lt_or_gt_of_ne h₃ with h₃ h₃
        · exact Or.inr h₃
        · exact Or.inl h₃
      cases' h₄ with h₄ h₄
      · 
        have h₅ : ∀ (n : ℕ), f n x < 2 * x := by
          intro n
          induction n with
          | zero =>
            
            have h₅₁ : f 0 x = (8 : ℝ) := by
              simp [f]
            rw [h₅₁]
            linarith
          | succ n ih =>
            
            have h₅₁ : f (n + 1) x = Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + 6 * f n x) := by
              simp [f]
            rw [h₅₁]
            have h₅₂ : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + 6 * f n x) < 2 * x := by
              have h₅₃ : x ^ 2 + 6 * f n x < (2 * x) ^ 2 := by
                have h₅₄ : f n x < 2 * x := ih
                nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 4)]
              have h₅₅ : 0 ≤ x ^ 2 + 6 * f n x := by
                have h₅₆ : 0 ≤ f n x := by
                  
                  have h₅₇ : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ f n x := by
                    intro n
                    induction n with
                    | zero =>
                      simp [f]
                      <;> norm_num
                    | succ n ih =>
                      simp_all [f]
                      <;> apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
                  exact h₅₇ n
                nlinarith [sq_nonneg x]
              have h₅₆ : 0 ≤ 2 * x := by
                nlinarith
              have h₅₇ : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + 6 * f n x) < 2 * x := by
                apply Real.sqrt_lt' (by positivity) |>.mpr
                nlinarith
              exact h₅₇
            exact h₅₂
        have h₆ : f n x < 2 * x := h₅ n
        linarith
      · 
        have h₅ : x < 4 := h₄
        by_cases h₆ : x ≤ 0
        · 
          have h₇ : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ f n x := by
            intro n
            induction n with
            | zero =>
              simp [f]
              <;> norm_num
            | succ n ih =>
              simp_all [f]
              <;> apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
          have h₈ : ∀ (n : ℕ), f n x > 2 * x := by
            intro n
            have h₉ : 0 ≤ f n x := h₇ n
            have h₁₀ : 2 * x ≤ 0 := by linarith
            have h₁₁ : f n x ≥ 0 := h₉
            have h₁₂ : f n x > 2 * x := by
              by_contra h₁₃
              have h₁₄ : f n x ≤ 2 * x := by linarith
              have h₁₅ : f n x ≥ 0 := h₉
              have h₁₆ : 2 * x ≤ 0 := by linarith
              have h₁₇ : f n x = 0 := by linarith
              have h₁₈ : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < f n x := by
                intro n
                induction n with
                | zero =>
                  simp [f]
                  <;> norm_num
                | succ n ih =>
                  simp_all [f]
                  <;>
                  (try positivity) <;>
                  (try
                    {
                      apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
                      nlinarith
                    })
                  <;>
                  (try
                    {
                      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (x ^ 2 + 6 * f n x)]
                    })
              have h₁₉ : 0 < f n x := h₁₈ n
              linarith
            exact h₁₂
          have h₉ : f n x > 2 * x := h₈ n
          linarith
        · 
          have h₇ : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
          have h₈ : ∀ (n : ℕ), f n x > 2 * x := by
            intro n
            induction n with
            | zero =>
              
              have h₉ : f 0 x = (8 : ℝ) := by
                simp [f]
              rw [h₉]
              nlinarith
            | succ n ih =>
              
              have h₉ : f (n + 1) x = Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + 6 * f n x) := by

    rw [ha]

  have h₂ : 0 ≤ b := by
    rw [hb]
    exact dist_nonneg
  
  have h₃ : 0 ≤ c := by
    rw [hc]
    exact dist_nonneg
  
  have h₄ : a^2 * (b + c - a) + b^2 * (c + a - b) + c^2 * (a + b - c) ≤ 3 * a * b * c := by
    have h₅ : a^3 + b^3 + c^3 + 3 * a * b * c ≥ a^2 * b + a^2 * c + b^2 * a + b^2 * c + c^2 * a + c^2 * b := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a + b - c), sq_nonneg (a + c - b), sq_nonneg (b + c - a),
        mul_nonneg h₁ h₂, mul_nonneg h₁ h₃, mul_nonneg h₂ h₃,
        sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (a - c), sq_nonneg (b - c),
        mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - b)) h₁, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - c)) h₁,
        mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (b - c)) h₂, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - b)) h₂,
        mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - c)) h₃, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (b - c)) h₃]
    have h₆ : a^2 * (b + c - a) + b^2 * (c + a - b) + c^2 * (a + b - c) = (a^2 * b + a^2 * c + b^2 * a + b^2 * c + c^2 * a + c^2 * b) - (a^3 + b^3 + c^3) := by
      ring

      linarith
    linarith

theorem imo_1964_p1b (n : ℕ) : ¬ 7 ∣ (2^n + 1) := by 
  have h_main : (2^n + 1) % 7 ≠ 0 := by
    have h : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      have : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt n (by decide)
      omega
    rcases h with (h | h | h)
    · 
      have h₁ : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 2 := by
        have h₂ : n % 3 = 0 := h
        have h₃ : ∃ m, n = 3 * m := by
          use n / 3
          have h₄ : n % 3 = 0 := h₂
          have h₅ : 3 * (n / 3) = n := by
            have h₆ := Nat.div_add_mod n 3
            omega
          linarith
        rcases h₃ with ⟨m, rfl⟩
        have h₄ : (2 ^ (3 * m) + 1) % 7 = 2 := by
          have h₅ : ∀ m : ℕ, (2 ^ (3 * m) + 1) % 7 = 2 := by
            intro m
            induction m with
            | zero => norm_num
            | succ m ih =>
              simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.add_mod] at ih ⊢
              <;> omega
          exact h₅ m
        exact h₄
      omega
    · 
      have h₁ : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 3 := by
        have h₂ : n % 3 = 1 := h
        have h₃ : ∃ m, n = 3 * m + 1 := by
          use n / 3
          have h₄ : n % 3 = 1 := h₂
          have h₅ : 3 * (n / 3) + 1 = n := by
            have h₆ := Nat.div_add_mod n 3
            omega
          linarith
        rcases h₃ with ⟨m, rfl⟩
        have h₄ : (2 ^ (3 * m + 1) + 1) % 7 = 3 := by
          have h₅ : ∀ m : ℕ, (2 ^ (3 * m + 1) + 1) % 7 = 3 := by
            intro m
            induction m with
            | zero => norm_num
            | succ m ih =>
              simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.add_mod] at ih ⊢
              <;> omega
          exact h₅ m
        exact h₄
      omega
    · 
      have h₁ : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 5 := by
        have h₂ : n % 3 = 2 := h
        have h₃ : ∃ m, n = 3 * m + 2 := by
          use n / 3
          have h₄ : n % 3 = 2 := h₂
          have h₅ : 3 * (n / 3) + 2 = n := by
            have h₆ := Nat.div_add_mod n 3
            omega
          linarith
        rcases h₃ with ⟨m, rfl⟩
        have h₄ : (2 ^ (3 * m + 2) + 1) % 7 = 5 := by
          have h₅ : ∀ m : ℕ, (2 ^ (3 * m + 2) + 1) % 7 = 5 := by
            intro m
            induction m with
            | zero => norm_num
            | succ m ih =>
              simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.add_mod] at ih ⊢
              <;> omega
          exact h₅ m
        exact h₄
      omega
  
  have h_final : ¬ 7 ∣ (2^n + 1) := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 0 := by
      omega
    have h₂ : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 ≠ 0 := h_main
    contradiction
  
  exact h_final

def IsGood (x A : ℝ) : Prop :=
  sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = A ∧ 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 ∧
    0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) ∧ 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)

abbrev solution_set_one : Set ℝ := ∅

theorem imo1959_p2b : IsGood x 1 ↔ x ∈ solution_set_one := by

    intro h

    have h₄ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := h.2.2.2

    have h₁₀ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have h₁₁ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by positivity
    
    have h₁₂ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [h₁]
      <;> norm_num
    have h₁₃ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = 2 * x + 2 * Real.sqrt ((x - 1) ^ 2) := by
      have h₁₄ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
        have h₁₅ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        have h₁₆ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        have h₁₇ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by positivity
        calc
          (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 =

                2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
            ring_nf
            <;> nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith),
              Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith)]
          _ = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
            have h₁₈ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by
              rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
            have h₁₉ : (sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by
              rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
            have h₂₀ : sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by
              rw [Real.sqrt_mul] <;> nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x - 1)]
            nlinarith
      have h₂₁ : (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = 2 * x + 2 * Real.sqrt ((x - 1) ^ 2) := by
        have h₂₂ : (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = (x - 1) ^ 2 := by

        rw [h₂₃]
        <;> ring_nf

        <;> nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 by linarith)]
      linarith
    have h₁₄ : 2 * x + 2 * Real.sqrt ((x - 1) ^ 2) = 1 := by

    have h₁₅ : Real.sqrt ((x - 1) ^ 2) = |x - 1| := by

        have h₂₂ : 2 * x + 2 * (-(x - 1)) > 1 := by

    <;> ring_nf
    <;> linarith

theorem singapore2019_r1_p4 (x : ℝ) (hx : Real.logb 21 3 = x) :

  have h₁ : x = Real.log 3 / Real.log 21 := by

      rw [Real.logb]
      <;> field_simp
      <;> ring
    rw [hx] at h₁₀
    linarith
  
  have h₂ : Real.log 21 = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := by
    have h₂₁ : Real.log 21 = Real.log (3 * 7) := by norm_num
    rw [h₂₁]
    have h₂₂ : Real.log (3 * 7) = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    rw [h₂₂]
    <;>
    norm_num
  
  have h₃ : x * (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) = Real.log 3 := by
    have h₃₁ : x = Real.log 3 / Real.log 21 := h₁
    have h₃₂ : Real.log 21 = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := h₂
    calc
      x * (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) = (Real.log 3 / Real.log 21) * (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := by rw [h₃₁]
      _ = (Real.log 3 / Real.log 21) * Real.log 21 := by
        rw [h₃₂]
        <;> ring
      _ = Real.log 3 := by
        have h₃₃ : Real.log 21 ≠ 0 := by
          have h₃₄ : Real.log 21 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
          linarith
        field_simp [h₃₃]
        <;> ring
        <;> field_simp [h₃₃]
        <;> linarith
  
  have h₄ : x * Real.log 7 = (1 - x) * Real.log 3 := by
    have h₄₁ : x * (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) = Real.log 3 := h₃
    have h₄₂ : x * Real.log 3 + x * Real.log 7 = Real.log 3 := by linarith
    have h₄₃ : x * Real.log 7 = Real.log 3 - x * Real.log 3 := by linarith
    have h₄₄ : x * Real.log 7 = (1 - x) * Real.log 3 := by
      calc
        x * Real.log 7 = Real.log 3 - x * Real.log 3 := by rw [h₄₃]
        _ = (1 - x) * Real.log 3 := by ring
    exact h₄₄
  
  have h₅ : Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * Real.log 3 / Real.log 7 := by
    have h₅₁ : Real.logb 7 9 = Real.log 9 / Real.log 7 := by
      rw [Real.logb]
      <;> field_simp
      <;> ring
    rw [h₅₁]
    have h₅₂ : Real.log 9 = 2 * Real.log 3 := by
      have h₅₃ : Real.log 9 = Real.log (3 ^ 2) := by norm_num

        rw [Real.log_pow] <;> norm_num
      rw [h₅₄]
    rw [h₅₂]
    <;> field_simp
    <;> ring
    <;>
    (try norm_num) <;>
    (try linarith [Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 3)]) <;>
    (try linarith [Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 7)])
  
  have h₆ : (1 - x) * Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * x := by
    have h₆₁ : Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * Real.log 3 / Real.log 7 := h₅

      (1 - x) * Real.logb 7 9 = (1 - x) * (2 * Real.log 3 / Real.log 7) := by rw [h₆₁]
      _ = 2 * ((1 - x) * Real.log 3) / Real.log 7 := by
        ring_nf
        <;> field_simp
        <;> ring_nf
      _ = 2 * (x * Real.log 7) / Real.log 7 := by
        have h₆₃ : (1 - x) * Real.log 3 = x * Real.log 7 := by linarith
        rw [h₆₃]
        <;> ring_nf
      _ = 2 * x := by
        have h₆₄ : Real.log 7 ≠ 0 := by
          have h₆₅ : Real.log 7 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
          linarith
        field_simp [h₆₄]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> field_simp [h₆₄]
        <;> linarith
  
  have h₇ : 1 - x ≠ 0 := by
    have h₇₁ : x = Real.log 3 / Real.log 21 := h₁
    have h₇₂ : Real.log 21 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h₇₃ : Real.log 3 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)

    have h₈₁ : (1 - x) * Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * x := h₆
    have h₈₂ : 1 - x ≠ 0 := h₇

      apply Eq.symm
      apply Eq.symm

theorem imo2008_p2a (x y z : ℝ) (h : x * y * z = 1) (hx : x ≠ 1) (hy : y ≠ 1) (hz : z ≠ 1) :
    x ^ 2 / (x - 1) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 / (y - 1) ^ 2 + z ^ 2 / (z - 1) ^ 2 ≥ 1 := by 
  have h₁ : x - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h₁
    apply hx
    linarith
  
  have h₂ : y - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h₂
    apply hy
    linarith
  
  have h₃ : z - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h₃
    apply hz
    linarith
  
  set a := x / (x - 1) with ha
  set b := y / (y - 1) with hb
  set c := z / (z - 1) with hc
  have h₄ : a * b * c = (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1) := by
    have h₄₁ : a - 1 = 1 / (x - 1) := by
      have h₄₂ : a = x / (x - 1) := by rw [ha]
      rw [h₄₂]
      field_simp [h₁]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [h₁]
      <;> ring_nf
    have h₄₃ : b - 1 = 1 / (y - 1) := by
      have h₄₄ : b = y / (y - 1) := by rw [hb]
      rw [h₄₄]
      field_simp [h₂]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [h₂]
      <;> ring_nf
    have h₄₅ : c - 1 = 1 / (z - 1) := by
      have h₄₆ : c = z / (z - 1) := by rw [hc]
      rw [h₄₆]
      field_simp [h₃]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [h₃]
      <;> ring_nf
    have h₄₇ : a = x / (x - 1) := by rw [ha]
    have h₄₈ : b = y / (y - 1) := by rw [hb]
    have h₄₉ : c = z / (z - 1) := by rw [hc]
    calc
      a * b * c = (x / (x - 1)) * (y / (y - 1)) * (z / (z - 1)) := by
        rw [h₄₇, h₄₈, h₄₉]
      _ = (x * y * z) / ((x - 1) * (y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by
        field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
        <;> ring_nf
      _ = 1 / ((x - 1) * (y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by
        rw [h]
        <;> field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
      _ = (1 / (x - 1)) * (1 / (y - 1)) * (1 / (z - 1)) := by
        field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
        <;> ring_nf
      _ = (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1) := by
        rw [h₄₁, h₄₃, h₄₅]
        <;> field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
        <;> ring_nf
  
  have h₅ : a * b + b * c + c * a = a + b + c - 1 := by
    have h₅₁ : a * b * c = (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1) := h₄
    have h₅₂ : a * b * c = (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1) := by rw [h₅₁]
    have h₅₃ : a * b + b * c + c * a = a + b + c - 1 := by
      ring_nf at h₅₂ ⊢
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a)]
    exact h₅₃
  
  have h₆ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 ≥ 1 := by
    have h₆₁ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = (a + b + c - 1) ^ 2 + 1 := by
      have h₆₂ : a * b + b * c + c * a = a + b + c - 1 := h₅
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a)]
    rw [h₆₁]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a + b + c - 1)]
  
  have h₇ : x ^ 2 / (x - 1) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 := by
    have h₇₁ : a = x / (x - 1) := by rw [ha]
    calc
      x ^ 2 / (x - 1) ^ 2 = (x / (x - 1)) ^ 2 := by
        field_simp [h₁]
        <;> ring_nf
      _ = a ^ 2 := by
        rw [h₇₁]
        <;> ring_nf
  
  have h₈ : y ^ 2 / (y - 1) ^ 2 = b ^ 2 := by
    have h₈₁ : b = y / (y - 1) := by rw [hb]
    calc
      y ^ 2 / (y - 1) ^ 2 = (y / (y - 1)) ^ 2 := by
        field_simp [h₂]
        <;> ring_nf
      _ = b ^ 2 := by
        rw [h₈₁]
        <;> ring_nf
  
  have h₉ : z ^ 2 / (z - 1) ^ 2 = c ^ 2 := by
    have h₉₁ : c = z / (z - 1) := by rw [hc]
    calc
      z ^ 2 / (z - 1) ^ 2 = (z / (z - 1)) ^ 2 := by
        field_simp [h₃]
        <;> ring_nf
      _ = c ^ 2 := by
        rw [h₉₁]
        <;> ring_nf
  
  have h₁₀ : x ^ 2 / (x - 1) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 / (y - 1) ^ 2 + z ^ 2 / (z - 1) ^ 2 ≥ 1 := by
    calc
      x ^ 2 / (x - 1) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 / (y - 1) ^ 2 + z ^ 2 / (z - 1) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 := by
        rw [h₇, h₈, h₉]
        <;> ring_nf
      _ ≥ 1 := by
        linarith
  
  exact h₁₀

 open Finset
variable (R : Type*) [LinearOrderedCommRing R]


structure IsGoodPeriodicSeq (c : R) (N : ℕ) where
  x : ℕ → R
  nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i
  good_sum : ∀ i, x i + x (i + 1) + x (i + 2) ≤ 2 • c
  periodic : ∀ k, x (k + 2 * N) = x k


def targetSum (x : ℕ → R) (N : ℕ) : R :=
  ∑ i ∈ range (2 * N), (x i * x (i + 2) + x (i + 1) * x (i + 3))


theorem imo_sl_2010_A3 {c : R} (hc : 0 ≤ c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
  IsGreatest (Set.range fun (s : IsGoodPeriodicSeq R c N) ↦ targetSum R s.x N) (2 * N • c ^ 2) :=
  by 
  have h_main_ineq : ∀ (a S T d : R), 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ S → 0 ≤ T → 0 ≤ d → a + S + T ≤ 2 • c → S + T + d ≤ 2 • c → a * T + S * d ≤ c ^ 2 := by
    intro a S T d ha hS hT hd h₁ h₂
    have h₃ : (S + T - c) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (S + T - c)]
    have h₄ : a * T + S * d ≤ c ^ 2 := by
      have h₅ : a ≤ 2 • c - S - T := by
        
        have h₅₁ : a + S + T ≤ 2 • c := h₁
        have h₅₂ : a ≤ 2 • c - S - T := by
          
          have h₅₃ : a + S + T ≤ 2 • c := h₁
          have h₅₄ : a ≤ 2 • c - S - T := by
            
            have h₅₅ : a + S + T - (S + T) ≤ 2 • c - (S + T) := by
              
              exact sub_le_sub_right h₅₃ (S + T)
            
            have h₅₆ : a ≤ 2 • c - S - T := by
              
              simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc] at h₅₅ ⊢
              <;> linarith
            exact h₅₆
          exact h₅₄
        exact h₅₂
      have h₆ : d ≤ 2 • c - S - T := by
        
        have h₆₁ : S + T + d ≤ 2 • c := h₂
        have h₆₂ : d ≤ 2 • c - S - T := by
          
          have h₆₃ : S + T + d ≤ 2 • c := h₂
          have h₆₄ : d ≤ 2 • c - S - T := by
            
            have h₆₅ : S + T + d - (S + T) ≤ 2 • c - (S + T) := by
              
              exact sub_le_sub_right h₆₃ (S + T)
            
            have h₆₆ : d ≤ 2 • c - S - T := by
              
              simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc] at h₆₅ ⊢
              <;> linarith
            exact h₆₆
          exact h₆₄
        exact h₆₂
      have h₇ : a * T ≤ (2 • c - S - T) * T := by
        
        have h₇₁ : 0 ≤ T := hT
        have h₇₂ : a ≤ 2 • c - S - T := h₅
        nlinarith
      have h₈ : S * d ≤ S * (2 • c - S - T) := by
        
        have h₈₁ : 0 ≤ S := hS
        have h₈₂ : d ≤ 2 • c - S - T := h₆
        nlinarith
      have h₉ : a * T + S * d ≤ (2 • c - S - T) * T + S * (2 • c - S - T) := by
        
        linarith
      have h₁₀ : (2 • c - S - T) * T + S * (2 • c - S - T) ≤ c ^ 2 := by
        
        have h₁₀₁ : (2 • c - S - T) * T + S * (2 • c - S - T) = 2 • c * (S + T) - (S + T) ^ 2 := by
          
          ring_nf
          <;> simp [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm, mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
          <;> abel
          <;> simp_all [two_mul]
          <;> ring_nf at *
          <;> linarith
        have h₁₀₂ : 2 • c * (S + T) - (S + T) ^ 2 ≤ c ^ 2 := by
          
          have h₁₀₃ : (S + T - c) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := h₃
          have h₁₀₄ : 0 ≤ (S + T - c) ^ 2 := by linarith
          have h₁₀₅ : 2 • c * (S + T) - (S + T) ^ 2 ≤ c ^ 2 := by
            
            have h₁₀₆ : (S + T - c) ^ 2 = (S + T) ^ 2 - 2 • c * (S + T) + c ^ 2 := by
              ring_nf
              <;> simp [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm, mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
              <;> abel
              <;> simp_all [two_mul]
              <;> ring_nf at *
              <;> linarith
            have h₁₀₇ : (S + T) ^ 2 - 2 • c * (S + T) + c ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by
              linarith
            have h₁₀₈ : 2 • c * (S + T) - (S + T) ^ 2 ≤ c ^ 2 := by
              
              linarith
            exact h₁₀₈
          exact h₁₀₅
        
        linarith
      
      linarith
    exact h₄
  
  have h_sum_le : ∀ (s : IsGoodPeriodicSeq R c N), targetSum R s.x N ≤ 2 * N • c ^ 2 := by
    intro s
    have h₁ : ∀ (i : ℕ), i ∈ Finset.range (2 * N) → (s.x i * s.x (i + 2) + s.x (i + 1) * s.x (i + 3)) ≤ c ^ 2 := by
      intro i hi
      have h₂ : 0 ≤ s.x i := s.nonneg i
      have h₃ : 0 ≤ s.x (i + 1) := s.nonneg (i + 1)
      have h₄ : 0 ≤ s.x (i + 2) := s.nonneg (i + 2)
      have h₅ : 0 ≤ s.x (i + 3) := s.nonneg (i + 3)
      have h₆ : s.x i + s.x (i + 1) + s.x (i + 2) ≤ 2 • c := s.good_sum i
      have h₇ : s.x (i + 1) + s.x (i + 2) + s.x (i + 3) ≤ 2 • c := s.good_sum (i + 1)
      have h₈ : s.x i * s.x (i + 2) + s.x (i + 1) * s.x (i + 3) ≤ c ^ 2 := by
        have h₉ := h_main_ineq (s.x i) (s.x (i + 1)) (s.x (i + 2)) (s.x (i + 3)) h₂ h₃ h₄ h₅ h₆ h₇
        exact h₉
      exact h₈
    calc
      targetSum R s.x N = ∑ i in Finset.range (2 * N), (s.x i * s.x (i + 2) + s.x (i + 1) * s.x (i + 3)) := rfl
      _ ≤ ∑ i in Finset.range (2 * N), c ^ 2 := Finset.sum_le_sum h₁
      _ = (2 * N : ℕ) • c ^ 2 := by
        simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
        <;>
        ring_nf
        <;>
        simp_all [mul_assoc]
        <;>
        norm_cast
        <;>
        simp_all [mul_assoc]
      _ = 2 * N • c ^ 2 := by simp [mul_assoc]
  
  have h_achievability : ∃ (s : IsGoodPeriodicSeq R c N), targetSum R s.x N = 2 * N • c ^ 2 := by
    have h₁ : ∃ (s : IsGoodPeriodicSeq R c N), targetSum R s.x N = 2 * N • c ^ 2 := by
      
      use {
        x := fun n => if n % 2 = 0 then c else 0
        nonneg := by
          intro i
          by_cases h : i % 2 = 0
          · 
            simp [h]
            <;> exact hc
          · 
            simp [h]
            <;> exact zero_le_zero
        good_sum := by
          intro i
          have h₂ : (if i % 2 = 0 then c else 0 : R) + (if (i + 1) % 2 = 0 then c else 0 : R) + (if (i + 2) % 2 = 0 then c else 0 : R) ≤ 2 • c := by
            have h₃ : i % 2 = 0 ∨ i % 2 = 1 := by omega
            rcases h₃ with (h₃ | h₃)
            · 
              have h₄ : (i : ℕ) % 2 = 0 := by omega
              have h₅ : (i + 1 : ℕ) % 2 = 1 := by omega
              have h₆ : (i + 2 : ℕ) % 2 = 0 := by omega
              simp [h₄, h₅, h₆]
              <;>
              (try norm_num) <;>
              (try simp_all [two_mul, add_assoc]) <;>
              (try ring_nf at *) <;>
              (try simp_all [add_assoc]) <;>
              (try nlinarith)
            · 
              have h₄ : (i : ℕ) % 2 = 1 := by omega
              have h₅ : (i + 1 : ℕ) % 2 = 0 := by omega
              have h₆ : (i + 2 : ℕ) % 2 = 1 := by omega
              simp [h₄, h₅, h₆]
              <;>
              (try norm_num) <;>
              (try simp_all [two_mul, add_assoc]) <;>
              (try ring_nf at *) <;>
              (try simp_all [add_assoc]) <;>
              (try nlinarith)
          exact h₂
        periodic := by
          intro k
          have h₃ : (if (k + 2 * N) % 2 = 0 then c else 0 : R) = (if k % 2 = 0 then c else 0 : R) := by
            have h₄ : (k + 2 * N) % 2 = k % 2 := by
              have h₅ : (k + 2 * N) % 2 = k % 2 := by
                have h₆ : (2 * N : ℕ) % 2 = 0 := by
                  simp [Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_mod]
                  <;> omega
                omega
              exact h₅
            by_cases h₅ : k % 2 = 0
            · simp [h₄, h₅]
            · simp [h₄, h₅]
          simp_all [h₃]
      }
      
      have h₂ : targetSum R (fun n => if n % 2 = 0 then c else 0) N = 2 * N • c ^ 2 := by
        calc
          targetSum R (fun n => if n % 2 = 0 then c else 0) N = ∑ i in Finset.range (2 * N), ((if i % 2 = 0 then c else 0 : R) * (if (i + 2) % 2 = 0 then c else 0 : R) + (if (i + 1) % 2 = 0 then c else 0 : R) * (if (i + 3) % 2 = 0 then c else 0 : R)) := rfl
          _ = ∑ i in Finset.range (2 * N), (c ^ 2 : R) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i _
            have h₃ : i % 2 = 0 ∨ i % 2 = 1 := by omega
            rcases h₃ with (h₃ | h₃)
            · 
              have h₄ : (i : ℕ) % 2 = 0 := by omega
              have h₅ : (i + 1 : ℕ) % 2 = 1 := by omega
              have h₆ : (i + 2 : ℕ) % 2 = 0 := by omega
              have h₇ : (i + 3 : ℕ) % 2 = 1 := by omega
              simp [h₄, h₅, h₆, h₇]
              <;>
              ring_nf <;>
              simp_all [pow_two]
              <;>
              nlinarith
            · 
              have h₄ : (i : ℕ) % 2 = 1 := by omega
              have h₅ : (i + 1 : ℕ) % 2 = 0 := by omega
              have h₆ : (i + 2 : ℕ) % 2 = 1 := by omega
              have h₇ : (i + 3 : ℕ) % 2 = 0 := by omega
              simp [h₄, h₅, h₆, h₇]

    rw [h₄₃]

theorem usa1974_p2 :
    ∀ (a b c : ℝ), a > 0 → b > 0 → c > 0 → a^a * b^b * c^c ≥ (a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3) := by 
  intro a b c ha hb hc
  have h_main : Real.log (a^a * b^b * c^c) ≥ Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) := by
    have h₁ : Real.log (a^a * b^b * c^c) = a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c := by
      have h₁₁ : Real.log (a^a * b^b * c^c) = Real.log (a^a) + Real.log (b^b) + Real.log (c^c) := by
        have h₁₁₁ : Real.log (a^a * b^b * c^c) = Real.log (a^a * b^b) + Real.log (c^c) := by
          rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        have h₁₁₂ : Real.log (a^a * b^b) = Real.log (a^a) + Real.log (b^b) := by
          rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        rw [h₁₁₁, h₁₁₂]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> field_simp [Real.log_mul, Real.log_rpow, ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
        <;> ring_nf
      have h₁₂ : Real.log (a^a) = a * Real.log a := by
        rw [Real.log_rpow ha]
      have h₁₃ : Real.log (b^b) = b * Real.log b := by
        rw [Real.log_rpow hb]
      have h₁₄ : Real.log (c^c) = c * Real.log c := by
        rw [Real.log_rpow hc]
      rw [h₁₁, h₁₂, h₁₃, h₁₄]
      <;> ring_nf
    have h₂ : Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) = ((a + b + c) / 3) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by
      have h₂₁ : Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) = ((a + b + c) / 3) * Real.log (a * b * c) := by
        rw [Real.log_rpow (by positivity)]
      have h₂₂ : Real.log (a * b * c) = Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c := by
        have h₂₂₁ : Real.log (a * b * c) = Real.log (a * b) + Real.log c := by
          rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        have h₂₂₂ : Real.log (a * b) = Real.log a + Real.log b := by
          rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        rw [h₂₂₁, h₂₂₂]
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₂₁, h₂₂]
      <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₁, h₂]
    have h₃ : (a - b) * (Real.log a - Real.log b) + (a - c) * (Real.log a - Real.log c) + (b - c) * (Real.log b - Real.log c) ≥ 0 := by
      have h₃₁ : (a - b) * (Real.log a - Real.log b) ≥ 0 := by
        by_cases h : a ≥ b
        · have h₃₁₁ : Real.log a ≥ Real.log b := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h
          have h₃₁₂ : a - b ≥ 0 := by linarith
          have h₃₁₃ : Real.log a - Real.log b ≥ 0 := by linarith
          nlinarith
        · have h₃₁₁ : Real.log a < Real.log b := Real.log_lt_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
          have h₃₁₂ : a - b < 0 := by linarith
          have h₃₁₃ : Real.log a - Real.log b < 0 := by linarith
          nlinarith
      have h₃₂ : (a - c) * (Real.log a - Real.log c) ≥ 0 := by
        by_cases h : a ≥ c
        · have h₃₂₁ : Real.log a ≥ Real.log c := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h
          have h₃₂₂ : a - c ≥ 0 := by linarith
          have h₃₂₃ : Real.log a - Real.log c ≥ 0 := by linarith
          nlinarith
        · have h₃₂₁ : Real.log a < Real.log c := Real.log_lt_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
          have h₃₂₂ : a - c < 0 := by linarith
          have h₃₂₃ : Real.log a - Real.log c < 0 := by linarith
          nlinarith
      have h₃₃ : (b - c) * (Real.log b - Real.log c) ≥ 0 := by
        by_cases h : b ≥ c
        · have h₃₃₁ : Real.log b ≥ Real.log c := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h
          have h₃₃₂ : b - c ≥ 0 := by linarith
          have h₃₃₃ : Real.log b - Real.log c ≥ 0 := by linarith
          nlinarith
        · have h₃₃₁ : Real.log b < Real.log c := Real.log_lt_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
          have h₃₃₂ : b - c < 0 := by linarith
          have h₃₃₃ : Real.log b - Real.log c < 0 := by linarith
          nlinarith
      linarith
    have h₄ : 3 * (a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c) ≥ (a + b + c) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by
      have h₄₁ : (a - b) * (Real.log a - Real.log b) + (a - c) * (Real.log a - Real.log c) + (b - c) * (Real.log b - Real.log c) ≥ 0 := h₃
      have h₄₂ : (a - b) * (Real.log a - Real.log b) + (a - c) * (Real.log a - Real.log c) + (b - c) * (Real.log b - Real.log c) = 3 * (a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c) - (a + b + c) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by
        ring_nf at h₄₁ ⊢
        <;>
        (try
          {
            nlinarith [Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)]
          })
        <;>
        (try
          {
            linarith [Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)]
          })
        <;>
        (try
          {
            nlinarith [Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)]
          })
        <;>
        (try
          {
            linarith [Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)]
          })
      linarith
    have h₅ : a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c ≥ ((a + b + c) / 3) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by
      linarith
    linarith
  
  have h_final : a^a * b^b * c^c ≥ (a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3) := by
    have h₁ : a^a * b^b * c^c > 0 := by positivity
    have h₂ : (a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3) > 0 := by positivity
    have h₃ : Real.log (a^a * b^b * c^c) ≥ Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) := h_main
    have h₄ : Real.log (a^a * b^b * c^c) ≥ Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) := by linarith
    have h₅ : a^a * b^b * c^c ≥ (a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3) := by
      by_contra h₅₁
      have h₅₂ : a^a * b^b * c^c < (a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3) := by linarith
      have h₅₃ : Real.log (a^a * b^b * c^c) < Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) := by
        apply Real.log_lt_log (by positivity)
        exact h₅₂
      linarith
    exact h₅
  
  exact h_final

theorem singapore2019_r1_p11 : 448 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) / Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) = solution := by

    have h₁₀ : Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180) := by
      rw [← Real.cos_pi_div_two_sub]
      congr 1
      ring_nf
      <;> field_simp
      <;> ring_nf
    exact h₁₀
  
  have h₂ : Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (78 * Real.pi / 180) / 2 := by
    have h₂₁ : Real.sin (78 * Real.pi / 180) = 2 * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180) := by
      have h₂₂ : Real.sin (78 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (2 * (39 * Real.pi / 180)) := by ring
      rw [h₂₂]
      have h₂₃ : Real.sin (2 * (39 * Real.pi / 180)) = 2 * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180) := by
        rw [Real.sin_two_mul]
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₂₃]
      <;> ring_nf
    have h₂₄ : Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (78 * Real.pi / 180) / 2 := by
      linarith
    exact h₂₄
  
  have h₃ : Real.sin (78 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.cos (12 * Real.pi / 180) := by
    have h₃₁ : Real.sin (78 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.cos (12 * Real.pi / 180) := by
      have h₃₂ : Real.sin (78 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.cos (Real.pi / 2 - 78 * Real.pi / 180) := by
        rw [← Real.cos_pi_div_two_sub]
      rw [h₃₂]
      have h₃₃ : Real.pi / 2 - 78 * Real.pi / 180 = 12 * Real.pi / 180 := by
        ring_nf
        <;> field_simp
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
      rw [h₃₃]
    exact h₃₁
  
  have h₄ : Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (12 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) / 2 := by
    have h₄₁ : Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) = 2 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (12 * Real.pi / 180) := by
      have h₄₂ : Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (2 * (12 * Real.pi / 180)) := by ring
      rw [h₄₂]
      have h₄₃ : Real.sin (2 * (12 * Real.pi / 180)) = 2 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (12 * Real.pi / 180) := by
        rw [Real.sin_two_mul]
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₄₃]
      <;> ring_nf
    have h₄₄ : Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (12 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) / 2 := by
      linarith
    exact h₄₄
  
  have h₅ : 448 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) / Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) = 112 := by
    have h₅₁ : Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) > 0 := by
      apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
      <;> norm_num <;>
      (try linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]) <;>
      (try linarith [Real.pi_pos])
    have h₅₂ : Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) > 0 := by
      apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
      <;> norm_num <;>
      (try linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]) <;>
      (try linarith [Real.pi_pos])
    have h₅₃ : Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) > 0 := by
      apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
      <;> norm_num <;>
      (try linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]) <;>
      (try linarith [Real.pi_pos])
    have h₅₄ : Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) > 0 := by
      apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
      <;> norm_num <;>
      (try linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]) <;>
      (try linarith [Real.pi_pos])
    have h₅₅ : Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) / 4 := by
      calc
        Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180) := by rw [h₁]
        _ = Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * (Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180)) := by ring
        _ = Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * (Real.sin (78 * Real.pi / 180) / 2) := by rw [h₂]
        _ = (Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (78 * Real.pi / 180)) / 2 := by ring
        _ = (Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (12 * Real.pi / 180)) / 2 := by
          rw [h₃]
          <;> ring_nf
        _ = (Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) / 2) / 2 := by
          rw [h₄]
          <;> ring_nf
        _ = Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) / 4 := by ring
    have h₅₆ : 448 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) / Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) = 112 := by
      calc
        448 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) / Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180)
          = 448 * (Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180)) / Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) := by ring
        _ = 448 * (Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) / 4) / Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) := by rw [h₅₅]
        _ = (448 / 4 : ℝ) * (Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) / Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180)) := by
          field_simp [h₅₄.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₅₄.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
        _ = (448 / 4 : ℝ) * 1 := by
          field_simp [h₅₄.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
        _ = 112 := by norm_num
    exact h₅₆
  
  have h₆ : 448 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) / Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) = solution := by
    rw [h₅]
    <;> norm_num [solution]

    <;>
    norm_num
    <;>
    linarith
  
  apply h₆

theorem imo1985_p4 (M : Finset ℕ) (Mpos : ∀ m ∈ M, 0 < m)
    (Mdivisors : ∀ m ∈ M, ∀ n, m.Prime ∧ n ∣ m → m ≤ 23)
    : ∃ M' : Finset ℕ, M' ⊆ M ∧ ∃ k, M'.prod id = k^4 := by

    use ∅
    constructor

      use 1
      simp [Finset.prod_empty]
      <;> norm_num
  
  exact h_main

theorem imo1963_p5 :
    Real.cos (Real.pi/7) - Real.cos (2*Real.pi/7) + Real.cos (3*Real.pi/7) = 1/2 := by 
  have h_main : 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) * (Real.cos (Real.pi / 7) - Real.cos (2 * Real.pi / 7) + Real.cos (3 * Real.pi / 7)) = Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) := by
    have h1 : 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 7) = Real.sin (2 * Real.pi / 7) := by
      have h1₁ : Real.sin (2 * Real.pi / 7) = Real.sin (2 * (Real.pi / 7)) := by ring
      rw [h1₁]
      have h1₂ : Real.sin (2 * (Real.pi / 7)) = 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 7) := by
        rw [Real.sin_two_mul]
        <;> ring_nf
      linarith
    have h2 : 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi / 7) = Real.sin (3 * Real.pi / 7) - Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) := by
      have h2₁ : Real.sin (3 * Real.pi / 7) - Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) = 2 * Real.cos ((3 * Real.pi / 7 + Real.pi / 7) / 2) * Real.sin ((3 * Real.pi / 7 - Real.pi / 7) / 2) := by
        have h2₂ : Real.sin (3 * Real.pi / 7) - Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) = 2 * Real.cos ((3 * Real.pi / 7 + Real.pi / 7) / 2) * Real.sin ((3 * Real.pi / 7 - Real.pi / 7) / 2) := by
          have h2₃ : Real.sin (3 * Real.pi / 7) - Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) = 2 * Real.cos ((3 * Real.pi / 7 + Real.pi / 7) / 2) * Real.sin ((3 * Real.pi / 7 - Real.pi / 7) / 2) := by
            rw [← sub_eq_zero]
            have h2₄ : Real.sin (3 * Real.pi / 7) - Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) = 2 * Real.cos ((3 * Real.pi / 7 + Real.pi / 7) / 2) * Real.sin ((3 * Real.pi / 7 - Real.pi / 7) / 2) := by
              rw [Real.sin_sub_sin]
              <;> ring_nf at * <;>
                (try norm_num) <;>
                (try linarith [Real.pi_pos]) <;>
                (try field_simp) <;>
                (try ring_nf) <;>
                (try norm_num) <;>
                (try linarith [Real.pi_pos])
            linarith
          linarith
        linarith
      have h2₂ : 2 * Real.cos ((3 * Real.pi / 7 + Real.pi / 7) / 2) * Real.sin ((3 * Real.pi / 7 - Real.pi / 7) / 2) = 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi / 7) := by
        have h2₃ : (3 * Real.pi / 7 + Real.pi / 7) / 2 = 2 * Real.pi / 7 := by

          <;> field_simp
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
        have h2₄ : (3 * Real.pi / 7 - Real.pi / 7) / 2 = Real.pi / 7 := by
          ring_nf
          <;> field_simp
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
        rw [h2₃, h2₄]
        <;>
        (try ring_nf) <;>

        (try simp [Real.sin_add, Real.cos_add, Real.sin_sub, Real.cos_sub]) <;>

        (try field_simp at *) <;>
        (try linarith [Real.pi_pos]) <;>
        (try nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]) <;>
        (try nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three])
        <;>

    have h3 : 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) * Real.cos (3 * Real.pi / 7) = Real.sin (4 * Real.pi / 7) - Real.sin (2 * Real.pi / 7) := by
      have h3₁ : Real.sin (4 * Real.pi / 7) - Real.sin (2 * Real.pi / 7) = 2 * Real.cos ((4 * Real.pi / 7 + 2 * Real.pi / 7) / 2) * Real.sin ((4 * Real.pi / 7 - 2 * Real.pi / 7) / 2) := by
        have h3₂ : Real.sin (4 * Real.pi / 7) - Real.sin (2 * Real.pi / 7) = 2 * Real.cos ((4 * Real.pi / 7 + 2 * Real.pi / 7) / 2) * Real.sin ((4 * Real.pi / 7 - 2 * Real.pi / 7) / 2) := by
          rw [Real.sin_sub_sin]

            (try field_simp) <;>

    have h4 : Real.sin (4 * Real.pi / 7) = Real.sin (3 * Real.pi / 7) := by
      have h4₁ : Real.sin (4 * Real.pi / 7) = Real.sin (Real.pi - 3 * Real.pi / 7) := by
        have h4₂ : 4 * Real.pi / 7 = Real.pi - 3 * Real.pi / 7 := by

        rw [h4₂]
      rw [h4₁]
      have h4₂ : Real.sin (Real.pi - 3 * Real.pi / 7) = Real.sin (3 * Real.pi / 7) := by

      rw [h4₂]
    calc
      2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) * (Real.cos (Real.pi / 7) - Real.cos (2 * Real.pi / 7) + Real.cos (3 * Real.pi / 7)) =
          2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 7) - 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi / 7) + 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) * Real.cos (3 * Real.pi / 7) := by

    intro x

    have h₂ : f (x + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := (hf.2 x).2

    have h₄ : f (x + 2 * a) = f (x + a + a) := by ring_nf
    rw [h₄, h₃]

    have h₆ : f x ≥ 1 / 2 := h_f_half x
    have h₇ : f x - (f x)^2 ≥ 0 := by

theorem imo1969_p2
    (x₁ x₂ : ℝ)
    (n : ℕ)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (h₁ : ∀ x, f x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x)) / (2^i))
    (h₂ : f x₂ = 0)
    (h₃ : f x₁ = 0)
    (h₄: ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 ^ i)) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by 
  have h_C : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using h₄
  
  set C : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i) with hC_def
  set S : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i) with hS_def
  
  have h_f_expand : ∀ (x : ℝ), f x = C * Real.cos x - S * Real.sin x := by
    intro x
    rw [h₁]
    have h₅ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) = C * Real.cos x - S * Real.sin x := by
      calc
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by rfl
        _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          have h₅₁ : Real.cos (a i + x) = Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x := by
            rw [Real.cos_add]
          rw [h₅₁]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp
          <;> ring_nf
        _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.sin x) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          have h₅₂ : (Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i = Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.sin x := by
            ring_nf
            <;> field_simp
            <;> ring_nf
          rw [h₅₂]
        _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.cos x) - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.sin x := by
          rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.cos x - (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.sin x := by
          have h₅₃ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.cos x) = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.cos x := by
            calc
              (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.cos x) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.cos x) := by rfl
              _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.cos x := by
                simp [Finset.sum_mul]
          have h₅₄ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.sin x) = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.sin x := by
            calc
              (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.sin x) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.sin x) := by rfl
              _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.sin x := by
                simp [Finset.sum_mul]
          rw [h₅₃, h₅₄]
          <;> ring_nf
        _ = C * Real.cos x - S * Real.sin x := by
          simp only [hC_def, hS_def]
          <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₅]
    <;> simp_all [hC_def, hS_def]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> field_simp
    <;> ring_nf
  
  have h_Ccosx₁_eq_Ssinx₁ : C * Real.cos x₁ = S * Real.sin x₁ := by
    have h₅ : f x₁ = C * Real.cos x₁ - S * Real.sin x₁ := by
      rw [h_f_expand]
    rw [h₅] at h₃
    have h₆ : C * Real.cos x₁ - S * Real.sin x₁ = 0 := by linarith
    linarith
  
  have h_Ccosx₂_eq_Ssinx₂ : C * Real.cos x₂ = S * Real.sin x₂ := by
    have h₅ : f x₂ = C * Real.cos x₂ - S * Real.sin x₂ := by
      rw [h_f_expand]
    rw [h₅] at h₂
    have h₆ : C * Real.cos x₂ - S * Real.sin x₂ = 0 := by linarith
    linarith
  
  have h_Csin_diff : C * Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
    have h₅ : C * Real.cos x₁ = S * Real.sin x₁ := h_Ccosx₁_eq_Ssinx₁
    have h₆ : C * Real.cos x₂ = S * Real.sin x₂ := h_Ccosx₂_eq_Ssinx₂
    have h₇ : C * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) = 0 := by
      calc
        C * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) = C * Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - C * Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁ := by ring
        _ = S * Real.sin x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - S * Real.sin x₂ * Real.sin x₁ := by
          have h₇₁ : C * Real.cos x₁ = S * Real.sin x₁ := h₅
          have h₇₂ : C * Real.cos x₂ = S * Real.sin x₂ := h₆
          calc
            C * Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - C * Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁ = (C * Real.cos x₁) * Real.sin x₂ - (C * Real.cos x₂) * Real.sin x₁ := by ring
            _ = (S * Real.sin x₁) * Real.sin x₂ - (S * Real.sin x₂) * Real.sin x₁ := by
              rw [h₇₁, h₇₂]
              <;> ring
            _ = S * Real.sin x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - S * Real.sin x₂ * Real.sin x₁ := by ring
        _ = 0 := by ring
    have h₈ : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = Real.sin x₂ * Real.cos x₁ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁ := by
      rw [Real.sin_sub]
      <;> ring
    have h₉ : C * Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = C * (Real.sin x₂ * Real.cos x₁ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) := by
      rw [h₈]
      <;> ring
    have h₁₀ : C * (Real.sin x₂ * Real.cos x₁ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) = C * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) := by
      ring
    calc
      C * Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = C * (Real.sin x₂ * Real.cos x₁ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) := by rw [h₉]
      _ = C * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) := by rw [h₁₀]
      _ = 0 := by rw [h₇]
  
  have h_sin_diff_zero : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
    have h₅ : C * Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := h_Csin_diff
    have h₆ : C ≠ 0 := by
      
      simpa [hC_def] using h_C
    
    have h₇ : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ h₆
      linarith
    exact h₇
  
  have h_final : ∃ m : ℤ, x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by
    have h₅ : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := h_sin_diff_zero
    have h₆ : ∃ (m : ℤ), x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by
      
      rw [Real.sin_eq_zero_iff] at h₅
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h₅
      refine' ⟨m, _⟩
      linarith
    exact h₆
  
  exact h_final

abbrev P (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < a ∧
  ∀ x, (f x)^2 ≤ f x ∧ f (x + a) = 1/2 + √(f x - (f x)^2)

theorem imo1968_p5a (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (hf : P a f) :
    ∃ b, 0 < b ∧ f.Periodic b := by 
  have h_main : ∀ x, f (x + 2 * a) = f x := by
    have h₀ : 0 < a := hf.1
    have h₁ : ∀ x, (f x)^2 ≤ f x ∧ f (x + a) = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := hf.2
    have h₂ : ∀ y, f y ≥ 1 / 2 := by
      intro y
      have h₃ : f y = f ((y - a) + a) := by ring_nf
      rw [h₃]
      have h₄ : f ((y - a) + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f (y - a) - (f (y - a))^2) := (h₁ (y - a)).2
      rw [h₄]
      have h₅ : Real.sqrt (f (y - a) - (f (y - a))^2) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      linarith
    intro x
    have h₃ : f (x + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := (h₁ x).2
    have h₄ : f (x + 2 * a) = f ((x + a) + a) := by ring_nf
    rw [h₄]
    have h₅ : f ((x + a) + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f (x + a) - (f (x + a))^2) := (h₁ (x + a)).2
    rw [h₅]
    have h₆ : f (x + a) - (f (x + a))^2 = (f x - 1 / 2)^2 := by
      have h₇ : f (x + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := (h₁ x).2
      rw [h₇]
      have h₈ : 0 ≤ f x - (f x)^2 := by
        have h₉ : (f x)^2 ≤ f x := (h₁ x).1
        nlinarith
      have h₉ : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h₁₀ : 0 ≤ 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := by linarith
      have h₁₁ : (1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2)) - (1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2))^2 = (f x - 1 / 2)^2 := by
        have h₁₂ : Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        have h₁₃ : (Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2))^2 = f x - (f x)^2 := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> nlinarith [h₁ x |>.1]
        nlinarith [h₁ x |>.1, h₁₃]
      linarith
    have h₇ : Real.sqrt (f (x + a) - (f (x + a))^2) = f x - 1 / 2 := by
      rw [h₆]

theorem imo1969_p2
    (x₁ x₂ : ℝ)
    (n : ℕ)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (h₁ : ∀ x, f x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x)) / (2^i))
    (h₂ : f x₂ = 0)
    (h₃ : f x₁ = 0)
    (h₄: ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 ^ i)) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by 
  have h_sum_formula : ∀ (x : ℝ), (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x)) / (2 : ℝ)^i) = (Real.cos x * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i)) - (Real.sin x * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i)) := by
    intro x
    have h₅ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ((Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      have h₅₁ : Real.cos (a i + x) = Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x := by
        rw [Real.cos_add]
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₅₁]
      <;> field_simp [pow_ne_zero]
      <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₅]
    have h₆ : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ((Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) = (Real.cos x * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) - (Real.sin x * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) := by
      calc
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ((Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos x * (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) - Real.sin x * (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          have h₆₁ : (Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i = Real.cos x * (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) - Real.sin x * (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by
            field_simp [pow_ne_zero]
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp [pow_ne_zero]
            <;> ring_nf
          rw [h₆₁]
        _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos x * (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i))) - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin x * (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        _ = Real.cos x * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) - Real.sin x * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by
          have h₆₂ : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos x * (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) = Real.cos x * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          have h₆₃ : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin x * (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) = Real.sin x * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          rw [h₆₂, h₆₃]
          <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₆]
    <;> ring_nf
  
  have h_A : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i)) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using h₄
  
  have h_main : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
    have h₅ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x₂)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) = 0 := by
      have h₅₁ : f x₂ = 0 := h₂
      have h₅₂ : f x₂ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x₂)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i := by
        rw [h₁]
        <;> simp [Nat.cast_pow]
        <;> field_simp [pow_ne_zero]
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₅₂] at h₅₁
      exact h₅₁
    have h₆ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x₁)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) = 0 := by
      have h₆₁ : f x₁ = 0 := h₃
      have h₆₂ : f x₁ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x₁)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i := by
        rw [h₁]
        <;> simp [Nat.cast_pow]
        <;> field_simp [pow_ne_zero]
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₆₂] at h₆₁
      exact h₆₁
    have h₇ : (Real.cos x₂ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) - (Real.sin x₂ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) = 0 := by
      have h₇₁ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x₂)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) = (Real.cos x₂ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) - (Real.sin x₂ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) := by
        rw [h_sum_formula]
      rw [h₇₁] at h₅
      exact h₅
    have h₈ : (Real.cos x₁ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) - (Real.sin x₁ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) = 0 := by
      have h₈₁ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x₁)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) = (Real.cos x₁ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) - (Real.sin x₁ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) := by
        rw [h_sum_formula]
      rw [h₈₁] at h₆
      exact h₆
    have h₉ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) ≠ 0 := h_A
    have h₁₀ : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
      have h₁₀₁ : (Real.cos x₂ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) = (Real.sin x₂ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) := by
        linarith
      have h₁₀₂ : (Real.cos x₁ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) = (Real.sin x₁ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) := by
        linarith
      have h₁₀₃ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) = 0 := by
        have h₁₀₄ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂) - (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * (Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) := by
          ring
        rw [h₁₀₄]
        have h₁₀₅ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂) = Real.sin x₂ * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x₁) := by ring
        have h₁₀₆ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * (Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) = Real.sin x₁ * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x₂) := by ring
        rw [h₁₀₅, h₁₀₆]
        have h₁₀₇ : Real.sin x₂ * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x₁) = Real.sin x₂ * (Real.sin x₁ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) := by
          have h₁₀₈ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x₁ = Real.sin x₁ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by
            calc
              (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x₁ = Real.cos x₁ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by ring
              _ = Real.sin x₁ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by
                have h₁₀₉ : Real.cos x₁ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) = Real.sin x₁ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by
                  linarith
                linarith
          rw [h₁₀₈]
          <;> ring
        have h₁₀₉ : Real.sin x₁ * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x₂) = Real.sin x₁ * (Real.sin x₂ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) := by
          have h₁₁₀ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x₂ = Real.sin x₂ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by
            calc
              (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x₂ = Real.cos x₂ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by ring
              _ = Real.sin x₂ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by
                have h₁₁₁ : Real.cos x₂ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) = Real.sin x₂ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) := by
                  linarith
                linarith
          rw [h₁₁₀]
          <;> ring
        rw [h₁₀₇, h₁₀₉]
        <;> ring
        <;> linarith
      have h₁₁ : Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁ = Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) := by
        have h₁₁₁ : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = Real.sin x₂ * Real.cos x₁ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁ := by
          rw [Real.sin_sub]
          <;> ring_nf
        have h₁₁₂ : Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁ = Real.sin x₂ * Real.cos x₁ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁ := by ring
        linarith
      have h₁₂ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
        calc
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) := by rw [h₁₁]
          _ = 0 := by rw [h₁₀₃]
      have h₁₃ : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ h₉
        linarith
      exact h₁₃
    exact h₁₀
  
  have h_final : ∃ m : ℤ, x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by
    have h₅ : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := h_main
    have h₆ : ∃ (m : ℤ), x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by
      
      have h₇ : ∃ (m : ℤ), x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by
        
        rw [Real.sin_eq_zero_iff] at h₅
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h₅
        use m

    exact dist_nonneg
  
  have h_schur : a^3 + b^3 + c^3 + 3*a*b*c ≥ a^2*b + a^2*c + b^2*a + b^2*c + c^2*a + c^2*b := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a + b + c), sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (a - c), sq_nonneg (b - c),

      <;> ring_nf

      field_simp [h₃]

  sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = A ∧ 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 ∧
    0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) ∧ 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)

theorem usa1980_p5 (x y z : ℝ)

    1 + (1 - x) * (1 - y) * (1 - z) := by

    have h₁ : 0 ≤ 1 - x := by
      have h₁ : x ≤ 1 := hx.2

    have h₂ : 0 ≤ 1 - y := by
      have h₁ : y ≤ 1 := hy.2
