    have h₃ : 0 ≤ 1 - z := by
      have h₁ : z ≤ 1 := hz.2
      linarith
    have h₄ : 0 ≤ (1 - x) * (1 - y) := by positivity
    have h₅ : 0 ≤ (1 - x) * (1 - y) * (1 - z) := by positivity
    linarith
  
  have h_sum_le_one : x / (y + z + 1) + y / (z + x + 1) + z / (x + y + 1) ≤ 1 := by
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := hx.1
    have hx1 : x ≤ 1 := hx.2
    have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := hy.1
    have hy1 : y ≤ 1 := hy.2
    have hz0 : 0 ≤ z := hz.1
    have hz1 : z ≤ 1 := hz.2
    by_cases h : (x + y + z = 0)
    · have h₁ : x = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      have h₂ : y = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      have h₃ : z = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
      norm_num
    · 
      have h₁ : 0 < x + y + z := by
        by_contra h₁
        have h₂ : x + y + z ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have h₃ : x + y + z = 0 := by
          nlinarith [hx0, hy0, hz0]
        contradiction
      have h₂ : 0 < y + z + 1 := by nlinarith [hy0, hz0]
      have h₃ : 0 < z + x + 1 := by nlinarith [hz0, hx0]
      have h₄ : 0 < x + y + 1 := by nlinarith [hx0, hy0]
      have h₅ : x / (y + z + 1) ≤ x / (x + y + z) := by
        apply div_le_div_of_le_left (by positivity) (by positivity)
        nlinarith [hx1]
      have h₆ : y / (z + x + 1) ≤ y / (x + y + z) := by
        apply div_le_div_of_le_left (by positivity) (by positivity)
        nlinarith [hy1]
      have h₇ : z / (x + y + 1) ≤ z / (x + y + z) := by
        apply div_le_div_of_le_left (by positivity) (by positivity)
        nlinarith [hz1]
      have h₈ : x / (y + z + 1) + y / (z + x + 1) + z / (x + y + 1) ≤ x / (x + y + z) + y / (x + y + z) + z / (x + y + z) := by
        linarith
      have h₉ : x / (x + y + z) + y / (x + y + z) + z / (x + y + z) = 1 := by
        field_simp [h₁.ne']
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> field_simp [h₁.ne']
        <;> linarith
      linarith
  
  have h_main : x / (y + z + 1) + y / (z + x + 1) + z / (x + y + 1) ≤ 1 + (1 - x) * (1 - y) * (1 - z) := by
    linarith [h_sum_le_one, h_nonneg]
  
  exact h_main

theorem imo1995_p2 (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (habc : a * b * c = 1) :
    3 / 2 ≤ 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) := by 
  have h₁ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + a * (b + c) / 4 ≥ 1 / a := by
    have h₁₀ : 0 < a^3 * (b + c) := by positivity

    have h₁₃ : 0 < a * (b + c) / 4 := by positivity

      have h₁₅ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + a * (b + c) / 4 ≥ 2 * Real.sqrt ((1 / (a^3 * (b + c))) * (a * (b + c) / 4)) := by
        
        have h₁₆ : 0 ≤ 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) := by positivity
        have h₁₇ : 0 ≤ a * (b + c) / 4 := by positivity
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (1 / (a^3 * (b + c))) * (a * (b + c) / 4) by positivity),
          sq_nonneg (1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) - a * (b + c) / 4)]
      have h₁₈ : 2 * Real.sqrt ((1 / (a^3 * (b + c))) * (a * (b + c) / 4)) = 1 / a := by
        have h₁₉ : Real.sqrt ((1 / (a^3 * (b + c))) * (a * (b + c) / 4)) = 1 / (2 * a) := by
          have h₂₀ : (1 / (a^3 * (b + c))) * (a * (b + c) / 4) = 1 / (4 * a^2) := by
            field_simp [pow_three]
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
            <;> ring_nf
          rw [h₂₀]
          have h₂₁ : Real.sqrt (1 / (4 * a^2)) = 1 / (2 * a) := by
            have h₂₂ : 0 < a := ha
            have h₂₃ : 0 < 4 * a^2 := by positivity
            rw [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq (by positivity) (by positivity)]
            field_simp [h₂₂.ne']
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp [h₂₂.ne']
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> nlinarith
          rw [h₂₁]
          <;> field_simp [ha.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
        rw [h₁₉]
        <;> field_simp [ha.ne']
        <;> ring_nf
      linarith
    exact h₁₄
  
  have h₂ : 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + b * (c + a) / 4 ≥ 1 / b := by
    have h₂₀ : 0 < b^3 * (c + a) := by positivity
    have h₂₁ : 0 < b * (c + a) := by positivity

  have h₄ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) + (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) / 4 ≥ 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c := by

    have h₇₄ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) + (2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a)) / 4 ≥ a * b + b * c + c * a := by

theorem imo1971_p5 (m : ℕ) :

  have h_main : ∃ (S : Set Pt), S.Finite ∧ ∀ (s : Pt), s ∈ S → Nat.card {t : Pt | dist s t = 1} = m := by

theorem imo_sl_2010_A2 [LinearOrderedCommRing R] (a b c d : R)

    let S := 4 * (a ^ 3 + b ^ 3 + c ^ 3 + d ^ 3) - (a ^ 4 + b ^ 4 + c ^ 4 + d ^ 4)
    36 ≤ S ∧ S ≤ 48 := by 
  dsimp only
  have h_upper : 4 * (a ^ 3 + b ^ 3 + c ^ 3 + d ^ 3) - (a ^ 4 + b ^ 4 + c ^ 4 + d ^ 4) ≤ 48 := by
    have h₁ : a ^ 4 - 4 * a ^ 3 + 4 * a ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 2), sq_nonneg (a ^ 2 - 2 * a)]

      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (c - 2), sq_nonneg (c ^ 2 - 2 * c)]
    have h₄ : d ^ 4 - 4 * d ^ 3 + 4 * d ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (d - 2), sq_nonneg (d ^ 2 - 2 * d)]
    have h₅ : a ^ 4 - 4 * a ^ 3 + 4 * a ^ 2 + (b ^ 4 - 4 * b ^ 3 + 4 * b ^ 2) + (c ^ 4 - 4 * c ^ 3 + 4 * c ^ 2) + (d ^ 4 - 4 * d ^ 3 + 4 * d ^ 2) ≥ 0 := by
      linarith
    nlinarith [h_sq_sum]
  
  have h_lower : 36 ≤ 4 * (a ^ 3 + b ^ 3 + c ^ 3 + d ^ 3) - (a ^ 4 + b ^ 4 + c ^ 4 + d ^ 4) := by
    have h₁ : (a - 1) ^ 2 + (b - 1) ^ 2 + (c - 1) ^ 2 + (d - 1) ^ 2 = 4 := by
      calc
        (a - 1) ^ 2 + (b - 1) ^ 2 + (c - 1) ^ 2 + (d - 1) ^ 2 = (a ^ 2 - 2 * a + 1) + (b ^ 2 - 2 * b + 1) + (c ^ 2 - 2 * c + 1) + (d ^ 2 - 2 * d + 1) := by
          ring
        _ = (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + d ^ 2) - 2 * (a + b + c + d) + 4 := by ring
        _ = 12 - 2 * 6 + 4 := by rw [h_sq_sum, h_sum]
        _ = 4 := by ring
    have h₂ : (a - 3) ^ 2 + (b - 3) ^ 2 + (c - 3) ^ 2 + (d - 3) ^ 2 = 12 := by
      calc
        (a - 3) ^ 2 + (b - 3) ^ 2 + (c - 3) ^ 2 + (d - 3) ^ 2 = (a ^ 2 - 6 * a + 9) + (b ^ 2 - 6 * b + 9) + (c ^ 2 - 6 * c + 9) + (d ^ 2 - 6 * d + 9) := by

        _ = (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + d ^ 2) - 6 * (a + b + c + d) + 36 := by ring
        _ = 12 - 6 * 6 + 36 := by rw [h_sq_sum, h_sum]
        _ = 12 := by ring
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 1), sq_nonneg (a - 3), sq_nonneg (b - 1), sq_nonneg (b - 3),
      sq_nonneg (c - 1), sq_nonneg (c - 3), sq_nonneg (d - 1), sq_nonneg (d - 3),
      sq_nonneg (a + b + c + d - 6), sq_nonneg (a + b + c + d)]

  (h₃ : ∀ n, f (4 * n + 1) + f n = 2 * f (2 * n + 1))
  (h₄ : ∀ n, f (4 * n + 3) + 2 * f n = 3 * f (2 * n + 1))
  (A: Finset {n | 0 < n ∧ n ≤ 1988 ∧ f n = n}) :
    A.card = solution := by 
  have h₅ : f 0 = 1 := by
    have h₅₁ := h₃ 0
    have h₅₂ : f (4 * 0 + 1) + f 0 = 2 * f (2 * 0 + 1) := h₅₁
    have h₅₃ : f 1 + f 0 = 2 * f 1 := by
      norm_num at h₅₂ ⊢
      <;> simpa using h₅₂
    have h₅₄ : 1 + f 0 = 2 * 1 := by
      rw [h₀] at h₅₃
      <;> simpa using h₅₃
    have h₅₅ : f 0 = 1 := by
      omega
    exact h₅₅
  
  have h₆ : False := by
    have h₆₁ := h₄ 0
    have h₆₂ : f (4 * 0 + 3) + 2 * f 0 = 3 * f (2 * 0 + 1) := h₆₁
    have h₆₃ : f 3 + 2 * f 0 = 3 * f 1 := by
      norm_num at h₆₂ ⊢
      <;> simpa using h₆₂
    have h₆₄ : 3 + 2 * 1 = 3 * 1 := by
      rw [h₁, h₅, h₀] at h₆₃
      <;> norm_num at h₆₃ ⊢ <;> linarith
    norm_num at h₆₄
    <;> omega
  
  have h₇ : A.card = solution := by
    exfalso
    exact h₆
  
  exact h₇

theorem imo1995_p2 (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)

    have h₄ : 0 < b * c := by positivity

    have h₆ : 0 < a * b * c := by positivity

      have h₇₂ : b + c ≠ 0 := by linarith

        have h₇₅₂ : b * c = 1 / a := by
          field_simp [h₇₁] at h₇₅₁ ⊢
          nlinarith
        calc
          (b * c : ℝ) ^ 2 = (1 / a : ℝ) ^ 2 := by rw [h₇₅₂]
          _ = 1 / a ^ 2 := by
            field_simp [h₇₁]
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp [h₇₁]
            <;> nlinarith
      calc
        (1 : ℝ) / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) = 1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) := by rfl

    have h₁₀ : (1 : ℝ) / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) = (b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b)) := by

  have h_main : ∃ (a₃ b₃ : ℤ), (a₁^2 + 3 * b₁^2) * (a₂^2 + 3 * b₂^2) = (a₃^2 + 3 * b₃^2) := by

    rw [h₁]
    <;>
    ring_nf
    <;>

theorem poland2016_s1_p8 (a b c : ℤ) : ∃ n : ℤ, n > 0 ∧ ¬ IsSquare (n^3 + a * n^2 + b * n + c) := by 
  have h_main : ∃ (n : ℤ), n > 0 ∧ ¬ IsSquare (n^3 + a * n^2 + b * n + c) := by
    by_cases h₁ : (1 + a + b + c) % 4 = 2 ∨ (1 + a + b + c) % 4 = 3
    · 
      use 1

        norm_num

        have h₂ : (x : ℤ) ^ 2 = 1 + a + b + c := by
          ring_nf at hx ⊢

theorem imo_1964_p1a (n : ℕ) : n ∈ solution_set ↔ 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by 
  have h_forward : n % 3 = 0 → 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : n % 3 = 0 := h
    have h₂ : ∃ k, n = 3 * k := by
      use n / 3
      have h₃ : n % 3 = 0 := h₁
      have h₄ : 3 * (n / 3) = n := by
        have h₅ := Nat.mod_add_div n 3
        omega
      linarith
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h₂
    have h₃ : (2 : ℕ) ^ (3 * k) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
      have h₄ : (2 : ℕ) ^ 3 ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
        norm_num [Nat.ModEq]
      calc
        (2 : ℕ) ^ (3 * k) = ((2 : ℕ) ^ 3) ^ k := by
          rw [pow_mul]
        _ ≡ 1 ^ k [MOD 7] := by
          
          gcongr
          <;> simp_all [Nat.ModEq]
        _ = 1 := by simp
        _ ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
          simp [Nat.ModEq]
    exact h₃
  
  have h_backward : 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] → n % 3 = 0 := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      rw [Nat.ModEq] at h
      exact h
    have h₂ : n % 3 = 0 := by
      have h₃ : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by
        intro n
        rw [← Nat.mod_add_div n 3]
        simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod]
        <;>
        (try decide) <;>
        (try
          {
            have : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
            rcases this with (h | h | h) <;> simp [h, pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod]
            <;> norm_num <;> omega
          })
        <;>
        (try omega)
      have h₄ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := h₃ n
      rw [h₄] at h₁
      have h₅ : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
      rcases h₅ with (h₅ | h₅ | h₅) <;>
      (try
        {
          simp [h₅, pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod] at h₁ ⊢ <;>
          norm_num at h₁ ⊢ <;>
          omega
        })
      <;>
      (try omega)
    exact h₂
  
  have h_main : n ∈ solution_set ↔ 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      have h₁ : n % 3 = 0 := by
        simp only [solution_set, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at h
        exact h
      have h₂ : 2 ^ n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := h_forward h₁
      exact h₂
    · 
      intro h
      have h₁ : n % 3 = 0 := h_backward h
      simp only [solution_set, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      exact h₁
  
  exact h_main

theorem imo1969_p2

      linarith
    have h₆ : 0 ≤ sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by
      apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
    have h₇ : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
    
    set a := x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) with ha

    have h₈ : 0 ≤ a := by
      rw [ha]
      linarith
    have h₉ : 0 ≤ b := by
      rw [hb]
      linarith
    have h₁₀ : 0 ≤ sqrt a := Real.sqrt_nonneg a
    have h₁₁ : 0 ≤ sqrt b := Real.sqrt_nonneg b
    
    have h₁₂ : (sqrt a + sqrt b) ^ 2 = a + b + 2 * Real.sqrt (a * b) := by
      have h₁₂₁ : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt a := Real.sqrt_nonneg a
      have h₁₂₂ : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt b := Real.sqrt_nonneg b

          ring_nf
          <;> nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ a), Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ b)]

          have h₁₂₇ : (Real.sqrt b) ^ 2 = b := by

          rw [h₁₂₆, h₁₂₇]

      rw [ha, hb]

theorem imo2008_p2a (x y z : ℝ) (h : x * y * z = 1) (hx : x ≠ 1) (hy : y ≠ 1) (hz : z ≠ 1) :

      linarith
    have h₃ : y - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h₃
      apply hy
      linarith
    have h₄ : z - 1 ≠ 0 := by

            field_simp [h₂]
            <;> ring

            <;> ring

      have h₅₉ : a * b * c = a * b * c - (a * b + b * c + c * a) + (a + b + c) - 1 := by

def IsGood (x A : ℝ) : Prop :=
  sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = A ∧ 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 ∧
    0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) ∧ 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)

      have h₇₁ : 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by linarith
      have h₇₂ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by linarith
      have h₇₃ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h₇₄ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

    have h₇₆ : b ≠ 0 := h₅

    rw [hsin_eq]

      have h₄₂ : a^2 + b^2 + c^2 + d^2 = 16 - e^2 := by

        _ = 4 * (16 - e^2) := by ring

      have h₅₂ : 0 ≤ (16 : ℝ) / 5 := by norm_num
      have h₅₃ : 5 * e ^ 2 - 16 * e ≤ 0 := by
        nlinarith
      have h₅₄ : e ≤ (16 : ℝ) / 5 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (e - 16 / 5)]
      simpa [max_e] using h₅₄
    exact h₅
  
  have h_achievable : max_e ∈ { e : ℝ | ∃ a b c d : ℝ, IsGood a b c d e } := by
    have h₁ : (6 : ℝ) / 5 + (6 : ℝ) / 5 + (6 : ℝ) / 5 + (6 : ℝ) / 5 + (16 : ℝ) / 5 = 8 := by norm_num

theorem imo1984_p1  (x y z : ℝ)

    0 ≤ x * y + y * z + z * x - 2 * x * y * z ∧ x * y + y * z + z * x - 2 * x * y * z ≤

    have h₂ : 0 ≤ x * y := by nlinarith
    have h₃ : 0 ≤ y * z := by nlinarith
    have h₄ : 0 ≤ z * x := by nlinarith
    have h₅ : 0 ≤ x * y * z := by
      have h₅₁ : 0 ≤ x := by nlinarith
      have h₅₂ : 0 ≤ y := by nlinarith
      have h₅₃ : 0 ≤ z := by nlinarith
      positivity
    have h₆ : 0 ≤ x * y * (1 - z) := by
      have h₆₁ : 0 ≤ x * y := by nlinarith
      have h₆₂ : 1 - z = x + y := by linarith
      have h₆₃ : 0 ≤ x + y := by nlinarith
      have h₆₄ : 0 ≤ 1 - z := by linarith
      nlinarith
    have h₇ : 0 ≤ z * (x + y) := by
      have h₇₁ : 0 ≤ z := by nlinarith
      have h₇₂ : 0 ≤ x + y := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - y), sq_nonneg (y - z), sq_nonneg (z - x)]
  
  have h_upper : x * y + y * z + z * x - 2 * x * y * z ≤ (7:ℝ) / 27 := by
    have h₂ : (x + y + z) ^ 2 = 1 := by

      sq_nonneg (x + y + z), sq_nonneg (x - y + z), sq_nonneg (x + y - z),

  exact ⟨h_lower, h_upper⟩

    (hz : 1 < z)
    (h : 1/x + 1/y + 1/z = 2) :
    √(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1) ≤ √(x + y + z) := by 
  have h₁ : 0 ≤ √(x - 1) := by
    apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
  
  have h₂ : 0 ≤ √(y - 1) := by
    apply Real.sqrt_nonneg

    apply Real.sqrt_nonneg

    apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
  
  have h₅ : (√(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1)) ^ 2 ≤ x + y + z := by
    have h₅₁ : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
    have h₅₂ : 0 ≤ y := by linarith
    have h₅₃ : 0 ≤ z := by linarith
    have h₅₄ : 0 ≤ x * y := by positivity
    have h₅₅ : 0 ≤ x * z := by positivity
    have h₅₆ : 0 ≤ y * z := by positivity
    
    have h₅₇ : (√(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1)) ^ 2 = (√x * √((x - 1) / x) + √y * √((y - 1) / y) + √z * √((z - 1) / z)) ^ 2 := by
      have h₅₇₁ : √(x - 1) = √x * √((x - 1) / x) := by
        have h₅₇₁₁ : 0 < x := by linarith
        have h₅₇₁₂ : 0 ≤ (x - 1) / x := by

          · linarith
          · linarith
        have h₅₇₁₃ : 0 ≤ √x := Real.sqrt_nonneg x
        have h₅₇₁₄ : 0 ≤ √((x - 1) / x) := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((x - 1) / x)
        have h₅₇₁₅ : √x * √((x - 1) / x) = √(x * ((x - 1) / x)) := by

          (try linarith)

          <;> ring_nf
          <;> linarith
        have h₅₇₁₇ : √(x * ((x - 1) / x)) = √(x - 1) := by
          rw [h₅₇₁₆]
        calc
          √(x - 1) = √(x * ((x - 1) / x)) := by rw [h₅₇₁₆]
          _ = √x * √((x - 1) / x) := by
            rw [h₅₇₁₅]
            <;>
            (try positivity) <;>
            (try linarith)
      have h₅₇₂ : √(y - 1) = √y * √((y - 1) / y) := by
        have h₅₇₂₁ : 0 < y := by linarith
        have h₅₇₂₂ : 0 ≤ (y - 1) / y := by
          apply div_nonneg
          · linarith
          · linarith
        have h₅₇₂₃ : 0 ≤ √y := Real.sqrt_nonneg y
        have h₅₇₂₄ : 0 ≤ √((y - 1) / y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((y - 1) / y)
        have h₅₇₂₅ : √y * √((y - 1) / y) = √(y * ((y - 1) / y)) := by
          rw [← Real.sqrt_mul] <;>
          (try positivity) <;>
          (try linarith)
        have h₅₇₂₆ : y * ((y - 1) / y) = y - 1 := by
          field_simp [h₅₇₂₁.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> linarith
        have h₅₇₂₇ : √(y * ((y - 1) / y)) = √(y - 1) := by

        calc

      have h₅₇₃ : √(z - 1) = √z * √((z - 1) / z) := by
        have h₅₇₃₁ : 0 < z := by linarith
        have h₅₇₃₂ : 0 ≤ (z - 1) / z := by

          · linarith
        have h₅₇₃₃ : 0 ≤ √z := Real.sqrt_nonneg z
        have h₅₇₃₄ : 0 ≤ √((z - 1) / z) := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((z - 1) / z)
        have h₅₇₃₅ : √z * √((z - 1) / z) = √(z * ((z - 1) / z)) := by
          rw [← Real.sqrt_mul] <;>
          (try positivity) <;>
          (try linarith)
        have h₅₇₃₆ : z * ((z - 1) / z) = z - 1 := by
          field_simp [h₅₇₃₁.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> linarith
        have h₅₇₃₇ : √(z * ((z - 1) / z)) = √(z - 1) := by
          rw [h₅₇₃₆]
        calc
          √(z - 1) = √(z * ((z - 1) / z)) := by rw [h₅₇₃₆]
          _ = √z * √((z - 1) / z) := by
            rw [h₅₇₃₅]
            <;>
            (try positivity) <;>
            (try linarith)
      calc
        (√(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1)) ^ 2 = (√x * √((x - 1) / x) + √y * √((y - 1) / y) + √z * √((z - 1) / z)) ^ 2 := by
          rw [h₅₇₁, h₅₇₂, h₅₇₃]

          (try ring_nf) <;>
          (try field_simp) <;>

        _ = (√x * √((x - 1) / x) + √y * √((y - 1) / y) + √z * √((z - 1) / z)) ^ 2 := by rfl
    have h₅₈ : (√x * √((x - 1) / x) + √y * √((y - 1) / y) + √z * √((z - 1) / z)) ^ 2 ≤ (x + y + z) * (( (x - 1) / x ) + ( (y - 1) / y ) + ( (z - 1) / z )) := by

      have h₅₈₂ : 0 ≤ √y := Real.sqrt_nonneg y

      have h₅₈₇ : (√x * √((x - 1) / x) + √y * √((y - 1) / y) + √z * √((z - 1) / z)) ^ 2 ≤ ((√x) ^ 2 + (√y) ^ 2 + (√z) ^ 2) * ((√((x - 1) / x)) ^ 2 + (√((y - 1) / y)) ^ 2 + (√((z - 1) / z)) ^ 2) := by

      have h₅₈₈ : ((√x) ^ 2 + (√y) ^ 2 + (√z) ^ 2) = (x + y + z) := by
        have h₅₈₈₁ : (√x) ^ 2 = x := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
        have h₅₈₈₂ : (√y) ^ 2 = y := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
        have h₅₈₈₃ : (√z) ^ 2 = z := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
        linarith
      have h₅₈₉ : ((√((x - 1) / x)) ^ 2 + (√((y - 1) / y)) ^ 2 + (√((z - 1) / z)) ^ 2) = ((x - 1) / x + (y - 1) / y + (z - 1) / z) := by
        have h₅₈₉₁ : (√((x - 1) / x)) ^ 2 = (x - 1) / x := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;>
          (try positivity) <;>
          (try
            {
              apply div_nonneg
              · linarith
              · linarith
            })
        have h₅₈₉₂ : (√((y - 1) / y)) ^ 2 = (y - 1) / y := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;>
          (try positivity) <;>
          (try
            {
              apply div_nonneg
              · linarith
              · linarith
            })
        have h₅₈₉₃ : (√((z - 1) / z)) ^ 2 = (z - 1) / z := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;>
          (try positivity) <;>
          (try
            {
              apply div_nonneg
              · linarith
              · linarith
            })
        linarith
      calc
        (√x * √((x - 1) / x) + √y * √((y - 1) / y) + √z * √((z - 1) / z)) ^ 2 ≤ ((√x) ^ 2 + (√y) ^ 2 + (√z) ^ 2) * ((√((x - 1) / x)) ^ 2 + (√((y - 1) / y)) ^ 2 + (√((z - 1) / z)) ^ 2) := by
          apply h₅₈₇
        _ = (x + y + z) * ((√((x - 1) / x)) ^ 2 + (√((y - 1) / y)) ^ 2 + (√((z - 1) / z)) ^ 2) := by
          rw [h₅₈₈]
        _ = (x + y + z) * ((x - 1) / x + (y - 1) / y + (z - 1) / z) := by
          rw [h₅₈₉]
          <;>
          (try ring_nf)
    have h₅₉ : (x + y + z) * (( (x - 1) / x ) + ( (y - 1) / y ) + ( (z - 1) / z )) = x + y + z := by
      have h₅₉₁ : ( (x - 1) / x ) + ( (y - 1) / y ) + ( (z - 1) / z ) = 1 := by
        have h₅₉₁₁ : ( (x - 1) / x ) + ( (y - 1) / y ) + ( (z - 1) / z ) = 3 - (1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z) := by
          have h₅₉₁₂ : (x - 1) / x = 1 - 1 / x := by
            have h₅₉₁₃ : x ≠ 0 := by linarith
            field_simp [h₅₉₁₃]
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp [h₅₉₁₃]
            <;> linarith
          have h₅₉₁₄ : (y - 1) / y = 1 - 1 / y := by
            have h₅₉₁₅ : y ≠ 0 := by linarith
            field_simp [h₅₉₁₅]
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp [h₅₉₁₅]
            <;> linarith
          have h₅₉₁₆ : (z - 1) / z = 1 - 1 / z := by
            have h₅₉₁₇ : z ≠ 0 := by linarith
            field_simp [h₅₉₁₇]
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp [h₅₉₁₇]
            <;> linarith
          calc
            ( (x - 1) / x ) + ( (y - 1) / y ) + ( (z - 1) / z ) = (1 - 1 / x) + (1 - 1 / y) + (1 - 1 / z) := by
              rw [h₅₉₁₂, h₅₉₁₄, h₅₉₁₆]
            _ = 3 - (1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z) := by ring
        rw [h₅₉₁₁]
        have h₅₉₁₈ : 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z = 2 := by
          have h₅₉₁₉ : 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z = 2 := by
            calc
              1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z = 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z := by rfl
              _ = 2 := by
                have h₅₉₂₀ : 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z = 2 := by
                  
                  have h₅₉₂₁ : 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z = 2 := by
                    calc
                      1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z = 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z := by rfl
                      _ = 2 := by
                        
                        have h₅₉₂₂ : 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z = 2 := by
                          
                          calc
                            1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z = 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z := by rfl
                            _ = 2 := by
                              
                              have h₅₉₂₃ : 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z = 2 := by
                                
                                field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne', hz.ne'] at h ⊢
                                nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hx) (sub_pos.mpr hy),
                                  mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hx) (sub_pos.mpr hz),
                                  mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hy) (sub_pos.mpr hz)]
                              linarith
                        linarith
                  linarith
                linarith
          linarith
        linarith
      calc
        (x + y + z) * (( (x - 1) / x ) + ( (y - 1) / y ) + ( (z - 1) / z )) = (x + y + z) * 1 := by
          rw [h₅₉₁]
        _ = x + y + z := by ring
    calc
      (√(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1)) ^ 2 = (√x * √((x - 1) / x) + √y * √((y - 1) / y) + √z * √((z - 1) / z)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [h₅₇]
      _ ≤ (x + y + z) * (( (x - 1) / x ) + ( (y - 1) / y ) + ( (z - 1) / z )) := by
        apply h₅₈
      _ = x + y + z := by
        rw [h₅₉]
  
  have h₆ : √(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1) ≤ √(x + y + z) := by
    have h₆₁ : 0 ≤ √(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1) := by
      linarith [h₁, h₂, h₃]
    have h₆₂ : 0 ≤ x + y + z := by linarith
    have h₆₃ : 0 ≤ √(x + y + z) := by positivity
    
    have h₆₄ : (√(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1)) ^ 2 ≤ x + y + z := h₅
    have h₆₅ : (√(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1)) ^ 2 ≤ (√(x + y + z)) ^ 2 := by
      have h₆₅₁ : (√(x + y + z)) ^ 2 = x + y + z := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
      linarith
    
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (x + y + z), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x + y + z by linarith)]
  
  apply h₆

@[mk_iff isGood_iff']
structure IsGood (x : ℝ) : Prop where
  
  ineq : 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 < 2 * x + 9
  
  sqrt_dom : 0 ≤ 2 * x + 1
  
  denom_dom : (1 - sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 ≠ 0

abbrev SolutionSet : Set ℝ := Ico (-1/2) (45/8) \ {0}

theorem imo1960_p2 {x} : IsGood x ↔ x ∈ SolutionSet := by 
  have h_main_identity : ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 ≤ 2 * x + 1 → (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 * (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = (2 * x) ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) * (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) = -2 * x := by
      have h2 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1) := Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x + 1)
      have h3 : (Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = 2 * x + 1 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
      nlinarith [h3]
    calc
      (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 * (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = ((1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) * (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1))) ^ 2 := by
        ring_nf
      _ = (-2 * x) ^ 2 := by rw [h1]
      _ = (2 * x) ^ 2 := by ring
  
  have h_forward : IsGood x → x ∈ SolutionSet := by
    intro hx
    have h₁ : 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 < 2 * x + 9 := hx.ineq
    have h₂ : 0 ≤ 2 * x + 1 := hx.sqrt_dom
    have h₃ : (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := hx.denom_dom
    have h₄ : x ≥ -1 / 2 := by
      linarith
    have h₅ : x ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      have h₆ : x = 0 := by tauto
      rw [h₆] at h₃
      have h₇ : (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * (0 : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 = 0 := by
        have h₈ : Real.sqrt (2 * (0 : ℝ) + 1) = 1 := by
          norm_num [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq]
        rw [h₈]
        <;> norm_num
      contradiction
    have h₆ : x < 45 / 8 := by
      have h₇ : x ≠ 0 := h₅
      have h₈ : 0 ≤ 2 * x + 1 := h₂
      have h₉ : (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := h₃
      have h₁₀ : (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h₁₀
        have h₁₁ : (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = 0 := by
          rw [h₁₀]
          <;> norm_num
        contradiction
      have h₁₁ : (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 := by
        have h₁₂ : (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 * (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = (2 * x) ^ 2 := h_main_identity x h₂
        have h₁₃ : (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := h₃
        have h₁₄ : (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = (2 * x) ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 := by
          field_simp [h₁₃] at h₁₂ ⊢
          <;> nlinarith
        have h₁₅ : (2 * x) ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 := by
          ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₁₃]
          <;> ring_nf
        rw [h₁₄, h₁₅]
      have h₁₂ : (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 < 2 * x + 9 := by
        calc
          (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 := by rw [h₁₁]
          _ < 2 * x + 9 := h₁
      have h₁₃ : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h₁₄ : 0 ≤ 2 * x + 1 := h₂
      have h₁₅ : (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = 1 + 2 * Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1) + (2 * x + 1) := by
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ 2 * x + 1)]
      have h₁₆ : 1 + 2 * Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1) + (2 * x + 1) < 2 * x + 9 := by
        linarith
      have h₁₇ : 2 * Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1) < 7 := by linarith
      have h₁₈ : Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1) < 7 / 2 := by linarith
      have h₁₉ : 2 * x + 1 < (7 / 2) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x + 1), Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ 2 * x + 1)]
      nlinarith
    have h₇ : x ∈ SolutionSet := by
      have h₈ : x ∈ Set.Ico (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (45 / 8 : ℝ) := by
        constructor <;> norm_num at h₄ h₆ ⊢ <;>
          (try norm_num) <;>
          (try linarith) <;>
          (try assumption)
      have h₉ : x ≠ 0 := h₅
      have h₁₀ : x ∉ ({0} : Set ℝ) := by
        intro h₁₀
        apply h₉
        simpa using h₁₀
      exact ⟨h₈, h₁₀⟩
    exact h₇
  
  have h_backward : x ∈ SolutionSet → IsGood x := by
    intro hx
    have h₁ : x ∈ Set.Ico (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (45 / 8 : ℝ) := hx.1
    have h₂ : x ∉ ({0} : Set ℝ) := hx.2
    have h₃ : x ≥ -1 / 2 := h₁.1
    have h₄ : x < 45 / 8 := h₁.2
    have h₅ : x ≠ 0 := by
      intro h₅

    have h₆ : 0 ≤ 2 * x + 1 := by
      linarith
    have h₇ : (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      have h₇₁ : 1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h₇₁

          have h₇₄ : Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1) = 1 := h₇₂
          have h₇₅ : 0 ≤ 2 * x + 1 := by linarith
          have h₇₆ : Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1) ^ 2 = 2 * x + 1 := by
            rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
          nlinarith
        have h₇₄ : x = 0 := by linarith
        contradiction
      intro h₇₂
      apply h₇₁
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x + 1)]
    have h₈ : 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 < 2 * x + 9 := by
      have h₈₁ : 0 ≤ 2 * x + 1 := h₆
      have h₈₂ : x ≠ 0 := h₅
      have h₈₃ : (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := h₇
      have h₈₄ : (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h₈₄
        have h₈₅ : (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = 0 := by
          rw [h₈₄]
          <;> norm_num
        contradiction
      have h₈₅ : (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 := by
        have h₈₅₁ : (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 * (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = (2 * x) ^ 2 := h_main_identity x h₆
        have h₈₅₂ : (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := h₇
        have h₈₅₃ : (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = (2 * x) ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 := by
          field_simp [h₈₅₂] at h₈₅₁ ⊢
          <;> nlinarith
        have h₈₅₄ : (2 * x) ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 = 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 := by
          ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₈₅₂]
          <;> ring_nf
        rw [h₈₅₃, h₈₅₄]
      have h₈₆ : (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * x + 1)) ^ 2 < 2 * x + 9 := by

def IsGood (x A : ℝ) : Prop :=
  sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = A ∧ 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 ∧
    0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) ∧ 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)

variable {x A : ℝ}

abbrev solution_set_one : Set ℝ := ∅

theorem imo1959_p2b : IsGood x 1 ↔ x ∈ solution_set_one := by 
  have h_main : IsGood x 1 → False := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = 1 := h.1
    have h₂ : 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 := h.2.1
    have h₃ : 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) := h.2.2.1
    have h₄ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := h.2.2.2
    have h₅ : x ≥ 1 / 2 := by
      linarith
    have h₆ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [h₁]
      <;> norm_num
    have h₇ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = 2 * x + 2 * |x - 1| := by
      have h₇₁ : 0 ≤ sqrt (2 * x - 1) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h₇₂ : 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by linarith
      have h₇₃ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by linarith
      have h₇₄ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h₇₅ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h₇₆ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by positivity
      have h₇₇ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith),
          Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith)]
      have h₇₈ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul] <;> nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x - 1)]
      have h₇₉ : (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = x ^ 2 - (sqrt (2 * x - 1)) ^ 2 := by
        ring_nf
        <;> nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x - 1)]
      have h₇₁₀ : (sqrt (2 * x - 1)) ^ 2 = 2 * x - 1 := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
      have h₇₁₁ : (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = (x - 1) ^ 2 := by
        rw [h₇₉, h₇₁₀]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> nlinarith
      have h₇₁₂ : Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = |x - 1| := by
        rw [h₇₁₁]
        have h₇₁₃ : Real.sqrt ((x - 1) ^ 2) = |x - 1| := by
          rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
        rw [h₇₁₃]
      have h₇₁₃ : 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = 2 * |x - 1| := by
        calc
          2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = 2 * Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
            rw [h₇₈]
          _ = 2 * |x - 1| := by
            rw [h₇₁₂]
          _ = 2 * |x - 1| := by rfl
      calc
        (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
          rw [h₇₇]
        _ = 2 * x + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by ring
        _ = 2 * x + 2 * |x - 1| := by rw [h₇₁₃]
        _ = 2 * x + 2 * |x - 1| := by rfl
    have h₈ : 2 * x + 2 * |x - 1| = 1 := by
      linarith
    
    by_cases h₉ : x ≥ 1
    · 
      have h₁₀ : |x - 1| = x - 1 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg] <;> linarith
      rw [h₁₀] at h₈
      have h₁₁ : 2 * x + 2 * (x - 1) = 1 := by linarith
      have h₁₂ : x = 3 / 4 := by linarith
      linarith
    · 
      have h₁₀ : x < 1 := by linarith
      have h₁₁ : |x - 1| = 1 - x := by
        rw [abs_of_nonpos] <;> linarith
      rw [h₁₁] at h₈
      have h₁₂ : 2 * x + 2 * (1 - x) = 1 := by linarith
      norm_num at h₁₂ ⊢
      <;> linarith
  
  have h_final : IsGood x 1 ↔ x ∈ solution_set_one := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exfalso
      exact h_main h
    · intro h
      exfalso
      simp only [solution_set_one] at h
      exact Set.not_mem_empty x h
  
  exact h_final

  (A: Finset {n | 0 < n ∧ n ≤ 1988 ∧ f n = n}) :
    A.card = solution := by 
  have h_f0_eq_1 : f 0 = 1 := by
    have h₃₀ := h₃ 0

  have h_f0_eq_0 : f 0 = 0 := by
    have h₄₀ := h₄ 0

    have h₄₂ : f 3 + 2 * f 0 = 3 * f 1 := by simpa using h₄₁
    have h₄₃ : 3 + 2 * f 0 = 3 * 1 := by
      rw [h₁] at h₄₂
      rw [h₀] at h₄₂
      simpa [h₁, h₀] using h₄₂
    have h₄₄ : 2 * f 0 = 0 := by
      omega
    have h₄₅ : f 0 = 0 := by

    have h₆ : f 0 = 0 := h_f0_eq_0

    linarith

    have h₂ : Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) = ((a + b + c) / 3) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by
      have h₃ : Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) = ((a + b + c) / 3) * Real.log (a*b*c) := by

    have h₅ : Real.log (a^a * b^b * c^c) ≥ Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) := by

  sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = A ∧ 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 ∧
    0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) ∧ 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)

abbrev solution_set_two : Set ℝ := { 3 / 2 }

theorem imo1959_p2c : IsGood x 2 ↔ x ∈ solution_set_two := by

    constructor
    ·

      have h₄ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := h.2.2.2

        have h₇₁ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        have h₇₂ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        have h₇₃ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by positivity
        calc
          (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 =

          _ = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
            have h₇₄ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by

      have h₈ : 2 * x + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = 4 := by
        linarith
      have h₉ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = 2 - x := by linarith
      
      have h₁₀ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (x - 1) ^ 2 := by
        have h₁₀₁ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        have h₁₀₂ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        have h₁₀₃ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by positivity
        have h₁₀₄ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 =

            _ = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by ring

          have h₁₀₆ : (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = x ^ 2 - (sqrt (2 * x - 1)) ^ 2 := by

          rw [h₁₀₇]

            have h₁₁₁ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = 2 - x := by

        have h₁₂₁ : x - 1 = 2 - x ∨ x - 1 = -(2 - x) := by

          nlinarith
        cases h₁₂₁ with
        | inl h₁₂₁ =>
          
          have h₁₂₂ : x = 3 / 2 := by linarith
          exact h₁₂₂
        | inr h₁₂₁ =>
          
          have h₁₂₂ : False := by linarith
          exfalso
          exact h₁₂₂
      exact h₁₂
    · 
      intro h
      have h₁ : x = 3 / 2 := h
      rw [h₁]
      have h₂ : sqrt ((3 / 2 : ℝ) + sqrt (2 * (3 / 2 : ℝ) - 1)) + sqrt ((3 / 2 : ℝ) - sqrt (2 * (3 / 2 : ℝ) - 1)) = 2 := by

                nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 by norm_num)]),

          have h₁₂ : sqrt ((3 / 2 : ℝ) + Real.sqrt 2) + sqrt ((3 / 2 : ℝ) - Real.sqrt 2) ≥ 0 := by positivity

theorem imo1968_p5a (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (hf : P a f) :
    ∃ b, 0 < b ∧ f.Periodic b := by 
  have h_a_pos : 0 < a := by

    exact h₁

    intro x
    have h₁ : 0 < a := hf.1
    have h₂ : ∀ (x : ℝ), (f x)^2 ≤ f x ∧ f (x + a) = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := hf.2
    have h₃ : (f (x - a))^2 ≤ f (x - a) ∧ f ((x - a) + a) = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f (x - a) - (f (x - a))^2) := h₂ (x - a)
    have h₄ : f ((x - a) + a) = f x := by
      ring_nf
    have h₅ : f x = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f (x - a) - (f (x - a))^2) := by
      linarith [h₃.2]
    have h₆ : 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f (x - a) - (f (x - a))^2) ≥ 1/2 := by
      have h₇ : Real.sqrt (f (x - a) - (f (x - a))^2) ≥ 0 := by
        apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
      linarith
    linarith
  
  have h_f_one : ∀ (x : ℝ), f x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    have h₁ : (f x)^2 ≤ f x := (hf.2 x).1
    have h₂ : 1 / 2 ≤ f x := h_f_half x
    by_contra! h₃
    have h₄ : f x > 1 := by linarith
    have h₅ : (f x)^2 > f x := by
      nlinarith
    linarith
  
  have h_f_periodic : ∀ (x : ℝ), f (x + 2 * a) = f x := by
    intro x
    have h₁ : 0 < a := hf.1
    have h₂ : ∀ (x : ℝ), (f x)^2 ≤ f x ∧ f (x + a) = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := hf.2
    have h₃ : (f x)^2 ≤ f x := (h₂ x).1
    have h₄ : f (x + a) = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := (h₂ x).2
    have h₅ : 1 / 2 ≤ f x := h_f_half x
    have h₆ : f x ≤ 1 := h_f_one x
    have h₇ : 1 / 2 ≤ f (x + a) := h_f_half (x + a)
    have h₈ : f (x + a) ≤ 1 := h_f_one (x + a)
    have h₉ : (f (x + a))^2 ≤ f (x + a) := (h₂ (x + a)).1
    have h₁₀ : f (x + a + a) = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f (x + a) - (f (x + a))^2) := (h₂ (x + a)).2
    have h₁₁ : f (x + 2 * a) = f (x + a + a) := by ring_nf
    rw [h₁₁]
    have h₁₂ : f (x + a + a) = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f (x + a) - (f (x + a))^2) := h₁₀
    rw [h₁₂]
    have h₁₃ : Real.sqrt (f (x + a) - (f (x + a))^2) = (f x - 1 / 2) := by
      have h₁₄ : f (x + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := h₄
      have h₁₅ : Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h₁₆ : f (x + a) - (f (x + a))^2 = (f x - 1 / 2)^2 := by

        have h₁₇ : Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        have h₁₈ : (Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2)) ^ 2 = f x - (f x)^2 := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;>
          (try nlinarith [h₃, h₅, h₆]) <;>
          (try nlinarith [h₃, h₅, h₆]) <;>
          (try nlinarith [h₃, h₅, h₆])
        nlinarith [h₁₈, h₃, h₅, h₆]
      have h₁₉ : Real.sqrt (f (x + a) - (f (x + a))^2) = Real.sqrt ((f x - 1 / 2)^2) := by
        rw [h₁₆]
      rw [h₁₉]

        rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
      rw [h₂₀]
      have h₂₁ : f x - 1 / 2 ≥ 0 := by
        nlinarith [h₅]
      have h₂₂ : |f x - 1 / 2| = f x - 1 / 2 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg h₂₁]
      rw [h₂₂]

      (try nlinarith [h₃, h₅, h₆]) <;>
      (try nlinarith [h₃, h₅, h₆]) <;>
      (try nlinarith [h₃, h₅, h₆])
    rw [h₁₃]

    (try ring_nf at * <;> nlinarith [h₃, h₅, h₆]) <;>
    (try ring_nf at * <;> nlinarith [h₃, h₅, h₆]) <;>
    (try ring_nf at * <;> nlinarith [h₃, h₅, h₆])
  
  have h_main : ∃ (b : ℝ), 0 < b ∧ f.Periodic b := by
    refine' ⟨2 * a, by linarith, _⟩
    intro x
    have h₁ : f (x + 2 * a) = f x := h_f_periodic x
    linarith

theorem imo1959_p1 : ∀ n : ℕ, Nat.Coprime (21 * n + 4) (14 * n + 3) := by 
  intro n
  have h_main : Nat.gcd (21 * n + 4) (14 * n + 3) = 1 := by

      have h₃ : Nat.gcd (21 * n + 4) (14 * n + 3) ∣ 21 * n + 4 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left (21 * n + 4) (14 * n + 3)
      have h₄ : Nat.gcd (21 * n + 4) (14 * n + 3) ∣ 14 * n + 3 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right (21 * n + 4) (14 * n + 3)
      have h₅ : Nat.gcd (21 * n + 4) (14 * n + 3) ∣ 2 * (21 * n + 4) := dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h₃ 2
      have h₆ : Nat.gcd (21 * n + 4) (14 * n + 3) ∣ 3 * (14 * n + 3) := dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h₄ 3
      have h₇ : Nat.gcd (21 * n + 4) (14 * n + 3) ∣ 1 := by

  have h_main : ∃ (a₃ b₃ : ℤ), (a₁^2 + 3 * b₁^2) * (a₂^2 + 3 * b₂^2) = (a₃^2 + 3 * b₃^2) := by

      ring_nf
      <;>
      (try norm_num) <;>
      (try ring_nf at *) <;>
      (try nlinarith) <;>
      (try linarith)
      <;>

    linarith

def IsGood (x A : ℝ) : Prop :=
  sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = A ∧ 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 ∧
    0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) ∧ 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)

variable {x A : ℝ}

abbrev solution_set_one : Set ℝ := ∅

theorem imo1959_p2b : IsGood x 1 ↔ x ∈ solution_set_one := by 
  have h_main : IsGood x 1 → False := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = 1 := h.1
    have h₂ : 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 := h.2.1
    have h₃ : 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) := h.2.2.1
    have h₄ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := h.2.2.2
    have h₅ : x ≥ 1 / 2 := by linarith
    have h₆ : 0 ≤ sqrt (2 * x - 1) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have h₇ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have h₈ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have h₉ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by positivity
    have h₁₀ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [h₁]
      <;> norm_num
    have h₁₁ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = 2 * x + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
      have h₁₂ : 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by linarith
      have h₁₃ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by linarith
      have h₁₄ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h₁₅ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      calc
        (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 =
            (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 + (sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 +
              2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
          ring_nf
          <;>
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith),
            Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith)]
        _ = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
          have h₁₆ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by
            rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
          have h₁₇ : (sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by
            rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
          rw [h₁₆, h₁₇]
          <;> ring_nf
        _ = 2 * x + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by ring
    have h₁₂ : 2 * x + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = 1 := by
      linarith
    have h₁₃ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = (1 - 2 * x) / 2 := by linarith
    have h₁₄ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by

      have h₁₆ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by linarith
      have h₁₇ : 0 ≤ (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by positivity
      have h₁₈ : Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by linarith)]
        <;>
        field_simp [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq] <;>
        ring_nf <;>
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x - 1)]
      linarith
    have h₁₅ : Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = (1 - 2 * x) / 2 := by
      linarith
    have h₁₆ : (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = x ^ 2 - (sqrt (2 * x - 1)) ^ 2 := by
      ring_nf
      <;>
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x - 1)]
    have h₁₇ : x ^ 2 - (sqrt (2 * x - 1)) ^ 2 = x ^ 2 - (2 * x - 1) := by
      have h₁₈ : (sqrt (2 * x - 1)) ^ 2 = 2 * x - 1 := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
      linarith
    have h₁₈ : x ^ 2 - (2 * x - 1) = (x - 1) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h₁₉ : (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = (x - 1) ^ 2 := by
      linarith
    have h₂₀ : Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = Real.sqrt ((x - 1) ^ 2) := by
      rw [h₁₉]
    have h₂₁ : Real.sqrt ((x - 1) ^ 2) = |x - 1| := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
    have h₂₂ : Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = |x - 1| := by
      rw [h₂₀, h₂₁]
    have h₂₃ : |x - 1| = (1 - 2 * x) / 2 := by
      linarith
    have h₂₄ : (1 - 2 * x) / 2 ≥ 0 := by
      have h₂₅ : Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      linarith
    have h₂₅ : x ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
    have h₂₆ : x = 1 / 2 := by linarith
    have h₂₇ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = Real.sqrt 2 := by
      rw [h₂₆]
      have h₂₈ : Real.sqrt (1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) - 1)) = Real.sqrt (1 / 2) := by
        have h₂₉ : Real.sqrt (2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) - 1) = 0 := by

        rw [h₂₉]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> field_simp [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq] <;> ring_nf <;> norm_num
      have h₃₀ : Real.sqrt (1 / 2 - Real.sqrt (2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) - 1)) = Real.sqrt (1 / 2) := by
        have h₃₁ : Real.sqrt (2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) - 1) = 0 := by
          norm_num [Real.sqrt_eq_zero']
        rw [h₃₁]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> field_simp [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq] <;> ring_nf <;> norm_num
      have h₃₂ : Real.sqrt (1 / 2) + Real.sqrt (1 / 2) = Real.sqrt 2 := by
        have h₃₃ : Real.sqrt (1 / 2) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        have h₃₄ : Real.sqrt 2 ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        have h₃₅ : (Real.sqrt (1 / 2) + Real.sqrt (1 / 2)) ^ 2 = 2 := by
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) by norm_num),
            Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
        have h₃₆ : Real.sqrt 2 ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) by norm_num),
          Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
      calc
        Real.sqrt (1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) - 1)) + Real.sqrt (1 / 2 - Real.sqrt (2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) - 1)) =
            Real.sqrt (1 / 2) + Real.sqrt (1 / 2) := by
          rw [h₂₈, h₃₀]
        _ = Real.sqrt 2 := by rw [h₃₂]
    have h₂₈ : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ (1 : ℝ) := by
      norm_num [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq]
    have h₂₉ : False := by
      have h₃₀ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = 1 := h₁
      rw [h₂₇] at h₃₀
      apply h₂₈
      linarith
    exact h₂₉
  
  have h_empty : x ∈ solution_set_one → False := by
    intro h
    simp only [solution_set_one] at h
    exact Set.not_mem_empty x h
  
  have h_final : IsGood x 1 ↔ x ∈ solution_set_one := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exfalso
      exact h_main h
    · intro h
      exfalso
      exact h_empty h
  
  exact h_final

    intro h
    have h₁ : n = 2891 := by simpa using h
    have h₂ : ∃ x y : ℤ, x^3 - 3 * x * y^2 + y^3 = (2891 : ℤ) := by
      obtain ⟨x, y, h₃⟩ := hxy
      use x, y

theorem singapore2019_r1_p7 (x : ℝ) (hx : tan x = 5) :

    have h₂ : tan x = 0 := by
      rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
      rw [h₁]
      <;> simp
    rw [h₂] at hx
    norm_num at hx <;> linarith
  
  have hsin_eq : sin x = 5 * cos x := by
    have h₁ : tan x = sin x / cos x := by
      rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
    rw [h₁] at hx
    have h₂ : sin x / cos x = 5 := by linarith
    have h₃ : sin x = 5 * cos x := by
      field_simp [hcos_ne_zero] at h₂
      linarith
    exact h₃
  
  have hcos_sq : cos x ^ 2 = 1 / 26 := by
    have h₁ : sin x ^ 2 + cos x ^ 2 = 1 := by exact Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq x
    rw [hsin_eq] at h₁
    ring_nf at h₁ ⊢
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hcos_ne_zero]
  
  have hsin2x : sin (2 * x) = 5 / 13 := by
    have h₁ : sin (2 * x) = 2 * sin x * cos x := by
      rw [sin_two_mul]
    rw [h₁]
    rw [hsin_eq]
    have h₂ : cos x ^ 2 = 1 / 26 := hcos_sq
    have h₃ : 2 * (5 * cos x) * cos x = 10 * (cos x ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [h₃]
    rw [h₂]
    <;> ring_nf <;> norm_num <;>
    linarith

      <;> ring_nf
      <;> simp [cos_sq']
      <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₁]
    have h₂ : cos x ^ 2 = 1 / 26 := hcos_sq
    rw [h₂]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> norm_num
    <;> linarith

    <;> field_simp

    <;> linarith

    rfl

theorem imo1969_p2
    (x₁ x₂ : ℝ)
    (n : ℕ)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (h₁ : ∀ x, f x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x)) / (2^i))
    (h₂ : f x₂ = 0)
    (h₃ : f x₁ = 0)
    (h₄: ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 ^ i)) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by 
  have h₅ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using h₄
  
  have h₆ : ∀ (x : ℝ), f x = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x - (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.sin x := by
    intro x
    rw [h₁]
    have h₆₁ : ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i = ∑ i in Finset.range n, ((Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      have h₆₂ : Real.cos (a i + x) = Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x := by
        rw [Real.cos_add]
      rw [h₆₂]
      <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₆₁]
    have h₆₃ : ∑ i in Finset.range n, ((Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i = (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x - (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.sin x := by
      calc
        ∑ i in Finset.range n, ((Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i = ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x / (2 : ℝ) ^ i - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x / (2 : ℝ) ^ i : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring_nf
          <;> field_simp
          <;> ring_nf
        _ = ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x / (2 : ℝ) ^ i : ℝ) - ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x / (2 : ℝ) ^ i : ℝ) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        _ = (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x - (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.sin x := by
          have h₆₄ : ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x / (2 : ℝ) ^ i : ℝ) = (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x := by
            calc
              ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x / (2 : ℝ) ^ i : ℝ) = ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.cos x : ℝ) := by
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro i _
                ring_nf
              _ = (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x := by
                rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          have h₆₅ : ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x / (2 : ℝ) ^ i : ℝ) = (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.sin x := by
            calc
              ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x / (2 : ℝ) ^ i : ℝ) = ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.sin x : ℝ) := by
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro i _
                ring_nf
              _ = (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.sin x := by
                rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          rw [h₆₄, h₆₅]
          <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₆₃]
    <;> simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
    <;> ring_nf
  
  set A := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) with hA_def
  set B := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) with hB_def
  have h₇ : A ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [hA_def] using h₅
  
  have h₈ : ∀ (x : ℝ), f x = A * Real.cos x - B * Real.sin x := by
    intro x
    rw [h₆]
    <;> simp [hA_def, hB_def]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> simp_all
    <;> field_simp
    <;> ring_nf
  
  have h₉ : A * Real.cos x₁ = B * Real.sin x₁ := by
    have h₉₁ : f x₁ = 0 := h₃
    have h₉₂ : f x₁ = A * Real.cos x₁ - B * Real.sin x₁ := by
      rw [h₈]
    rw [h₉₂] at h₉₁
    have h₉₃ : A * Real.cos x₁ - B * Real.sin x₁ = 0 := by linarith
    linarith
  
  have h₁₀ : A * Real.cos x₂ = B * Real.sin x₂ := by
    have h₁₀₁ : f x₂ = 0 := h₂
    have h₁₀₂ : f x₂ = A * Real.cos x₂ - B * Real.sin x₂ := by
      rw [h₈]
    rw [h₁₀₂] at h₁₀₁
    have h₁₀₃ : A * Real.cos x₂ - B * Real.sin x₂ = 0 := by linarith
    linarith
  
  have h₁₁ : A * Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
    have h₁₁₁ : A * Real.cos x₁ = B * Real.sin x₁ := h₉
    have h₁₁₂ : A * Real.cos x₂ = B * Real.sin x₂ := h₁₀
    have h₁₁₃ : A * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) = 0 := by
      calc
        A * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) = A * Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - A * Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁ := by ring
        _ = B * Real.sin x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - B * Real.sin x₂ * Real.sin x₁ := by
          have h₁₁₄ : A * Real.cos x₁ = B * Real.sin x₁ := h₉
          have h₁₁₅ : A * Real.cos x₂ = B * Real.sin x₂ := h₁₀
          calc
            A * Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - A * Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁ = (B * Real.sin x₁) * Real.sin x₂ - (B * Real.sin x₂) * Real.sin x₁ := by
              rw [h₁₁₄, h₁₁₅]
              <;> ring
            _ = B * Real.sin x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - B * Real.sin x₂ * Real.sin x₁ := by ring
        _ = 0 := by ring
    have h₁₁₄ : Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁ = Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) := by
      have h₁₁₅ : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = Real.sin x₂ * Real.cos x₁ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁ := by
        rw [Real.sin_sub]
        <;> ring
      linarith [Real.sin_sub x₂ x₁]
    calc
      A * Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = A * (Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ - Real.cos x₂ * Real.sin x₁) := by rw [h₁₁₄]
      _ = 0 := by rw [h₁₁₃]
      _ = 0 := by ring
  
  have h₁₂ : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
    have h₁₂₁ : A * Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := h₁₁
    have h₁₂₂ : A ≠ 0 := h₇
    have h₁₂₃ : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ h₁₂₂
      linarith
    exact h₁₂₃
  
  have h₁₃ : ∃ m : ℤ, x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by
    have h₁₃₁ : Real.sin (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := h₁₂
    have h₁₃₂ : ∃ m : ℤ, x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by
      
      have h₁₃₃ : ∃ (m : ℤ), x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by
        
        rw [Real.sin_eq_zero_iff] at h₁₃₁
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h₁₃₁
        refine' ⟨m, _⟩
        linarith
      exact h₁₃₃
    exact h₁₃₂
  
  exact h₁₃

      intro h

            <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]

theorem imo1971_p5 (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ S : Set Pt, S.Finite ∧ ∀ s ∈ S, Nat.card {t | dist s t = 1} = m := by 
  have h_main : ∃ (S : Set Pt), S.Finite ∧ ∀ (s : Pt), s ∈ S → Nat.card {t | dist s t = 1} = m := by
    refine' ⟨∅, Set.finite_empty, _⟩
    intro s hs
    
    exfalso
    exact Set.not_mem_empty s hs
  
  obtain ⟨S, hS_fin, hS⟩ := h_main
  refine' ⟨S, hS_fin, _⟩
  intro s hs
  have h := hS s hs
  exact h

theorem imo1995_p2 (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (habc : a * b * c = 1) :
    3 / 2 ≤ 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) := by 
  have h₁ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) = (b * c)^2 / (a * (b + c)) := by
    have h₁₁ : a ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h₁₂ : b + c ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h₁₃ : a ^ 3 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h₁₄ : a * (b + c) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h₁₅ : (a * b * c) = 1 := habc
    have h₁₆ : (b * c) = 1 / a := by
      have h₁₆₁ : a * (b * c) = 1 := by
        calc
          a * (b * c) = a * b * c := by ring
          _ = 1 := habc
      field_simp at h₁₆₁ ⊢
      nlinarith
    have h₁₇ : (b * c) ^ 2 = (1 / a) ^ 2 := by rw [h₁₆]
    have h₁₈ : (a : ℝ) > 0 := ha
    have h₁₉ : (b : ℝ) > 0 := hb
    have h₂₀ : (c : ℝ) > 0 := hc
    calc
      1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) = (1 : ℝ) / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) := by norm_num
      _ = (1 : ℝ) / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) := by rfl
      _ = (b * c) ^ 3 / (b + c) := by
        have h₂₁ : (b * c) ^ 3 = 1 / a ^ 3 := by
          calc
            (b * c) ^ 3 = (1 / a) ^ 3 := by
              rw [h₁₆]
            _ = 1 / a ^ 3 := by
              field_simp [h₁₁]
              <;> ring_nf
              <;> field_simp [h₁₁]
              <;> nlinarith
        calc
          (1 : ℝ) / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) = (1 : ℝ) / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) := by rfl
          _ = (1 / a ^ 3) / (b + c) := by
            field_simp [h₁₃, h₁₂]
            <;> ring_nf
          _ = (b * c) ^ 3 / (b + c) := by
            rw [h₂₁]
            <;> field_simp [h₁₂]
            <;> ring_nf
      _ = (b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) := by
        have h₂₂ : (b * c) ^ 3 / (b + c) = (b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) := by
          have h₂₃ : (b * c) = 1 / a := by
            rw [h₁₆]
          calc
            (b * c) ^ 3 / (b + c) = (b * c) ^ 2 * (b * c) / (b + c) := by ring
            _ = (b * c) ^ 2 * (1 / a) / (b + c) := by rw [h₂₃]
            _ = (b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) := by
              field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
              <;> ring_nf
              <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
              <;> nlinarith
        rw [h₂₂]
        <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
        <;> nlinarith
  
  have h₂ : 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) = (a * c)^2 / (b * (c + a)) := by
    have h₂₁ : b ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h₂₂ : c + a ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h₂₃ : b ^ 3 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h₂₄ : b * (c + a) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h₂₅ : (a * b * c) = 1 := habc
    have h₂₆ : (a * c) = 1 / b := by
      have h₂₆₁ : b * (a * c) = 1 := by
        calc
          b * (a * c) = a * b * c := by ring
          _ = 1 := habc
      field_simp at h₂₆₁ ⊢
      nlinarith
    have h₂₇ : (a * c) ^ 2 = (1 / b) ^ 2 := by rw [h₂₆]
    have h₂₈ : (a : ℝ) > 0 := ha
    have h₂₉ : (b : ℝ) > 0 := hb
    have h₃₀ : (c : ℝ) > 0 := hc
    calc
      1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) = (1 : ℝ) / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) := by norm_num
      _ = (1 : ℝ) / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) := by rfl
      _ = (a * c) ^ 3 / (c + a) := by
        have h₃₁ : (a * c) ^ 3 = 1 / b ^ 3 := by
          calc
            (a * c) ^ 3 = (1 / b) ^ 3 := by
              rw [h₂₆]
            _ = 1 / b ^ 3 := by
              field_simp [h₂₁]
              <;> ring_nf
              <;> field_simp [h₂₁]
              <;> nlinarith
        calc
          (1 : ℝ) / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) = (1 : ℝ) / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) := by rfl
          _ = (1 / b ^ 3) / (c + a) := by
            field_simp [h₂₃, h₂₂]
            <;> ring_nf
          _ = (a * c) ^ 3 / (c + a) := by
            rw [h₃₁]
            <;> field_simp [h₂₂]
            <;> ring_nf
      _ = (a * c) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) := by
        have h₃₂ : (a * c) ^ 3 / (c + a) = (a * c) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) := by
          have h₃₃ : (a * c) = 1 / b := by
            rw [h₂₆]
          calc
            (a * c) ^ 3 / (c + a) = (a * c) ^ 2 * (a * c) / (c + a) := by ring
            _ = (a * c) ^ 2 * (1 / b) / (c + a) := by rw [h₃₃]
            _ = (a * c) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) := by
              field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
              <;> ring_nf
              <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
              <;> nlinarith
        rw [h₃₂]
        <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
        <;> nlinarith
  
  have h₃ : 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) = (a * b)^2 / (c * (a + b)) := by
    have h₃₁ : c ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h₃₂ : a + b ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h₃₃ : c ^ 3 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h₃₄ : c * (a + b) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h₃₅ : (a * b * c) = 1 := habc
    have h₃₆ : (a * b) = 1 / c := by
      have h₃₆₁ : c * (a * b) = 1 := by
        calc
          c * (a * b) = a * b * c := by ring
          _ = 1 := habc
      field_simp at h₃₆₁ ⊢
      nlinarith
    have h₃₇ : (a * b) ^ 2 = (1 / c) ^ 2 := by rw [h₃₆]
    have h₃₈ : (a : ℝ) > 0 := ha
    have h₃₉ : (b : ℝ) > 0 := hb
    have h₄₀ : (c : ℝ) > 0 := hc
    calc
      1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) = (1 : ℝ) / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) := by norm_num
      _ = (1 : ℝ) / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) := by rfl
      _ = (a * b) ^ 3 / (a + b) := by
        have h₄₁ : (a * b) ^ 3 = 1 / c ^ 3 := by
          calc
            (a * b) ^ 3 = (1 / c) ^ 3 := by
              rw [h₃₆]
            _ = 1 / c ^ 3 := by
              field_simp [h₃₁]
              <;> ring_nf
              <;> field_simp [h₃₁]
              <;> nlinarith
        calc
          (1 : ℝ) / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) = (1 : ℝ) / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) := by rfl
          _ = (1 / c ^ 3) / (a + b) := by
            field_simp [h₃₃, h₃₂]
            <;> ring_nf
          _ = (a * b) ^ 3 / (a + b) := by
            rw [h₄₁]
            <;> field_simp [h₃₂]
            <;> ring_nf
      _ = (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b)) := by
        have h₄₂ : (a * b) ^ 3 / (a + b) = (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b)) := by
          have h₄₃ : (a * b) = 1 / c := by
            rw [h₃₆]
          calc
            (a * b) ^ 3 / (a + b) = (a * b) ^ 2 * (a * b) / (a + b) := by ring
            _ = (a * b) ^ 2 * (1 / c) / (a + b) := by rw [h₄₃]
            _ = (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b)) := by
              field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
              <;> ring_nf
              <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
              <;> nlinarith
        rw [h₄₂]
        <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
        <;> nlinarith
  
  have h₄ : (b * c)^2 / (a * (b + c)) + (a * c)^2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b)^2 / (c * (a + b)) ≥ (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 := by
    have h₄₁ : 0 < a * b := by positivity
    have h₄₂ : 0 < b * c := by positivity
    have h₄₃ : 0 < c * a := by positivity
    have h₄₄ : 0 < a * b * (b * c) := by positivity
    have h₄₅ : 0 < a * b * (c * a) := by positivity
    have h₄₆ : 0 < b * c * (c * a) := by positivity
    have h₄₇ : 0 < a * (b + c) := by positivity
    have h₄₈ : 0 < b * (c + a) := by positivity
    have h₄₉ : 0 < c * (a + b) := by positivity
    
    have h₅₀ : (b * c)^2 / (a * (b + c)) + (a * c)^2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b)^2 / (c * (a + b)) ≥ (a * b + b * c + c * a)^2 / (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) := by
      
      have h₅₁ : 0 < a * (b + c) := by positivity
      have h₅₂ : 0 < b * (c + a) := by positivity
      have h₅₃ : 0 < c * (a + b) := by positivity
      have h₅₄ : 0 < a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b) := by positivity
      
      have h₅₅ : 0 ≤ (b * c)^2 := by positivity
      have h₅₆ : 0 ≤ (a * c)^2 := by positivity
      have h₅₇ : 0 ≤ (a * b)^2 := by positivity
      
      have h₅₈ : (b * c)^2 / (a * (b + c)) + (a * c)^2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b)^2 / (c * (a + b)) ≥ (a * b + b * c + c * a)^2 / (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) := by
        
        field_simp [h₅₁.ne', h₅₂.ne', h₅₃.ne']
        rw [div_le_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b * c * (b * (c + a)) - a * c * (a * (b + c))),
          sq_nonneg (a * c * (c * (a + b)) - a * b * (b * (c + a))),
          sq_nonneg (a * b * (a * (b + c)) - b * c * (c * (a + b)))]
      
      linarith
    
    have h₅₁ : (a * b + b * c + c * a)^2 / (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) = (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 := by
      have h₅₂ : a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b) = 2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a) := by
        ring
      rw [h₅₂]
      have h₅₃ : (a * b + b * c + c * a) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [h₅₃]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [h₅₃]
      <;> nlinarith
    
    linarith
  
  have h₅ : a * b + b * c + c * a ≥ 3 := by
    have h₅₁ : 0 < a * b := by positivity
    have h₅₂ : 0 < b * c := by positivity
    have h₅₃ : 0 < c * a := by positivity
    have h₅₄ : a * b * (b * c) * (c * a) = 1 := by
      calc
        a * b * (b * c) * (c * a) = (a * b * c) * (a * b * c) := by ring
        _ = 1 * 1 := by rw [habc]
        _ = 1 := by ring
    have h₅₅ : a * b + b * c + c * a ≥ 3 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a * b - b * c), sq_nonneg (b * c - c * a), sq_nonneg (c * a - a * b),
        mul_pos h₅₁ h₅₂, mul_pos h₅₂ h₅₃, mul_pos h₅₃ h₅₁]
    exact h₅₅
  
  have h₆ : (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 ≥ 3 / 2 := by
    linarith
  
  have h₇ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) ≥ 3 / 2 := by
    calc
      1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) = (b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (a * c) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b)) := by
        rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
        <;> ring_nf
      _ ≥ (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 := by
        exact h₄
      _ ≥ 3 / 2 := by
        linarith
  
  linarith

theorem india1998_p1a (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℤ) :
    (∃ a₃ b₃, (a₁^2 + 3 * b₁^2) * (a₂^2 + 3 * b₂^2) = (a₃^2 + 3 * b₃^2)) := by 
  have h_main : ∃ (a₃ b₃ : ℤ), (a₁^2 + 3 * b₁^2) * (a₂^2 + 3 * b₂^2) = (a₃^2 + 3 * b₃^2) := by
    use a₁ * a₂ - 3 * b₁ * b₂, a₁ * b₂ + a₂ * b₁
    have h₁ : (a₁^2 + 3 * b₁^2) * (a₂^2 + 3 * b₂^2) = (a₁ * a₂ - 3 * b₁ * b₂)^2 + 3 * (a₁ * b₂ + a₂ * b₁)^2 := by
      ring_nf
      <;>
      (try norm_num) <;>
      (try ring_nf) <;>
      (try nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a₁ * a₂ - 3 * b₁ * b₂), sq_nonneg (a₁ * b₂ + a₂ * b₁)])
    rw [h₁]
    <;>
    ring_nf
    <;>
    (try norm_num)
    <;>
    (try nlinarith)
  
  exact h_main

theorem singapore2019_r1_p11 : 448 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) / Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) = solution := by 
  have h₁ : 2 * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.cos (12 * Real.pi / 180) := by
    have h₁₁ : 2 * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180 - 51 * Real.pi / 180) - Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180 + 51 * Real.pi / 180) := by
      have h₁₁₁ : 2 * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180 - 51 * Real.pi / 180) - Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180 + 51 * Real.pi / 180) := by
        have h₁₁₂ : Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180 - 51 * Real.pi / 180) - Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180 + 51 * Real.pi / 180) = 2 * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) := by
          have h₁₁₃ : Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180 - 51 * Real.pi / 180) - Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180 + 51 * Real.pi / 180) = 2 * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) := by
            rw [Real.cos_sub, Real.cos_add]
            ring_nf
            <;> simp [Real.sin_add, Real.sin_sub]
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> linarith [Real.sin_le_one (39 * Real.pi / 180), Real.sin_le_one (51 * Real.pi / 180),
              Real.cos_le_one (39 * Real.pi / 180), Real.cos_le_one (51 * Real.pi / 180)]
          linarith
        linarith
      linarith
    have h₁₂ : Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180 - 51 * Real.pi / 180) - Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180 + 51 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.cos (12 * Real.pi / 180) := by
      have h₁₂₁ : Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180 - 51 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.cos (-(12 * Real.pi / 180)) := by
        ring_nf
        <;> field_simp
        <;> ring_nf
      have h₁₂₂ : Real.cos (39 * Real.pi / 180 + 51 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.cos (90 * Real.pi / 180) := by
        ring_nf
        <;> field_simp
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₁₂₁, h₁₂₂]
      have h₁₂₃ : Real.cos (-(12 * Real.pi / 180)) = Real.cos (12 * Real.pi / 180) := by
        rw [← Real.cos_neg]
        <;> ring_nf
      have h₁₂₄ : Real.cos (90 * Real.pi / 180) = 0 := by
        have h₁₂₅ : Real.cos (90 * Real.pi / 180) = 0 := by
          rw [show (90 : ℝ) * Real.pi / 180 = Real.pi / 2 by ring]
          norm_num [Real.cos_pi_div_two]
        rw [h₁₂₅]
      rw [h₁₂₃, h₁₂₄]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> norm_num
    linarith
  
  have h₂ : 4 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) := by
    have h₂₁ : 4 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) = 2 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * (2 * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180)) := by ring
    rw [h₂₁]
    have h₂₂ : 2 * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.cos (12 * Real.pi / 180) := h₁
    rw [h₂₂]
    have h₂₃ : 2 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (12 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) := by
      have h₂₃₁ : Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (2 * (12 * Real.pi / 180)) := by ring
      rw [h₂₃₁]
      have h₂₃₂ : Real.sin (2 * (12 * Real.pi / 180)) = 2 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (12 * Real.pi / 180) := by
        rw [Real.sin_two_mul]
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₂₃₂]
      <;> ring_nf
    linarith
  
  have h₃ : Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) ≠ 0 := by
    have h₃₁ : 0 < 24 * Real.pi / 180 := by
      have h₃₂ : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
      positivity
    have h₃₂ : 24 * Real.pi / 180 < Real.pi := by
      have h₃₃ : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
      have h₃₄ : 24 * Real.pi / 180 < Real.pi := by
        have h₃₅ : (24 : ℝ) / 180 < 1 := by norm_num
        have h₃₆ : 24 * Real.pi / 180 < Real.pi := by
          nlinarith [Real.pi_pos, Real.pi_gt_three]
        exact h₃₆
      exact h₃₄
    have h₃₃ : Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) > 0 := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi h₃₁ h₃₂
    linarith
  
  have h₄ : 448 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) = 112 * Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) := by
    have h₄₁ : 4 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) := h₂
    have h₄₂ : 448 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) = 112 * (4 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180)) := by ring
    rw [h₄₂]
    rw [h₄₁]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> field_simp at *
    <;> nlinarith [Real.sin_le_one (24 * Real.pi / 180), Real.sin_le_one (12 * Real.pi / 180),
      Real.sin_le_one (39 * Real.pi / 180), Real.sin_le_one (51 * Real.pi / 180)]
  
  have h₅ : 448 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) / Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) = 112 := by
    have h₅₁ : 448 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) = 112 * Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) := h₄
    have h₅₂ : Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) ≠ 0 := h₃
    calc
      448 * Real.sin (12 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (39 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.sin (51 * Real.pi / 180) / Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180)
        = (112 * Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180)) / Real.sin (24 * Real.pi / 180) := by rw [h₅₁]
      _ = 112 := by
        field_simp [h₅₂]
        <;> ring_nf

def IsGood (x A : ℝ) : Prop :=
  sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = A ∧ 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 ∧
    0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) ∧ 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)

variable {x A : ℝ}

abbrev solution_set_one : Set ℝ := ∅

theorem imo1959_p2b : IsGood x 1 ↔ x ∈ solution_set_one := by 
  have h_main : ¬IsGood x 1 := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = 1 := h.1
    have h₂ : 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 := h.2.1
    have h₃ : 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) := h.2.2.1
    have h₄ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := h.2.2.2
    have h₅ : x ≥ 1 / 2 := by
      linarith
    
    have h₆ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by linarith
    
    have h₇ : 0 ≤ sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by
      apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
    have h₈ : 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by linarith
    have h₉ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by linarith
    
    have h₁₀ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = 2 * x + 2 * |x - 1| := by
      have h₁₀₁ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h₁₀₂ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h₁₀₃ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by positivity
      have h₁₀₄ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith),
          Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith)]
      have h₁₀₅ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul] <;> nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x - 1), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 by linarith)]
      have h₁₀₆ : (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = (x - 1) ^ 2 := by
        have h₁₀₇ : (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = x ^ 2 - (sqrt (2 * x - 1)) ^ 2 := by
          ring_nf
          <;> nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x - 1), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 by linarith)]
        have h₁₀₈ : (sqrt (2 * x - 1)) ^ 2 = 2 * x - 1 := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
        rw [h₁₀₇, h₁₀₈]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> nlinarith
      have h₁₀₉ : Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = |x - 1| := by
        rw [h₁₀₆]
        have h₁₁₀ : Real.sqrt ((x - 1) ^ 2) = |x - 1| := by
          rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
        rw [h₁₁₀]
      calc
        (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by rw [h₁₀₄]
        _ = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by rw [h₁₀₅]
        _ = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * |x - 1| := by rw [h₁₀₉]
        _ = 2 * x + 2 * |x - 1| := by ring_nf <;> linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x - 1)]
    
    have h₁₁ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 ≥ 2 := by
      have h₁₁₁ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = 2 * x + 2 * |x - 1| := by rw [h₁₀]
      rw [h₁₁₁]
      cases' le_or_lt 0 (x - 1) with h₁₁₂ h₁₁₂
      · 
        have h₁₁₃ : |x - 1| = x - 1 := by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg h₁₁₂]
        rw [h₁₁₃]
        nlinarith [h₅]
      · 
        have h₁₁₃ : |x - 1| = -(x - 1) := by
          rw [abs_of_neg h₁₁₂]
          <;> linarith
        rw [h₁₁₃]
        nlinarith [h₅]
    
    have h₁₂ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [h₁]
      <;> norm_num
    have h₁₃ : (1 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
    linarith
  
  have h_final : IsGood x 1 ↔ x ∈ solution_set_one := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exfalso
      exact h_main h
    · intro h
      exfalso
      simp only [solution_set_one] at h
      exact Set.not_mem_empty x h
  
  exact h_final

    have h₅ : Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have h₆ : f (x + a) = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := h₃

      have h₈ : f (x + a) - (f (x + a))^2 = (1/2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2)) - (1/2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2))^2 := by

        <;>

      linarith
    exact h₇

    intro x
    have h₁ : f (x + a) - (f (x + a))^2 = (f x - 1 / 2)^2 := h_square_identity x

def IsGood (x A : ℝ) : Prop :=
  sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = A ∧ 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 ∧
    0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) ∧ 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)

variable {x A : ℝ}

abbrev solution_set_one : Set ℝ := ∅

theorem imo1959_p2b : IsGood x 1 ↔ x ∈ solution_set_one := by 
  have h_main : IsGood x 1 → False := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = 1 := h.1
    have h₂ : 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 := h.2.1
    have h₃ : 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) := h.2.2.1
    have h₄ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := h.2.2.2
    have h₅ : x ≥ 1 / 2 := by linarith
    have h₆ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [h₁]
      <;> norm_num
    have h₇ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = 2 * x + 2 * |x - 1| := by
      have h₇₁ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h₇₂ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h₇₃ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by positivity
      have h₇₄ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith),
          Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith)]
      have h₇₅ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul] <;> nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x - 1), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 by linarith)]
      have h₇₆ : (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = (x - 1) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 by linarith)]
      have h₇₇ : Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = |x - 1| := by
        rw [h₇₆]
        rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
      calc
        (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by rw [h₇₄]
        _ = 2 * x + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by ring
        _ = 2 * x + 2 * Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by rw [h₇₅]
        _ = 2 * x + 2 * |x - 1| := by rw [h₇₇]
    have h₈ : 2 * x + 2 * |x - 1| = 1 := by
      linarith
    have h₉ : x = 1 := by
      cases' le_or_lt 0 (x - 1) with h₉₁ h₉₁
      · 
        have h₉₂ : |x - 1| = x - 1 := by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg h₉₁]
        rw [h₉₂] at h₈
        have h₉₃ : 2 * x + 2 * (x - 1) = 1 := by linarith
        have h₉₄ : x ≥ 1 := by linarith
        have h₉₅ : 2 * x ≥ 2 := by linarith
        nlinarith
      · 
        have h₉₂ : |x - 1| = -(x - 1) := by
          rw [abs_of_neg h₉₁]
          <;> linarith
        rw [h₉₂] at h₈
        have h₉₃ : 2 * x + 2 * (-(x - 1)) = 1 := by linarith
        have h₉₄ : x < 1 := by linarith
        have h₉₅ : 2 * x ≥ 1 := by linarith
        nlinarith
    have h₁₀ : x = 1 := h₉
    rw [h₁₀] at h₈
    norm_num [abs_of_nonneg] at h₈
    <;> linarith
  
  have h_imp : IsGood x 1 ↔ x ∈ solution_set_one := by
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      exfalso
      exact h_main h
    · 
      intro h
      exfalso
      
      simp only [solution_set_one] at h
      exact Set.not_mem_empty x h
  
  exact h_imp
