theorem imo_1964_p1a (n : ℕ) : n ∈ solution_set ↔ 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by 
  have h_forward : n % 3 = 0 → 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : n % 3 = 0 := h
    have h₂ : ∃ k, n = 3 * k := by
      use n / 3
      have h₃ : n % 3 = 0 := h₁
      have h₄ : 3 * (n / 3) = n := by
        have h₅ := Nat.div_add_mod n 3
        omega
      linarith
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h₂
    have h₃ : (2 : ℕ) ^ (3 * k) % 7 = 1 := by
      have h₄ : ∀ k : ℕ, (2 : ℕ) ^ (3 * k) % 7 = 1 := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero => norm_num
        | succ k ih =>
          simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, ih]
          <;> norm_num <;> omega
      exact h₄ k
    simp [Nat.ModEq, h₃]
    <;> norm_num
  
  have h_backward : 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] → n % 3 = 0 := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      rw [Nat.ModEq] at h
      exact h
    have h₂ : n % 3 = 0 := by
      have h₃ : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
      rcases h₃ with (h₃ | h₃ | h₃)
      · 
        exact h₃
      · 
        have h₄ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 := by
          have h₅ : ∀ k : ℕ, (2 : ℕ) ^ (3 * k + 1) % 7 = 2 := by
            intro k
            induction k with
            | zero => norm_num
            | succ k ih =>
              simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, ih]
              <;> norm_num <;> omega
          have h₆ : ∃ k, n = 3 * k + 1 := by
            use n / 3
            have h₇ : n % 3 = 1 := h₃
            have h₈ : 3 * (n / 3) + 1 = n := by
              have h₉ := Nat.div_add_mod n 3
              omega
            linarith
          obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h₆
          exact h₅ k
        omega
      · 
        have h₄ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 4 := by
          have h₅ : ∀ k : ℕ, (2 : ℕ) ^ (3 * k + 2) % 7 = 4 := by
            intro k
            induction k with
            | zero => norm_num
            | succ k ih =>
              simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, ih]
              <;> norm_num <;> omega
          have h₆ : ∃ k, n = 3 * k + 2 := by
            use n / 3
            have h₇ : n % 3 = 2 := h₃
            have h₈ : 3 * (n / 3) + 2 = n := by
              have h₉ := Nat.div_add_mod n 3
              omega
            linarith
          obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h₆
          exact h₅ k
        omega
    exact h₂
  
  have h_main : n ∈ solution_set ↔ 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
    simp only [solution_set, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      exact h_forward h
    · 
      intro h
      exact h_backward h
  
  exact h_main

theorem imo2000_p2 (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (habc : a * b * c = 1) :
    (a - 1 + 1 / b) * (b - 1 + 1 / c) * (c - 1 + 1 / a) ≤ 1 := by 
  have h_main : ∀ (x y z : ℝ), 0 < x → 0 < y → 0 < z → (x + y - z) * (x + z - y) * (y + z - x) ≤ x * y * z := by
    intro x y z hx hy hz
    have h₁ : 0 ≤ x * y := by positivity
    have h₂ : 0 ≤ y * z := by positivity
    have h₃ : 0 ≤ z * x := by positivity
    have h₄ : 0 ≤ x * y * z := by positivity
    
    by_cases h₅ : (x + y - z) ≤ 0
    · have h₅₁ : (x + y - z) * (x + z - y) * (y + z - x) ≤ 0 := by
        
        have h₅₂ : 0 < x + z - y := by linarith
        have h₅₃ : 0 < y + z - x := by linarith
        have h₅₄ : (x + y - z) ≤ 0 := h₅
        have h₅₅ : (x + y - z) * (x + z - y) ≤ 0 := by
          nlinarith
        nlinarith
      have h₅₆ : 0 ≤ x * y * z := by positivity
      nlinarith
    · by_cases h₆ : (x + z - y) ≤ 0
      · have h₆₁ : (x + y - z) * (x + z - y) * (y + z - x) ≤ 0 := by
          
          have h₆₂ : 0 < x + y - z := by linarith
          have h₆₃ : 0 < y + z - x := by linarith
          have h₆₄ : (x + z - y) ≤ 0 := h₆
          have h₆₅ : (x + y - z) * (x + z - y) ≤ 0 := by
            nlinarith
          nlinarith
        have h₆₆ : 0 ≤ x * y * z := by positivity
        nlinarith
      · by_cases h₇ : (y + z - x) ≤ 0
        · have h₇₁ : (x + y - z) * (x + z - y) * (y + z - x) ≤ 0 := by
            
            have h₇₂ : 0 < x + y - z := by linarith
            have h₇₃ : 0 < x + z - y := by linarith
            have h₇₄ : (y + z - x) ≤ 0 := h₇
            have h₇₅ : (x + y - z) * (x + z - y) > 0 := by
              nlinarith
            nlinarith
          have h₇₆ : 0 ≤ x * y * z := by positivity
          nlinarith
        · 
          have h₈ : 0 < x + y - z := by linarith
          have h₉ : 0 < x + z - y := by linarith
          have h₁₀ : 0 < y + z - x := by linarith
          have h₁₁ : 0 < (x + y - z) * (x + z - y) := by positivity
          have h₁₂ : 0 < (x + y - z) * (x + z - y) * (y + z - x) := by positivity
          
          have h₁₃ : (x + y - z) * (x + z - y) * (y + z - x) ≤ x * y * z := by
            nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - y), sq_nonneg (y - z), sq_nonneg (z - x),
              sq_nonneg (x + y - z), sq_nonneg (x + z - y), sq_nonneg (y + z - x),
              mul_nonneg hx.le hy.le, mul_nonneg hy.le hz.le, mul_nonneg hz.le hx.le,
              mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (x - y)) hz.le, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (y - z)) hx.le,
              mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (z - x)) hy.le]
          exact h₁₃
  
  have h_subst : ∃ (x y z : ℝ), 0 < x ∧ 0 < y ∧ 0 < z ∧ a = x / y ∧ b = y / z ∧ c = z / x := by
    refine' ⟨a, 1, 1 / b, by positivity, by norm_num, by positivity, _, _, _⟩
    · 
      field_simp
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> nlinarith
    · 
      field_simp
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> nlinarith
    · 
      have h₁ : c = 1 / (a * b) := by
        have h₂ : a * b * c = 1 := habc
        have h₃ : a * b ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp [h₃] at h₂ ⊢
        nlinarith
      have h₂ : 0 < a * b := by positivity
      field_simp [h₁]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne']
      <;> nlinarith
  
  have h_final : (a - 1 + 1 / b) * (b - 1 + 1 / c) * (c - 1 + 1 / a) ≤ 1 := by
    obtain ⟨x, y, z, hx, hy, hz, ha', hb', hc'⟩ := h_subst
    have h₁ : (a - 1 + 1 / b) = (x + z - y) / y := by

      have h₃ : b = y / z := hb'

          field_simp [h₅.ne', h₆.ne']

        _ = (y + x - z) / z := by

          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₅.ne']
          <;> nlinarith
    have h₃ : (c - 1 + 1 / a) = (z + y - x) / x := by
      have h₄ : c = z / x := hc'
      have h₅ : a = x / y := ha'
      have h₆ : 0 < x := hx
      have h₇ : 0 < y := hy
      calc
        (c - 1 + 1 / a) = (z / x - 1 + 1 / (x / y)) := by rw [h₄, h₅]
        _ = (z / x - 1 + y / x) := by
          field_simp [h₆.ne', h₇.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₆.ne', h₇.ne']
          <;> nlinarith
        _ = (z + y - x) / x := by
          field_simp [h₆.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₆.ne']
          <;> nlinarith
    calc
      (a - 1 + 1 / b) * (b - 1 + 1 / c) * (c - 1 + 1 / a) = ((x + z - y) / y) * ((y + x - z) / z) * ((z + y - x) / x) := by rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]

        field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne', hz.ne']
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne', hz.ne']
        <;> ring_nf
      _ ≤ 1 := by
        have h₄ : (x + z - y) * (y + x - z) * (z + y - x) ≤ x * y * z := by
          have h₅ : (x + z - y) * (y + x - z) * (z + y - x) = (x + y - z) * (x + z - y) * (y + z - x) := by ring
          rw [h₅]

        have h₅ : 0 < x * y * z := by positivity
        have h₆ : (x + z - y) * (y + x - z) * (z + y - x) / (x * y * z) ≤ 1 := by
          rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]

  exact h_final

def IsGood (x A : ℝ) : Prop :=
  sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = A ∧ 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 ∧
    0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) ∧ 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)

    have h₄ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := h.2.2.2
    have h₅ : x ≥ 1 / 2 := by
      linarith
    have h₆ : 0 ≤ sqrt (2 * x - 1) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have h₇ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have h₈ : 0 ≤ sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

    have h₁₁ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by

      rw [h₁]
      <;> norm_num
    have h₁₀ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)))^2 = 2 * x + 2 * Real.sqrt ((x - 1)^2) := by
      have h₁₀₁ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)))^2 = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith),
          Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith),
          mul_nonneg h₆ h₇]
      have h₁₀₂ : (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = 2 * x := by ring
      have h₁₀₃ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul] <;> nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x - 1), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 by linarith)]

        have h₁₀₄₁ : (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = x^2 - (sqrt (2 * x - 1))^2 := by ring
        rw [h₁₀₄₁]
        have h₁₀₄₂ : (sqrt (2 * x - 1))^2 = 2 * x - 1 := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
        rw [h₁₀₄₂]
        nlinarith
      have h₁₀₅ : Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = Real.sqrt ((x - 1)^2) := by
        rw [h₁₀₄]
      calc
        (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)))^2 = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by rw [h₁₀₁]
        _ = 2 * x + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by rw [h₁₀₂] <;> ring
        _ = 2 * x + 2 * Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by
          rw [h₁₀₃]
          <;> ring_nf
        _ = 2 * x + 2 * Real.sqrt ((x - 1)^2) := by rw [h₁₀₅]
    have h₁₁ : 2 * x + 2 * Real.sqrt ((x - 1)^2) = 1 := by
      linarith
    have h₁₂ : x ≥ 1 / 2 := by
      linarith
    have h₁₃ : Real.sqrt ((x - 1)^2) = |x - 1| := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
    have h₁₄ : 2 * x + 2 * |x - 1| = 1 := by
      rw [h₁₃] at h₁₁
      linarith
    have h₁₅ : x < 1 := by
      by_contra h₁₅
      have h₁₆ : x ≥ 1 := by linarith
      have h₁₇ : |x - 1| = x - 1 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg] <;> linarith
      rw [h₁₇] at h₁₄
      nlinarith
    have h₁₆ : |x - 1| = 1 - x := by
      rw [abs_of_nonpos] <;> linarith
    rw [h₁₆] at h₁₄
    nlinarith
  
  have h_final : IsGood x 1 ↔ x ∈ solution_set_one := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exfalso
      exact h_main h
    · intro h
      exfalso
      simp only [solution_set_one] at h

  exact h_final

  sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = A ∧ 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 ∧

theorem imo1959_p2c : IsGood x 2 ↔ x ∈ solution_set_two := by

    constructor

      have h₃ : 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) := h.2.2.1
      have h₄ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := h.2.2.2
      have h₅ : x ≥ 1 / 2 := by linarith

        have h₆₂ : 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 := by linarith

        <;> norm_num

            have h₈₄ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by

            have h₈₅ : (sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := by

            have h₈₇ : 0 ≤ (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by linarith

              rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by linarith)]

            <;>

            <;>
            nlinarith

        linarith
      have h₁₀ : Real.sqrt ((x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) = 2 - x := by

theorem iran1998_p9

      have h₈₇₁ : (√(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1))^2 = (√((x - 1) / x) * √x + √((y - 1) / y) * √y + √((z - 1) / z) * √z)^2 := by
        have h₈₇₂ : √((x - 1) / x) * √x = √(x - 1) := by
          have h₈₇₃ : 0 ≤ (x - 1) / x := by
            apply div_nonneg
            · linarith
            · linarith
          have h₈₇₄ : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
          have h₈₇₅ : 0 ≤ (x - 1) / x * x := by positivity
          have h₈₇₆ : √((x - 1) / x) * √x = √(((x - 1) / x) * x) := by

      have h₈₉₀ : 0 ≤ √((x - 1) / x) := by positivity
      have h₈₉₁ : 0 ≤ √((y - 1) / y) := by positivity
      have h₈₉₂ : 0 ≤ √((z - 1) / z) := by positivity
      have h₈₉₃ : 0 ≤ √x := by positivity

      have h₈₉₅ : 0 ≤ √z := by positivity

        have h₉₀₀ : (√((z - 1) / z)) ^ 2 = (z - 1) / z := by

        have h₉₀₂ : (√x) ^ 2 = x := by

        have h₉₀₃ : (√y) ^ 2 = y := by

        have h₉₀₄ : (√z) ^ 2 = z := by

          exact h₈₉₆
        _ = ((x - 1) / x + (y - 1) / y + (z - 1) / z) * (x + y + z) := by
          rw [h₈₉₇, h₉₀₁]
    
    have h₈₈ : ((x - 1) / x + (y - 1) / y + (z - 1) / z) * (x + y + z) = 1 * (x + y + z) := by
      rw [h₇]

    have h₉₁ : 0 ≤ √(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1) := by positivity

        rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> positivity
      rw [h₉₅]
      linarith

theorem singapore2019_r1_p4 (x : ℝ) (hx : Real.logb 21 3 = x) :

  have h₁ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := by

      rw [Real.logb]

      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp
      <;> ring_nf
    have h₁₂ : Real.log 21 = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := by
      have h₁₂₁ : Real.log 21 = Real.log (3 * 7) := by norm_num
      rw [h₁₂₁]

    have h₂₁ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h₁

      <;> nlinarith [Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 3),
        Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 7)]
    have h₂₇ : 1 - x > 0 := by linarith
    have h₂₈ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h₂₉ : x ≠ 0 := by linarith

      have h₃₁₂ : x * Real.log 3 + x * Real.log 7 = Real.log 3 := by linarith

        <;> linarith
      exact h₃₁₄
    have h₃₂ : Real.log 7 = (Real.log 3 * (1 - x)) / x := by
      have h₃₂₁ : x * Real.log 7 = Real.log 3 * (1 - x) := h₃₁

        field_simp [h₂₉] at h₃₂₁ ⊢
        <;> nlinarith
      exact h₃₂₂
    exact h₃₂
  
  have h₃ : Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * (Real.log 3 / Real.log 7) := by

  have h₄ : Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * x / (1 - x) := by

    have h₄₇ : x > 0 := by

    have h₄₉ : 1 - x > 0 := by linarith

  have h₅ : Real.logb 7 9 = solution x := by
    rw [h₄]
    <;> simp [solution]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> field_simp
    <;> ring_nf

theorem usa1980_p5 (x y z : ℝ)

  have h_main : x / (y + z + 1) + y / (z + x + 1) + z / (x + y + 1) ≤ 1 + (1 - x) * (1 - y) * (1 - z) := by
    have hx₁ : 0 ≤ x := by exact hx.1
    have hx₂ : x ≤ 1 := by exact hx.2
    have hy₁ : 0 ≤ y := by exact hy.1
    have hy₂ : y ≤ 1 := by exact hy.2
    have hz₁ : 0 ≤ z := by exact hz.1
    have hz₂ : z ≤ 1 := by exact hz.2
    have h₁ : 0 ≤ (1 - x) := by linarith
    have h₂ : 0 ≤ (1 - y) := by linarith
    have h₃ : 0 ≤ (1 - z) := by linarith
    have h₄ : 0 ≤ (1 - x) * (1 - y) := by positivity
    have h₅ : 0 ≤ (1 - x) * (1 - y) * (1 - z) := by positivity
    by_cases h : (x + y + z = 0)
    · 
      have h₆ : x = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      have h₇ : y = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      have h₈ : z = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      rw [h₆, h₇, h₈]
      norm_num
    · 
      have h₆ : 0 < x + y + z := by
        by_contra h₆
        have h₇ : x + y + z ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have h₈ : x + y + z = 0 := by
          nlinarith
        contradiction
      have h₇ : x / (y + z + 1) ≤ x / (x + y + z) := by
        
        have h₇₁ : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
        have h₇₂ : 0 < y + z + 1 := by nlinarith
        have h₇₃ : 0 < x + y + z := by linarith
        have h₇₄ : x + y + z ≤ y + z + 1 := by nlinarith
        have h₇₅ : 0 < y + z + 1 := by nlinarith
        
        have h₇₆ : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
        have h₇₇ : 0 < x + y + z := by linarith
        have h₇₈ : 0 < y + z + 1 := by nlinarith
        
        have h₇₉ : x / (y + z + 1) ≤ x / (x + y + z) := by
          apply (div_le_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
          nlinarith
        exact h₇₉
      have h₈ : y / (z + x + 1) ≤ y / (x + y + z) := by
        
        have h₈₁ : 0 ≤ y := by linarith
        have h₈₂ : 0 < z + x + 1 := by nlinarith
        have h₈₃ : 0 < x + y + z := by linarith
        have h₈₄ : x + y + z ≤ z + x + 1 := by nlinarith
        have h₈₅ : 0 < z + x + 1 := by nlinarith
        
        have h₈₆ : 0 ≤ y := by linarith
        have h₈₇ : 0 < x + y + z := by linarith
        have h₈₈ : 0 < z + x + 1 := by nlinarith
        
        have h₈₉ : y / (z + x + 1) ≤ y / (x + y + z) := by
          apply (div_le_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
          nlinarith
        exact h₈₉
      have h₉ : z / (x + y + 1) ≤ z / (x + y + z) := by
        
        have h₉₁ : 0 ≤ z := by linarith
        have h₉₂ : 0 < x + y + 1 := by nlinarith
        have h₉₃ : 0 < x + y + z := by linarith
        have h₉₄ : x + y + z ≤ x + y + 1 := by nlinarith
        have h₉₅ : 0 < x + y + 1 := by nlinarith
        
        have h₉₆ : 0 ≤ z := by linarith
        have h₉₇ : 0 < x + y + z := by linarith
        have h₉₈ : 0 < x + y + 1 := by nlinarith
        
        have h₉₉ : z / (x + y + 1) ≤ z / (x + y + z) := by
          apply (div_le_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
          nlinarith
        exact h₉₉
      
      have h₁₀ : x / (y + z + 1) + y / (z + x + 1) + z / (x + y + 1) ≤ x / (x + y + z) + y / (x + y + z) + z / (x + y + z) := by
        linarith
      
      have h₁₁ : x / (x + y + z) + y / (x + y + z) + z / (x + y + z) = 1 := by
        have h₁₁₁ : x / (x + y + z) + y / (x + y + z) + z / (x + y + z) = (x + y + z) / (x + y + z) := by
          field_simp [h₆.ne']
          <;> ring
        rw [h₁₁₁]
        have h₁₁₂ : (x + y + z) / (x + y + z) = 1 := by
          field_simp [h₆.ne']
        rw [h₁₁₂]
      
      have h₁₂ : x / (y + z + 1) + y / (z + x + 1) + z / (x + y + 1) ≤ 1 := by
        linarith
      
      have h₁₃ : 1 ≤ 1 + (1 - x) * (1 - y) * (1 - z) := by
        have h₁₃₁ : 0 ≤ (1 - x) * (1 - y) * (1 - z) := by
          have h₁₃₂ : 0 ≤ (1 - x) := by linarith
          have h₁₃₃ : 0 ≤ (1 - y) := by linarith
          have h₁₃₄ : 0 ≤ (1 - z) := by linarith
          positivity
        linarith
      
      linarith
  exact h_main

def AcuteTriangle (T : Affine.Triangle ℝ Pt) : Prop :=
  ∠ (T.points 1) (T.points 2) (T.points 3) < Real.pi / 2 ∧
  ∠ (T.points 2) (T.points 3) (T.points 1) < Real.pi / 2 ∧

theorem imo1970_p6
    (P : Fin 100 → Pt)

    let cardAll := Nat.card { t : Affine.Triangle ℝ Pt |
                              ∃ a b c : Fin 100, ![P a, P b, P c] = t.points }

      Nat.card { t : Affine.Triangle ℝ Pt | ∃ a b c : Fin 100, ![P a, P b, P c] = t.points ∧
                                            AcuteTriangle t }
    (cardAcute : ℚ) / cardAll ≤ 7 / 10 := by 
  have h_contradiction : False := by
    
    let a : Fin 100 := ⟨0, by decide⟩
    let b : Fin 100 := ⟨1, by decide⟩
    let c : Fin 100 := ⟨2, by decide⟩
    have h₁ : List.Nodup ([a, b, c] : List (Fin 100)) := by
      simp [a, b, c, List.Nodup]
      <;> decide
    have h₂ : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P c, P b, P c} : Set Pt) := hP a b c h₁
    
    have h₃ : Collinear ℝ ({P c, P b, P c} : Set Pt) := by

        (try {

      rw [h₅]
      exact h₄
    
    exact h₂ h₃
  
  have h_main : ( (Nat.card { t : Affine.Triangle ℝ Pt | ∃ a b c : Fin 100, ![P a, P b, P c] = t.points } : ℚ) / (Nat.card { t : Affine.Triangle ℝ Pt | ∃ a b c : Fin 100, ![P a, P b, P c] = t.points }) : ℚ) ≤ 7 / 10 := by

      have h₇₁ : Nat.gcd (21 * n + 4) (14 * n + 3) ∣ 2 * (21 * n + 4) + 1 := h₆

theorem singapore2019_r1_p7 (x : ℝ) (hx : tan x = 5) :

  have h_cos_ne_zero : cos x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos] at hx
    rw [h] at hx
    norm_num at hx ⊢
    <;> simp_all [div_eq_mul_inv]
    <;> ring_nf at *
    <;> nlinarith [sin_le_one x, cos_le_one x, sin_sq_add_cos_sq x]
  
  have h_sin_eq : sin x = 5 * cos x := by
    have h1 : tan x = sin x / cos x := by rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
    rw [h1] at hx
    have h2 : sin x / cos x = 5 := by linarith
    have h3 : sin x = 5 * cos x := by
      field_simp [h_cos_ne_zero] at h2
      linarith
    exact h3
  
  have h_cos_sq : cos x ^ 2 = 1 / 26 := by
    have h1 : sin x ^ 2 + cos x ^ 2 = 1 := by exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq x
    rw [h_sin_eq] at h1
    ring_nf at h1 ⊢
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero h_cos_ne_zero]
  
  have h_sin_two_x : sin (2 * x) = 5 / 13 := by
    have h1 : sin (2 * x) = 2 * sin x * cos x := by
      rw [sin_two_mul]
    rw [h1]
    rw [h_sin_eq]
    have h2 : cos x ^ 2 = 1 / 26 := h_cos_sq
    have h3 : 2 * (5 * cos x) * cos x = 10 * (cos x ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [h3]
    have h4 : 10 * (cos x ^ 2) = 10 * (1 / 26) := by
      rw [h2]
      <;> ring
    rw [h4]
    <;> norm_num
    <;> linarith
  
  have h_one_plus_cos_two_x : 1 + cos (2 * x) = 1 / 13 := by
    have h1 : cos (2 * x) = 2 * cos x ^ 2 - 1 := by
      rw [cos_two_mul]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> simp [cos_sq]
      <;> ring_nf
    rw [h1]
    have h2 : cos x ^ 2 = 1 / 26 := h_cos_sq
    rw [h2]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> norm_num
    <;> linarith
  
  have h_six_plus_sin_two_x : 6 + sin (2 * x) = 83 / 13 := by
    rw [h_sin_two_x]
    <;> norm_num
  
  have h_main : (6 + sin (2 * x)) / (1 + cos (2 * x)) = 83 := by
    rw [h_six_plus_sin_two_x, h_one_plus_cos_two_x]
    <;> norm_num
    <;> field_simp
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> norm_num
  
  have h_solution : (6 + sin (2 * x)) / (1 + cos (2 * x)) = solution := by
    rw [h_main]
    <;> norm_num [solution]
  
  apply h_solution

          have h₄ : |a 2 - a 1| = 2 * |a 1 - a 0| := by
            have h₅ : a 2 - a 1 = 2 * (a 0 - a 1) := h₃
            have h₆ : |a 2 - a 1| = |2 * (a 0 - a 1)| := by rw [h₅]
            rw [h₆]
            have h₇ : |2 * (a 0 - a 1)| = 2 * |a 0 - a 1| := by
              simp [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (show (2 : ℤ) ≥ 0 by norm_num)]
              <;>
              (try omega) <;>
              (try simp_all [abs_of_nonneg, abs_of_nonpos]) <;>
              (try norm_num) <;>
              (try linarith)
            rw [h₇]
            have h₈ : |a 0 - a 1| = |a 1 - a 0| := by
              rw [abs_sub_comm]
            rw [h₈]
            <;>
            (try omega) <;>
            (try simp_all [abs_of_nonneg, abs_of_nonpos]) <;>
            (try norm_num) <;>
            (try linarith)
          have h₅ : |a (1 + 1) - a 1| ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := by
            rw [show (1 : ℕ) + 1 = 2 by norm_num]
            have h₆ : 2 * |a 1 - a 0| ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := by
              have h₇ : |a 1 - a 0| ≥ 0 := abs_nonneg _
              have h₈ : (2 : ℤ) * |a 1 - a 0| ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := by
                nlinarith
              exact h₈
            linarith
          simpa using h₅
      · 
        have h₂ : a (n + 2) = 2 * a (n + 1) - a n ∨ a (n + 2) = 2 * a n - a (n + 1) := ha (n + 2) (by omega)
        cases h₂ with
        | inl h₂ =>
          
          have h₃ : a (n + 2) - a (n + 1) = a (n + 1) - a n := by
            rw [h₂]
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> omega
          have h₄ : |a (n + 2) - a (n + 1)| = |a (n + 1) - a n| := by
            rw [h₃]
          have h₅ : |a (n + 1 + 1) - a (n + 1)| ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := by
            calc
              |a (n + 1 + 1) - a (n + 1)| = |a (n + 2) - a (n + 1)| := by ring_nf
              _ = |a (n + 1) - a n| := by rw [h₄]
              _ ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := by
                simpa [add_assoc] using IH
          simpa [add_assoc] using h₅
        | inr h₂ =>
          
          have h₃ : a (n + 2) - a (n + 1) = 2 * (a n - a (n + 1)) := by
            rw [h₂]
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> omega
          have h₄ : |a (n + 2) - a (n + 1)| = 2 * |a (n + 1) - a n| := by
            have h₅ : a (n + 2) - a (n + 1) = 2 * (a n - a (n + 1)) := h₃
            have h₆ : |a (n + 2) - a (n + 1)| = |2 * (a n - a (n + 1))| := by rw [h₅]
            rw [h₆]
            have h₇ : |2 * (a n - a (n + 1))| = 2 * |a n - a (n + 1)| := by
              simp [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (show (2 : ℤ) ≥ 0 by norm_num)]
              <;>
              (try omega) <;>
              (try simp_all [abs_of_nonneg, abs_of_nonpos]) <;>
              (try norm_num) <;>
              (try linarith)
            rw [h₇]
            have h₈ : |a n - a (n + 1)| = |a (n + 1) - a n| := by
              rw [abs_sub_comm]
            rw [h₈]
            <;>
            (try omega) <;>
            (try simp_all [abs_of_nonneg, abs_of_nonpos]) <;>
            (try norm_num) <;>
            (try linarith)
          have h₅ : |a (n + 1 + 1) - a (n + 1)| ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := by
            calc
              |a (n + 1 + 1) - a (n + 1)| = |a (n + 2) - a (n + 1)| := by ring_nf
              _ = 2 * |a (n + 1) - a n| := by rw [h₄]
              _ ≥ 2 * |a 1 - a 0| := by
                have h₆ : |a (n + 1) - a n| ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := by
                  simpa [add_assoc] using IH
                have h₇ : (2 : ℤ) * |a (n + 1) - a n| ≥ 2 * |a 1 - a 0| := by
                  nlinarith [abs_nonneg (a (n + 1) - a n), abs_nonneg (a 1 - a 0)]
                linarith
              _ ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := by
                have h₆ : |a 1 - a 0| ≥ 0 := abs_nonneg _
                nlinarith [abs_nonneg (a 1 - a 0)]
          simpa [add_assoc] using h₅
    exact h₁ n hn
  
  have h_final : |a 1 - a 0| = 1 := by
    have h₁ : |a 2024 - a 2023| = 1 := by
      have h₂ : |a 2023 - a 2024| = 1 := ha'
      have h₃ : |a 2024 - a 2023| = |a 2023 - a 2024| := by
        rw [abs_sub_comm]
      rw [h₃]
      exact h₂
    have h₂ : |a 2024 - a 2023| ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := by
      have h₃ : |a (2023) - a (2022)| ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := h_main_ineq 2022 (by norm_num)
      have h₄ : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 2023 → |a (n + 1) - a n| ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := by
        intro n hn
        have h₅ : n ≥ 2023 := hn
        have h₆ : |a (n + 1) - a n| ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := by
          have h₇ : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≥ 1 → |a (k + 1) - a k| ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := h_main_ineq
          have h₈ : n + 1 ≥ 1 := by omega
          have h₉ : n ≥ 1 := by omega
          have h₁₀ : |a (n + 1) - a n| ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := h_main_ineq n (by omega)
          exact h₁₀
        exact h₆
      have h₅ : |a 2024 - a 2023| ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := by
        have h₆ : |a (2023 + 1) - a 2023| ≥ |a 1 - a 0| := h_main_ineq 2023 (by norm_num)
        simpa [add_comm] using h₆
      exact h₅
    have h₃ : |a 1 - a 0| ≤ 1 := by
      linarith
    have h₄ : |a 1 - a 0| ≥ 1 := by
      have h₅ : a 0 ≠ a 1 := h_a1_ne_a0
      have h₆ : a 1 - a 0 ≠ 0 := by
        intro h₇
        apply h₅
        linarith
      have h₇ : |a 1 - a 0| ≥ 1 := by
        have h₈ : a 1 - a 0 ≠ 0 := h₆
        have h₉ : |a 1 - a 0| ≥ 1 := by
          have h₁₀ : (a 1 - a 0 : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h₈
          have h₁₁ : |(a 1 - a 0 : ℤ)| ≥ 1 := by
            have h₁₂ : (a 1 - a 0 : ℤ) ≥ 1 ∨ (a 1 - a 0 : ℤ) ≤ -1 := by
              by_contra! h₁₃
              have h₁₄ : -1 < (a 1 - a 0 : ℤ) := by linarith
              have h₁₅ : (a 1 - a 0 : ℤ) < 1 := by linarith
              have h₁₆ : (a 1 - a 0 : ℤ) = 0 := by
                omega
              contradiction
            cases h₁₂ with
            | inl h₁₂ =>
              have h₁₃ : |(a 1 - a 0 : ℤ)| ≥ 1 := by
                have h₁₄ : (a 1 - a 0 : ℤ) ≥ 1 := h₁₂
                have h₁₅ : |(a 1 - a 0 : ℤ)| = (a 1 - a 0 : ℤ) := by
                  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
                rw [h₁₅]
                linarith
              exact h₁₃
            | inr h₁₂ =>
              have h₁₃ : |(a 1 - a 0 : ℤ)| ≥ 1 := by
                have h₁₄ : (a 1 - a 0 : ℤ) ≤ -1 := h₁₂
                have h₁₅ : |(a 1 - a 0 : ℤ)| = -(a 1 - a 0 : ℤ) := by
                  rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
                  <;> linarith
                rw [h₁₅]
                linarith
              exact h₁₃
          exact_mod_cast h₁₁
        exact h₉
      exact h₇
    have h₅ : |a 1 - a 0| = 1 := by
      linarith
    exact h₅
  
  have h_abs_symm : |a 0 - a 1| = |a 1 - a 0| := by
    rw [abs_sub_comm]
    <;>
    simp [abs_sub_comm]
  
  have h_main : |a 0 - a 1| = 1 := by
    have h₁ : |a 1 - a 0| = 1 := h_final
    have h₂ : |a 0 - a 1| = |a 1 - a 0| := h_abs_symm
    rw [h₂]
    <;> simp [h₁]
  
  exact h_main

theorem imo1972_p5 (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (hf1 : ∀ x, ∀ y, f (x + y) + f (x - y) = 2 * f x * g y)
    (hf2 : BddAbove (Set.range fun x => ‖f x‖)) (hf3 : ∃ x, f x ≠ 0) (y : ℝ) : ‖g y‖ ≤ 1 := by 
  have hM_exists : ∃ M, IsLUB (Set.range fun x => ‖f x‖) M := by
    have h₁ : BddAbove (Set.range fun x => ‖f x‖) := hf2
    have h₂ : ∃ M, IsLUB (Set.range fun x => ‖f x‖) M := by
      
      refine' ⟨sSup (Set.range fun x => ‖f x‖), _⟩
      apply isLUB_csSup
      · 
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hf3
        have h₃ : ‖f x‖ ∈ Set.range (fun x => ‖f x‖) := by
          exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
        exact Set.nonempty_of_mem h₃
      · 
        exact hf2
    exact h₂
  
  have hM_pos : ∀ (M : ℝ), IsLUB (Set.range fun x => ‖f x‖) M → M > 0 := by
    intro M hM
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hf3
    have h₁ : ‖f x₀‖ > 0 := by
      have h₂ : f x₀ ≠ 0 := hx₀
      have h₃ : ‖f x₀‖ ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        have h₄ : f x₀ = 0 := by
          simp [norm_eq_zero] at h ⊢
          <;> simp_all
        contradiction
      have h₄ : ‖f x₀‖ ≥ 0 := norm_nonneg (f x₀)
      have h₅ : ‖f x₀‖ > 0 := by
        contrapose! h₃
        linarith
      exact h₅
    have h₂ : ‖f x₀‖ ∈ Set.range (fun x => ‖f x‖) := by
      exact ⟨x₀, rfl⟩
    have h₃ : ‖f x₀‖ ≤ M := by
      apply hM.1
      exact h₂
    linarith
  
  have h_key_ineq : ∀ (M : ℝ), IsLUB (Set.range fun x => ‖f x‖) M → ∀ (x : ℝ), ‖f x‖ * |g y| ≤ M := by
    intro M hM x
    have h₁ : ‖f x‖ ∈ Set.range (fun x => ‖f x‖) := by
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    have h₂ : ‖f x‖ ≤ M := by
      apply hM.1
      exact h₁
    have h₃ : ‖f (x + y) + f (x - y)‖ ≤ 2 * M := by
      have h₄ : ‖f (x + y)‖ ≤ M := by
        have h₅ : ‖f (x + y)‖ ∈ Set.range (fun x => ‖f x‖) := by
          exact ⟨x + y, rfl⟩
        have h₆ : ‖f (x + y)‖ ≤ M := by
          apply hM.1
          exact h₅
        exact h₆
      have h₅ : ‖f (x - y)‖ ≤ M := by
        have h₆ : ‖f (x - y)‖ ∈ Set.range (fun x => ‖f x‖) := by
          exact ⟨x - y, rfl⟩
        have h₇ : ‖f (x - y)‖ ≤ M := by
          apply hM.1
          exact h₆
        exact h₇
      calc
        ‖f (x + y) + f (x - y)‖ ≤ ‖f (x + y)‖ + ‖f (x - y)‖ := norm_add_le (f (x + y)) (f (x - y))
        _ ≤ M + M := by linarith
        _ = 2 * M := by ring
    have h₄ : f (x + y) + f (x - y) = 2 * f x * g y := by
      have h₅ := hf1 x y
      linarith
    have h₅ : ‖f (x + y) + f (x - y)‖ = ‖2 * f x * g y‖ := by
      rw [h₄]
    have h₆ : ‖2 * f x * g y‖ = 2 * ‖f x‖ * |g y| := by
      calc
        ‖2 * f x * g y‖ = ‖2 * (f x) * g y‖ := by ring_nf
        _ = ‖2 * (f x)‖ * |g y| := by
          simp [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          <;>
          ring_nf
          <;>
          simp [abs_mul]
          <;>
          ring_nf
        _ = 2 * ‖f x‖ * |g y| := by
          simp [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg, show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num]
          <;>
          ring_nf
          <;>
          simp [abs_mul]
          <;>
          ring_nf
    have h₇ : 2 * ‖f x‖ * |g y| ≤ 2 * M := by
      calc
        2 * ‖f x‖ * |g y| = ‖2 * f x * g y‖ := by
          rw [h₆]
          <;>
          ring_nf
        _ = ‖f (x + y) + f (x - y)‖ := by
          rw [h₅]
          <;>
          ring_nf
        _ ≤ 2 * M := h₃
    have h₈ : ‖f x‖ * |g y| ≤ M := by
      linarith
    exact h₈
  
  have h_main : ‖g y‖ ≤ 1 := by
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hM_exists
    have hM_pos' : M > 0 := hM_pos M hM
    by_cases hg : g y = 0
    · 
      have h₁ : ‖g y‖ = 0 := by
        simp [hg]
      have h₂ : ‖g y‖ ≤ 1 := by
        linarith
      exact h₂
    · 
      have h₁ : ‖f (0 : ℝ)‖ * |g y| ≤ M := h_key_ineq M hM 0
      have h₂ : ∀ (x : ℝ), ‖f x‖ * |g y| ≤ M := by
        intro x
        exact h_key_ineq M hM x
      have h₃ : |g y| > 0 := by
        have h₄ : g y ≠ 0 := hg
        have h₅ : |g y| > 0 := by
          apply abs_pos.mpr
          exact h₄
        exact h₅
      have h₄ : ∀ (x : ℝ), ‖f x‖ ≤ M / |g y| := by
        intro x
        have h₅ : ‖f x‖ * |g y| ≤ M := h₂ x
        have h₆ : 0 < |g y| := by positivity
        have h₇ : ‖f x‖ ≤ M / |g y| := by
          rw [le_div_iff h₆]
          nlinarith
        exact h₇
      have h₅ : M ≤ M / |g y| := by
        have h₆ : IsLUB (Set.range fun x => ‖f x‖) M := hM
        have h₇ : M / |g y| ∈ upperBounds (Set.range fun x => ‖f x‖) := by
          intro r hr
          obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hr
          have h₈ : ‖f x‖ ≤ M / |g y| := h₄ x
          linarith
        have h₈ : M ≤ M / |g y| := by
          apply h₆.2
          exact h₇
        exact h₈
      have h₆ : |g y| ≤ 1 := by
        have h₇ : 0 < |g y| := by positivity
        have h₈ : 0 < M := by linarith
        have h₉ : M / |g y| ≥ M := by
          linarith
        have h₁₀ : M / |g y| ≥ M := by linarith
        have h₁₁ : |g y| ≤ 1 := by
          by_contra h
          have h₁₂ : |g y| > 1 := by linarith
          have h₁₃ : M / |g y| < M := by
            rw [div_lt_iff (by positivity)]
            nlinarith
          linarith
        exact h₁₁
      have h₇ : ‖g y‖ ≤ 1 := by
        have h₈ : ‖g y‖ = |g y| := by
          simp [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        rw [h₈]
        exact h₆
      exact h₇
  exact h_main

theorem imo1969_p2
    (x₁ x₂ : ℝ)
    (n : ℕ)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (h₁ : ∀ x, f x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x)) / (2^i))
    (h₂ : f x₂ = 0)
    (h₃ : f x₁ = 0)
    (h₄: ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 ^ i)) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, x₂ - x₁ = m * Real.pi := by 
  have hA : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using h₄
  
  have hA_def : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i)) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i) := by rfl
  
  set A := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i) with hA_def'
  have hB_def : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i)) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i) := by rfl
  
  set B := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ)^i) with hB_def'
  
  have h_f_expand : ∀ (x : ℝ), f x = A * Real.cos x - B * Real.sin x := by
    intro x
    rw [h₁]
    have h₅ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i + x)) / (2 ^ i : ℝ)) = ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      have h₆ : Real.cos (a i + x) = Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x := by
        rw [Real.cos_add]
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₆]
      <;> field_simp [pow_ne_zero]
      <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₅]
    have h₆ : ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i = (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x - (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.sin x := by
      calc
        ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) * Real.sin x) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i = ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.cos x - Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.sin x) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          field_simp [pow_ne_zero]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [pow_ne_zero]
          <;> ring_nf
        _ = ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.cos x) - ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i * Real.sin x) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        _ = (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.cos x) - (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.sin x) := by
          ring_nf
        _ = (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x - (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.sin x := by
          have h₇ : ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.cos x = (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.cos (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.cos x := by
            simp [Finset.sum_mul]
          have h₈ : ∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i) * Real.sin x = (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Real.sin (a i) / (2 : ℝ) ^ i)) * Real.sin x := by
            simp [Finset.sum_mul]
          rw [h₇, h₈]
          <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₆]
    <;> simp only [A, B]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> field_simp [pow_ne_zero]
    <;> ring_nf
  
  have hAx₁ : A * Real.cos x₁ = B * Real.sin x₁ := by
    have h₅ : f x₁ = 0 := h₃
    have h₆ : f x₁ = A * Real.cos x₁ - B * Real.sin x₁ := by
      rw [h_f_expand]
    rw [h₆] at h₅
    linarith
  
  have hAx₂ : A * Real.cos x₂ = B * Real.sin x₂ := by
    have h₅ : f x₂ = 0 := h₂
    have h₆ : f x₂ = A * Real.cos x₂ - B * Real.sin x₂ := by
      rw [h_f_expand]
    rw [h₆] at h₅
    linarith
  
  have hBsin : B * Real.sin (x₁ - x₂) = 0 := by
    have h₅ : A * Real.cos x₁ = B * Real.sin x₁ := hAx₁
    have h₆ : A * Real.cos x₂ = B * Real.sin x₂ := hAx₂
    have h₇ : B * Real.sin (x₁ - x₂) = B * (Real.sin x₁ * Real.cos x₂ - Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂) := by
      have h₈ : Real.sin (x₁ - x₂) = Real.sin x₁ * Real.cos x₂ - Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ := by
        rw [Real.sin_sub]
      rw [h₈]
      <;> ring
    rw [h₇]
    have h₈ : A * Real.cos x₁ * Real.cos x₂ = B * Real.sin x₁ * Real.cos x₂ := by
      calc
        A * Real.cos x₁ * Real.cos x₂ = (A * Real.cos x₁) * Real.cos x₂ := by ring
        _ = (B * Real.sin x₁) * Real.cos x₂ := by rw [h₅]
        _ = B * Real.sin x₁ * Real.cos x₂ := by ring
    have h₉ : A * Real.cos x₂ * Real.cos x₁ = B * Real.sin x₂ * Real.cos x₁ := by
      calc
        A * Real.cos x₂ * Real.cos x₁ = (A * Real.cos x₂) * Real.cos x₁ := by ring
        _ = (B * Real.sin x₂) * Real.cos x₁ := by rw [h₆]
        _ = B * Real.sin x₂ * Real.cos x₁ := by ring
    have h₁₀ : B * (Real.sin x₁ * Real.cos x₂ - Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂) = B * Real.sin x₁ * Real.cos x₂ - B * Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ := by ring
    have h₁₁ : B * Real.sin x₁ * Real.cos x₂ - B * Real.cos x₁ * Real.sin x₂ = 0 := by

abbrev P (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < a ∧
  ∀ x, (f x)^2 ≤ f x ∧ f (x + a) = 1/2 + √(f x - (f x)^2)

theorem imo1968_p5a (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (hf : P a f) :
    ∃ b, 0 < b ∧ f.Periodic b := by 
  have h_main : ∀ (x : ℝ), f (x + 2 * a) = f x := by
    intro x
    have h₁ : 0 < a := hf.1
    have h₂ : ∀ x, (f x)^2 ≤ f x ∧ f (x + a) = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := hf.2
    have h₃ : (f x)^2 ≤ f x := (h₂ x).1
    have h₄ : f (x + a) = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := (h₂ x).2
    have h₅ : (f (x + a))^2 ≤ f (x + a) := (h₂ (x + a)).1
    have h₆ : f (x + a + a) = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f (x + a) - (f (x + a))^2) := (h₂ (x + a)).2
    have h₇ : f (x + 2 * a) = f (x + a + a) := by ring_nf
    rw [h₇]
    have h₈ : f (x + a + a) = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f (x + a) - (f (x + a))^2) := by rw [h₆]
    rw [h₈]
    have h₉ : f (x + a) = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := h₄
    have h₁₀ : f x ≥ 1 / 2 := by
      have h₁₁ : f x = f ((x - a) + a) := by ring_nf
      rw [h₁₁]
      have h₁₂ : f ((x - a) + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f (x - a) - (f (x - a)) ^ 2) := (h₂ (x - a)).2
      rw [h₁₂]
      have h₁₃ : Real.sqrt (f (x - a) - (f (x - a)) ^ 2) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      linarith
    have h₁₁ : f x ≤ 1 := by
      have h₁₂ : f x = f ((x - a) + a) := by ring_nf
      rw [h₁₂]
      have h₁₃ : f ((x - a) + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f (x - a) - (f (x - a)) ^ 2) := (h₂ (x - a)).2
      rw [h₁₃]
      have h₁₄ : Real.sqrt (f (x - a) - (f (x - a)) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        have h₁₅ : f (x - a) - (f (x - a)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (f (x - a) - 1 / 2)]
        have h₁₆ : Real.sqrt (f (x - a) - (f (x - a)) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (1 / 4) := by
          apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
          linarith
        have h₁₇ : Real.sqrt (1 / 4) = 1 / 2 := by
          rw [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq] <;> norm_num
        linarith
      linarith
    have h₁₂ : f (x + a) ≥ 1 / 2 := by
      have h₁₃ : f (x + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2) := h₄
      rw [h₁₃]
      have h₁₄ : Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      linarith
    have h₁₃ : f (x + a) ≤ 1 := by
      have h₁₄ : f (x + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2) := h₄
      rw [h₁₄]
      have h₁₅ : Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        have h₁₆ : f x - (f x) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (f x - 1 / 2)]
        have h₁₇ : Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (1 / 4) := by
          apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
          linarith
        have h₁₈ : Real.sqrt (1 / 4) = 1 / 2 := by
          rw [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq] <;> norm_num
        linarith
      linarith
    have h₁₄ : (f (x + a) - (f (x + a)) ^ 2) = (f x - 1 / 2) ^ 2 := by
      have h₁₅ : f (x + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2) := h₄
      have h₁₆ : f x - (f x) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by
        nlinarith [h₃]
      have h₁₇ : Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h₁₈ : (Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2)) ^ 2 = f x - (f x) ^ 2 := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
      calc
        (f (x + a) - (f (x + a)) ^ 2) = (1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2)) - (1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by rw [h₁₅]
        _ = (1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2)) - (1 / 4 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2) + (Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2)) ^ 2) := by
          ring_nf
          <;>
          nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (f x - (f x) ^ 2)]
        _ = 1 / 4 - (Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
          ring_nf
          <;>
          nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (f x - (f x) ^ 2)]
        _ = 1 / 4 - (f x - (f x) ^ 2) := by rw [h₁₈]
        _ = (f x - 1 / 2) ^ 2 := by
          ring_nf
          <;>
          nlinarith
    have h₁₅ : Real.sqrt (f (x + a) - (f (x + a)) ^ 2) = f x - 1 / 2 := by
      have h₁₆ : (f (x + a) - (f (x + a)) ^ 2) = (f x - 1 / 2) ^ 2 := h₁₄
      have h₁₇ : Real.sqrt (f (x + a) - (f (x + a)) ^ 2) = Real.sqrt ((f x - 1 / 2) ^ 2) := by rw [h₁₆]
      rw [h₁₇]
      have h₁₈ : Real.sqrt ((f x - 1 / 2) ^ 2) = f x - 1 / 2 := by
        have h₁₉ : f x - 1 / 2 ≥ 0 := by linarith
        rw [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq] <;> nlinarith
      rw [h₁₈]
    rw [h₁₅]
    <;>
    ring_nf
    <;>
    nlinarith
  
  have h_periodic : ∃ b, 0 < b ∧ f.Periodic b := by
    have h₁ : 0 < a := hf.1
    have h₂ : ∀ x, (f x)^2 ≤ f x ∧ f (x + a) = 1/2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x)^2) := hf.2
    use 2 * a
    constructor
    · 
      linarith
    · 
      refine' fun x => _
      have h₃ : f (x + 2 * a) = f x := h_main x
      linarith
  
  exact h_periodic

theorem imo_sl_2008_A2a_part1 [LinearOrderedField F]
    {x y z : F} (hx : x ≠ 1) (hy : y ≠ 1) (hz : z ≠ 1) (h : x * y * z = 1) :
    1 ≤ (x / (x - 1)) ^ 2 + (y / (y - 1)) ^ 2 + (z / (z - 1)) ^ 2 := by

    simpa [sub_eq_zero] using h₁
  
  have hy1 : y - 1 ≠ 0 := by

  have hz1 : z - 1 ≠ 0 := by

    simpa [sub_eq_zero] using h₁
  
  set a := (1 : F) / (x - 1) with ha

            have h₄ : a = 1 / (x - 1) := rfl
            field_simp [ha, hx1] at h₄ ⊢
            <;> nlinarith
          _ = 1 / a := by rfl
      have h₄ : x = 1 + 1 / a := by
        calc
          x = (x - 1) + 1 := by ring
          _ = 1 / a + 1 := by rw [h₃]

      exact h₄
    have h₂ : y = 1 + 1 / b := by
      have h₃ : b = 1 / (y - 1) := rfl
      have h₄ : y - 1 = 1 / b := by
        calc
          y - 1 = 1 / b := by
            have h₅ : b = 1 / (y - 1) := rfl
            field_simp [hb, hy1] at h₅ ⊢
            <;> nlinarith
          _ = 1 / b := by rfl
      have h₅ : y = 1 + 1 / b := by
        calc
          y = (y - 1) + 1 := by ring
          _ = 1 / b + 1 := by rw [h₄]
          _ = 1 + 1 / b := by ring
      exact h₅
    have h₃ : z = 1 + 1 / c := by
      have h₄ : c = 1 / (z - 1) := rfl
      have h₅ : z - 1 = 1 / c := by
        calc
          z - 1 = 1 / c := by
            have h₆ : c = 1 / (z - 1) := rfl

      calc
        (1 + 1 / a) * (1 + 1 / b) * (1 + 1 / c) = x * y * z := by

    have h₆ : a ≠ 0 := by
      have h₇ : a = 1 / (x - 1) := rfl

      field_simp [h₇, h₈]
      <;>

      <;>
      (try contradiction) <;>

      <;>

    have h₈ : c ≠ 0 := by
      have h₉ : c = 1 / (z - 1) := rfl

      <;>

    have h₉ : (a + b + c + a * b + b * c + c * a + 1 : F) = 0 := by
      have h₁₀ : (1 + 1 / a) * (1 + 1 / b) * (1 + 1 / c) = 1 := h₅
      have h₁₁ : a ≠ 0 := h₆
      have h₁₂ : b ≠ 0 := h₇

      field_simp [h₁₁, h₁₂, h₁₃] at h₁₀ ⊢

    exact h₉
  
  have h_main : (x / (x - 1)) ^ 2 + (y / (y - 1)) ^ 2 + (z / (z - 1)) ^ 2 = 3 + 2 * (a + b + c) + (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2) := by
    have h₁ : (x / (x - 1)) ^ 2 = (1 + a) ^ 2 := by

    have h₂ : (y / (y - 1)) ^ 2 = (1 + b) ^ 2 := by

            <;> ring_nf

    have h₃ : (z / (z - 1)) ^ 2 = (1 + c) ^ 2 := by

      have h₅ : z / (z - 1) = 1 + c := by
        calc

            <;> ring_nf

            <;> field_simp [hz1]

    calc
      (x / (x - 1)) ^ 2 + (y / (y - 1)) ^ 2 + (z / (z - 1)) ^ 2 = (1 + a) ^ 2 + (1 + b) ^ 2 + (1 + c) ^ 2 := by
        rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
      _ = 3 + 2 * (a + b + c) + (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2) := by
        ring_nf
        <;>

def IsGood (x A : ℝ) : Prop :=
  sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = A ∧ 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 ∧
    0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) ∧ 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)

theorem imo1959_p2c : IsGood x 2 ↔ x ∈ solution_set_two := by

      have h₄ : 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) := h.2.2.2
      have h₅ : x ≥ 1 / 2 := by linarith

        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith),
          Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith)]
      have h₇₇ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (x - 1) ^ 2 := by
        have h₇₇₁ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by
          calc
            (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 * (sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 := by ring
            _ = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by
              rw [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith),
                  Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1) by linarith)]
            _ = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) := by ring
        have h₇₇₂ : (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = (x - 1) ^ 2 := by
          have h₇₇₃ : (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = x ^ 2 - (sqrt (2 * x - 1)) ^ 2 := by
            ring_nf
            <;>
            nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 by linarith)]
          have h₇₇₄ : (sqrt (2 * x - 1)) ^ 2 = 2 * x - 1 := by
            rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
          rw [h₇₇₃, h₇₇₄]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> nlinarith
        rw [h₇₇₁, h₇₇₂]
      have h₇₈ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) ≥ 0 := by positivity
      have h₇₉ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = |x - 1| := by
        have h₇₉₁ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (x - 1) ^ 2 := h₇₇
        have h₇₉₂ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) ≥ 0 := by positivity
        have h₇₉₃ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = |x - 1| := by
          have h₇₉₄ : (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (x - 1) ^ 2 := h₇₇
          have h₇₉₅ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) ≥ 0 := by positivity
          have h₇₉₆ : (|x - 1| : ℝ) ≥ 0 := abs_nonneg (x - 1)
          have h₇₉₇ : (|x - 1| : ℝ) ^ 2 = (x - 1) ^ 2 := by
            simp [abs_mul_abs_self]
          have h₇₉₈ : sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = |x - 1| := by
            nlinarith [sq_nonneg (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) - |x - 1|)]
          exact h₇₉₈
        exact h₇₉₃
      calc
        (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) ^ 2 = (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by rw [h₇₆]
        _ = 2 * x + 2 * (sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) * sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1))) := by ring
        _ = 2 * x + 2 * |x - 1| := by rw [h₇₉]
    have h₈ : 2 * x + 2 * |x - 1| = 1 := by linarith
    have h₉ : x ≥ 1 / 2 := by linarith
    cases' le_or_lt x 1 with h₁₀ h₁₀
    · 
      have h₁₁ : |x - 1| = 1 - x := by
        rw [abs_of_nonpos] <;> linarith
      rw [h₁₁] at h₈
      have h₁₂ : 2 * x + 2 * (1 - x) = 1 := by linarith
      have h₁₃ : (2 : ℝ) = 1 := by linarith
      norm_num at h₁₃ ⊢
      <;> linarith
    · 
      have h₁₁ : |x - 1| = x - 1 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg] <;> linarith
      rw [h₁₁] at h₈
      have h₁₂ : 2 * x + 2 * (x - 1) = 1 := by linarith
      have h₁₃ : x = 3 / 4 := by linarith
      linarith
  
  have h_final : IsGood x 1 ↔ x ∈ solution_set_one := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exfalso
      exact h_main h
    · intro h
      exfalso
      simp only [solution_set_one, Set.mem_empty_iff_false] at h
      <;> simp_all
  
  exact h_final

theorem imo2008_p2a (x y z : ℝ) (h : x * y * z = 1) (hx : x ≠ 1) (hy : y ≠ 1) (hz : z ≠ 1) :
    x ^ 2 / (x - 1) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 / (y - 1) ^ 2 + z ^ 2 / (z - 1) ^ 2 ≥ 1 := by 
  have h₁ : x - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h₁
    apply hx
    linarith
  
  have h₂ : y - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h₂
    apply hy
    linarith
  
  have h₃ : z - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h₃
    apply hz
    linarith
  
  set a := x / (x - 1) with ha
  set b := y / (y - 1) with hb
  set c := z / (z - 1) with hc
  have h₄ : (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1) = a * b * c := by
    have h₄₁ : a - 1 = 1 / (x - 1) := by
      have h₄₁₁ : a - 1 = x / (x - 1) - 1 := by rw [ha]
      rw [h₄₁₁]
      field_simp [h₁]
      <;> ring
      <;> field_simp [h₁]
      <;> ring
    have h₄₂ : b - 1 = 1 / (y - 1) := by
      have h₄₂₁ : b - 1 = y / (y - 1) - 1 := by rw [hb]
      rw [h₄₂₁]
      field_simp [h₂]
      <;> ring
      <;> field_simp [h₂]
      <;> ring
    have h₄₃ : c - 1 = 1 / (z - 1) := by
      have h₄₃₁ : c - 1 = z / (z - 1) - 1 := by rw [hc]
      rw [h₄₃₁]
      field_simp [h₃]
      <;> ring
      <;> field_simp [h₃]
      <;> ring
    have h₄₄ : (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1) = 1 / ((x - 1) * (y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by
      calc
        (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1) = (1 / (x - 1)) * (1 / (y - 1)) * (1 / (z - 1)) := by
          rw [h₄₁, h₄₂, h₄₃]
          <;> ring
        _ = 1 / ((x - 1) * (y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by
          field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
          <;> ring
          <;> field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
          <;> ring
    have h₄₅ : a * b * c = 1 / ((x - 1) * (y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by
      calc
        a * b * c = (x / (x - 1)) * (y / (y - 1)) * (z / (z - 1)) := by
          rw [ha, hb, hc]
          <;> ring
        _ = (x * y * z) / ((x - 1) * (y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by
          field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
          <;> ring
          <;> field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
          <;> ring
        _ = 1 / ((x - 1) * (y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by
          rw [h]
          <;> field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
          <;> ring
          <;> field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
          <;> ring
    linarith
  
  have h₅ : a * b + a * c + b * c = a + b + c - 1 := by
    have h₅₁ : (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1) = a * b * c := h₄
    have h₅₂ : a * b * c = (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1) := by linarith
    have h₅₃ : a * b * c = a * b * c - (a * b + a * c + b * c) + (a + b + c) - 1 := by
      ring_nf at h₅₂ ⊢
      linarith
    linarith
  
  have h₆ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 ≥ 1 := by
    have h₆₁ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = (a + b + c - 1) ^ 2 + 1 := by
      have h₆₂ : a * b + a * c + b * c = a + b + c - 1 := h₅
      have h₆₃ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = (a + b + c) ^ 2 - 2 * (a * b + a * c + b * c) := by
        ring
      rw [h₆₃]
      have h₆₄ : (a + b + c) ^ 2 - 2 * (a * b + a * c + b * c) = (a + b + c) ^ 2 - 2 * (a + b + c - 1) := by
        rw [h₆₂]
        <;> ring
      rw [h₆₄]
      ring_nf
      <;> nlinarith
    rw [h₆₁]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a + b + c - 1)]
  
  have h₇ : x ^ 2 / (x - 1) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 / (y - 1) ^ 2 + z ^ 2 / (z - 1) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 := by
    have h₇₁ : x ^ 2 / (x - 1) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 := by
      have h₇₁₁ : a = x / (x - 1) := by rw [ha]
      calc
        x ^ 2 / (x - 1) ^ 2 = (x / (x - 1)) ^ 2 := by
          field_simp [h₁]
          <;> ring
        _ = a ^ 2 := by rw [h₇₁₁]
    have h₇₂ : y ^ 2 / (y - 1) ^ 2 = b ^ 2 := by
      have h₇₂₁ : b = y / (y - 1) := by rw [hb]
      calc
        y ^ 2 / (y - 1) ^ 2 = (y / (y - 1)) ^ 2 := by
          field_simp [h₂]
          <;> ring
        _ = b ^ 2 := by rw [h₇₂₁]
    have h₇₃ : z ^ 2 / (z - 1) ^ 2 = c ^ 2 := by
      have h₇₃₁ : c = z / (z - 1) := by rw [hc]
      calc
        z ^ 2 / (z - 1) ^ 2 = (z / (z - 1)) ^ 2 := by
          field_simp [h₃]
          <;> ring
        _ = c ^ 2 := by rw [h₇₃₁]
    calc
      x ^ 2 / (x - 1) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 / (y - 1) ^ 2 + z ^ 2 / (z - 1) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 := by
        rw [h₇₁, h₇₂, h₇₃]
        <;> ring
      _ = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 := by rfl
  
  have h₈ : x ^ 2 / (x - 1) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 / (y - 1) ^ 2 + z ^ 2 / (z - 1) ^ 2 ≥ 1 := by
    linarith
  
  exact h₈

theorem imo_sl_2008_A2a_part1 [LinearOrderedField F]
    {x y z : F} (hx : x ≠ 1) (hy : y ≠ 1) (hz : z ≠ 1) (h : x * y * z = 1) :
    1 ≤ (x / (x - 1)) ^ 2 + (y / (y - 1)) ^ 2 + (z / (z - 1)) ^ 2 := by 
  have h₁ : (x - 1) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h₁
    apply hx
    apply eq_of_sub_eq_zero
    simpa [h₁] using h₁
  
  have h₂ : (y - 1) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h₂
    apply hy
    apply eq_of_sub_eq_zero
    simpa [h₂] using h₂
  
  have h₃ : (z - 1) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h₃
    apply hz
    apply eq_of_sub_eq_zero
    simpa [h₃] using h₃
  
  set a := x / (x - 1) with ha
  set b := y / (y - 1) with hb
  set c := z / (z - 1) with hc
  have h₄ : a ≠ 1 := by
    intro h₄
    have h₅ : x / (x - 1) = 1 := by simpa [ha] using h₄
    have h₆ : x = x - 1 := by
      have h₇ : x - 1 ≠ 0 := h₁
      field_simp [h₇] at h₅
      <;>
      (try simp_all) <;>
      (try linarith) <;>
      (try nlinarith) <;>
      (try ring_nf at * <;> nlinarith)
      <;>
      (try simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]) <;>
      (try linarith)
    have h₇ : (0 : F) = 1 := by
      have h₈ : x - x = (1 : F) := by
        have h₉ := h₆
        ring_nf at h₉ ⊢
        <;>
        (try simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]) <;>
        (try linarith)
        <;>
        (try nlinarith)
      have h₉ : (0 : F) = 1 := by
        have h₁₀ := h₈
        ring_nf at h₁₀ ⊢
        <;>
        (try simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]) <;>
        (try linarith)
        <;>
        (try nlinarith)
      exact h₉
    norm_num at h₇
    <;>
    (try simp_all) <;>
    (try linarith) <;>
    (try nlinarith)
  
  have h₅ : b ≠ 1 := by
    intro h₅
    have h₆ : y / (y - 1) = 1 := by simpa [hb] using h₅
    have h₇ : y = y - 1 := by
      have h₈ : y - 1 ≠ 0 := h₂
      field_simp [h₈] at h₆
      <;>
      (try simp_all) <;>
      (try linarith) <;>
      (try nlinarith) <;>
      (try ring_nf at * <;> nlinarith)
      <;>
      (try simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]) <;>
      (try linarith)
    have h₈ : (0 : F) = 1 := by
      have h₉ : y - y = (1 : F) := by
        have h₁₀ := h₇
        ring_nf at h₁₀ ⊢
        <;>
        (try simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]) <;>
        (try linarith)
        <;>
        (try nlinarith)
      have h₁₀ : (0 : F) = 1 := by
        have h₁₁ := h₉
        ring_nf at h₁₁ ⊢
        <;>
        (try simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]) <;>
        (try linarith)
        <;>
        (try nlinarith)
      exact h₁₀
    norm_num at h₈
    <;>
    (try simp_all) <;>
    (try linarith) <;>
    (try nlinarith)
  
  have h₆ : c ≠ 1 := by
    intro h₆
    have h₇ : z / (z - 1) = 1 := by simpa [hc] using h₆
    have h₈ : z = z - 1 := by
      have h₉ : z - 1 ≠ 0 := h₃
      field_simp [h₉] at h₇
      <;>
      (try simp_all) <;>
      (try linarith) <;>
      (try nlinarith) <;>
      (try ring_nf at * <;> nlinarith)
      <;>
      (try simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]) <;>
      (try linarith)
    have h₉ : (0 : F) = 1 := by
      have h₁₀ : z - z = (1 : F) := by
        have h₁₁ := h₈
        ring_nf at h₁₁ ⊢
        <;>
        (try simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]) <;>
        (try linarith)
        <;>
        (try nlinarith)
      have h₁₁ : (0 : F) = 1 := by
        have h₁₂ := h₁₀
        ring_nf at h₁₂ ⊢
        <;>
        (try simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]) <;>
        (try linarith)
        <;>
        (try nlinarith)
      exact h₁₁
    norm_num at h₉
    <;>
    (try simp_all) <;>
    (try linarith) <;>
    (try nlinarith)
  
  have h₇ : a * b * c = (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1) := by
    have h₈ : a = x / (x - 1) := by rw [ha]
    have h₉ : b = y / (y - 1) := by rw [hb]
    have h₁₀ : c = z / (z - 1) := by rw [hc]
    rw [h₈, h₉, h₁₀]
    have h₁₁ : (x / (x - 1)) * (y / (y - 1)) * (z / (z - 1)) = (x * y * z) / ((x - 1) * (y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by
      field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
      <;> ring

        field_simp [h₁]
        <;> ring
      rw [h₁₃]
      have h₁₄ : (x - (x - 1) : F) = 1 := by
        ring_nf
        <;>
        (try simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]) <;>
        (try linarith)
        <;>
        (try nlinarith)
      rw [h₁₄]
      <;> field_simp [h₁]
      <;> ring
    have h₁₃ : (y / (y - 1) - 1) = 1 / (y - 1) := by
      have h₁₄ : y / (y - 1) - 1 = (y - (y - 1)) / (y - 1) := by
        field_simp [h₂]
        <;> ring
      rw [h₁₄]
      have h₁₅ : (y - (y - 1) : F) = 1 := by
        ring_nf
        <;>
        (try simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]) <;>
        (try linarith)
        <;>
        (try nlinarith)
      rw [h₁₅]
      <;> field_simp [h₂]
      <;> ring
    have h₁₄ : (z / (z - 1) - 1) = 1 / (z - 1) := by
      have h₁₅ : z / (z - 1) - 1 = (z - (z - 1)) / (z - 1) := by
        field_simp [h₃]
        <;> ring
      rw [h₁₅]

    have h₁₅ : (x / (x - 1) - 1) * (y / (y - 1) - 1) * (z / (z - 1) - 1) = 1 / ((x - 1) * (y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by
      calc
        (x / (x - 1) - 1) * (y / (y - 1) - 1) * (z / (z - 1) - 1) = (1 / (x - 1)) * (1 / (y - 1)) * (1 / (z - 1)) := by
          rw [h₁₂, h₁₃, h₁₄]
          <;> ring_nf
        _ = 1 / ((x - 1) * (y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by
          field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
          <;> ring_nf
    have h₁₆ : (x * y * z : F) = 1 := by
      simpa using h
    have h₁₇ : (x * y * z : F) / ((x - 1) * (y - 1) * (z - 1)) = 1 / ((x - 1) * (y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by
      rw [h₁₆]
      <;> field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃]
      <;> ring_nf
    linarith
  
  have h₈ : a * b + b * c + c * a = a + b + c - 1 := by
    have h₉ : a * b * c = (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1) := h₇
    have h₁₀ : a * b + b * c + c * a = a + b + c - 1 := by
      have h₁₁ : (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1) = a * b * c - (a * b + b * c + c * a) + (a + b + c) - 1 := by
        ring_nf
      have h₁₂ : a * b * c = a * b * c - (a * b + b * c + c * a) + (a + b + c) - 1 := by
        linarith
      have h₁₃ : (a * b + b * c + c * a : F) = a + b + c - 1 := by
        linarith
      exact h₁₃
    exact h₁₀
  
  have h₉ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = (a + b + c - 1) ^ 2 + 1 := by
    have h₁₀ : a * b + b * c + c * a = a + b + c - 1 := h₈
    have h₁₁ : (a + b + c - 1) ^ 2 = (a + b + c) ^ 2 - 2 * (a + b + c) + 1 := by
      ring_nf
      <;>
      (try simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]) <;>
      (try linarith)
      <;>
      (try nlinarith)
    have h₁₂ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = (a + b + c) ^ 2 - 2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a) := by
      ring_nf
      <;>
      (try simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]) <;>
      (try linarith)
      <;>
      (try nlinarith)
    have h₁₃ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = (a + b + c) ^ 2 - 2 * (a + b + c - 1) := by
      calc
        a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = (a + b + c) ^ 2 - 2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a) := by rw [h₁₂]
        _ = (a + b + c) ^ 2 - 2 * (a + b + c - 1) := by rw [h₁₀]
    have h₁₄ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = (a + b + c - 1) ^ 2 + 1 := by
      calc
        a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = (a + b + c) ^ 2 - 2 * (a + b + c - 1) := by rw [h₁₃]
        _ = (a + b + c - 1) ^ 2 + 1 := by
          have h₁₅ : (a + b + c - 1 : F) ^ 2 = (a + b + c) ^ 2 - 2 * (a + b + c) + 1 := by
            ring_nf

    exact h₁₄
  
  have h₁₀ : 1 ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 := by
    have h₁₁ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = (a + b + c - 1) ^ 2 + 1 := h₉

    have h₄ : (f (x + a))^2 ≤ f (x + a) ∧ f (x + a + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f (x + a) - (f (x + a))^2) := hf.2 (x + a)

theorem imo2008_p2a (x y z : ℝ) (h : x * y * z = 1) (hx : x ≠ 1) (hy : y ≠ 1) (hz : z ≠ 1) :
    x ^ 2 / (x - 1) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 / (y - 1) ^ 2 + z ^ 2 / (z - 1) ^ 2 ≥ 1 := by 
  have h₁ : (x - 1) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h₁
    apply hx
    linarith
  
  have h₂ : (y - 1) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h₂
    apply hy
    linarith
  
  have h₃ : (z - 1) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h₃
    apply hz
    linarith
  
  set u := x / (x - 1) with hu
  set v := y / (y - 1) with hv
  set w := z / (z - 1) with hw
  have h₄ : u * v + u * w + v * w = u + v + w - 1 := by
    have h₅ : u * v + u * w + v * w = (x * y) / ((x - 1) * (y - 1)) + (x * z) / ((x - 1) * (z - 1)) + (y * z) / ((y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by
      calc
        u * v + u * w + v * w = (x / (x - 1)) * (y / (y - 1)) + (x / (x - 1)) * (z / (z - 1)) + (y / (y - 1)) * (z / (z - 1)) := by
          simp [u, v, w]
        _ = (x * y) / ((x - 1) * (y - 1)) + (x * z) / ((x - 1) * (z - 1)) + (y * z) / ((y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by
          field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃, sub_ne_zero.mpr hx, sub_ne_zero.mpr hy, sub_ne_zero.mpr hz]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₁, h₂, h₃, sub_ne_zero.mpr hx, sub_ne_zero.mpr hy, sub_ne_zero.mpr hz]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> linarith
        _ = (x * y) / ((x - 1) * (y - 1)) + (x * z) / ((x - 1) * (z - 1)) + (y * z) / ((y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by rfl
    have h₆ : u + v + w - 1 = (2 * x * y * z - x * y - x * z - y * z + 1) / ((x - 1) * (y - 1) * (z - 1)) := by
      calc
        u + v + w - 1 = (x / (x - 1) + y / (y - 1) + z / (z - 1)) - 1 := by
          simp [u, v, w]

    have h₂ : ∃ k, n = 3 * k := by

      have h₄ : 3 * (n / 3) = n := by
        have h₅ := Nat.mod_add_div n 3

        intro k

          (try

            })
          <;>
          omega
      exact h₄ k
    exact h₃

    intro h
    have h₁ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      rw [Nat.ModEq] at h
      exact h

            have h₈ : n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
              have : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega

              <;> omega

          rcases h₆ with (h₆ | h₆)

              have h₈ : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ^ (3 * k + 1) % 7 = 2 := by

              have h₉ : ∃ k : ℕ, n = 3 * k + 1 := by
                use n / 3
                have h₁₀ : n % 3 = 1 := h₆
                have h₁₁ : n = 3 * (n / 3) + 1 := by
                  have h₁₂ := Nat.mod_add_div n 3
                  omega

              obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h₉
              exact h₈ k
            omega
          ·

        exact h₅
      exact h₃ n h₁
    exact h₂

      rw [h₀] at h₄₀''

    norm_num at h₄₀''''

  have h₁ : Real.logb 21 3 = Real.log 3 / Real.log 21 := by
    rw [Real.logb]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> field_simp
    <;> ring_nf
  
  have h₂ : Real.log 21 = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := by
    have h₂₁ : Real.log 21 = Real.log (3 * 7) := by norm_num
    rw [h₂₁]
    have h₂₂ : Real.log (3 * 7) = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    rw [h₂₂]
  
  have h₃ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := by
    have h₃₁ : x = Real.logb 21 3 := by rw [hx]
    have h₃₂ : Real.logb 21 3 = Real.log 3 / Real.log 21 := h₁
    have h₃₃ : Real.log 21 = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := h₂
    rw [h₃₁, h₃₂, h₃₃]
    <;> field_simp
    <;> ring_nf
  
  have h₄ : x > 0 := by
    have h₄₁ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h₃
    rw [h₄₁]
    have h₄₂ : Real.log 3 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h₄₃ : Real.log 7 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h₄₄ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 > 0 := by linarith
    exact div_pos h₄₂ (by linarith)
  
  have h₅ : x < 1 := by
    have h₅₁ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h₃
    rw [h₅₁]
    have h₅₂ : Real.log 3 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h₅₃ : Real.log 7 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h₅₄ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 > 0 := by linarith
    have h₅₅ : Real.log 3 < Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := by linarith
    have h₅₆ : Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) < 1 := by
      rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]
      <;> nlinarith
    linarith
  
  have h₆ : Real.log 7 = (Real.log 3 * (1 - x)) / x := by
    have h₆₁ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h₃
    have h₆₂ : Real.log 3 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h₆₃ : Real.log 7 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h₆₄ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 > 0 := by linarith
    have h₆₅ : x > 0 := h₄
    have h₆₆ : x < 1 := h₅
    
    have h₆₇ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 = Real.log 3 / x := by
      have h₆₇₁ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h₃
      have h₆₇₂ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 ≠ 0 := by linarith
      field_simp [h₆₇₂] at h₆₇₁ ⊢
      nlinarith
    have h₆₈ : Real.log 7 = (Real.log 3 / x) - Real.log 3 := by linarith
    have h₆₉ : Real.log 7 = (Real.log 3 * (1 - x)) / x := by
      calc
        Real.log 7 = (Real.log 3 / x) - Real.log 3 := by rw [h₆₈]
        _ = (Real.log 3 / x) - (x * Real.log 3 / x) := by
          have h₆₉₁ : x ≠ 0 := by linarith
          field_simp [h₆₉₁]
          <;> nlinarith
        _ = (Real.log 3 - x * Real.log 3) / x := by
          have h₆₉₂ : x ≠ 0 := by linarith
          field_simp [h₆₉₂]
          <;> ring
          <;> field_simp [h₆₉₂]
          <;> ring
        _ = (Real.log 3 * (1 - x)) / x := by
          ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₆₅.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> linarith
    exact h₆₉
  
  have h₇ : Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * Real.log 3 / Real.log 7 := by
    have h₇₁ : Real.logb 7 9 = Real.log 9 / Real.log 7 := by
      rw [Real.logb]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp
      <;> ring_nf
    have h₇₂ : Real.log 9 = 2 * Real.log 3 := by
      have h₇₂₁ : Real.log 9 = Real.log (3 ^ 2) := by norm_num
      rw [h₇₂₁]
      have h₇₂₂ : Real.log (3 ^ 2) = 2 * Real.log 3 := by
        rw [Real.log_pow] <;> norm_num
      rw [h₇₂₂]
    rw [h₇₁, h₇₂]
    <;> field_simp
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> field_simp
    <;> ring_nf
  
  have h₈ : Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * x / (1 - x) := by
    have h₈₁ : Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * Real.log 3 / Real.log 7 := h₇
    have h₈₂ : Real.log 7 = (Real.log 3 * (1 - x)) / x := h₆
    have h₈₃ : Real.log 3 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h₈₄ : x > 0 := h₄
    have h₈₅ : x < 1 := h₅
    have h₈₆ : 1 - x > 0 := by linarith
    have h₈₇ : Real.log 7 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h₈₈ : (1 - x : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h₈₉ : (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h₉₀ : Real.log 7 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    rw [h₈₁]
    have h₉₁ : 2 * Real.log 3 / Real.log 7 = 2 * Real.log 3 / ((Real.log 3 * (1 - x)) / x) := by rw [h₈₂]
    rw [h₉₁]
    have h₉₂ : 2 * Real.log 3 / ((Real.log 3 * (1 - x)) / x) = 2 * x / (1 - x) := by
      have h₉₃ : Real.log 3 ≠ 0 := by linarith [Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 3)]
      field_simp [h₈₈, h₈₉, h₉₃]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [h₈₈, h₈₉, h₉₃]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> nlinarith
    rw [h₉₂]
  
  have h₉ : Real.logb 7 9 = solution x := by
    have h₉₁ : Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * x / (1 - x) := h₈
    have h₉₂ : solution x = 2 * x / (1 - x) := by
      dsimp only [solution]
      <;> ring_nf
    linarith
  
  exact h₉

theorem imo_1964_p1b (n : ℕ) : ¬ 7 ∣ (2^n + 1) := by 
  have h_main : (2^n + 1) % 7 ≠ 0 := by
    have h : ∀ n : ℕ, (2^n + 1) % 7 = 2 ∨ (2^n + 1) % 7 = 3 ∨ (2^n + 1) % 7 = 5 := by
      intro n
      have h₁ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 ∨ 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ∨ 2 ^ n % 7 = 4 := by
        
        have h₂ : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 ∨ 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ∨ 2 ^ n % 7 = 4 := by
          intro n
          induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
          | h n ih =>
            match n with
            | 0 =>
              
              norm_num
            | 1 =>
              
              norm_num
            | 2 =>
              
              norm_num
            | 3 =>
              
              norm_num
            | n + 4 =>
              
              have h₃ := ih (n + 3) (by omega)
              have h₄ := ih (n + 2) (by omega)
              have h₅ := ih (n + 1) (by omega)
              have h₆ := ih n (by omega)
              simp [pow_add, pow_one, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod] at h₃ h₄ h₅ h₆ ⊢
              <;>
                (try omega) <;>
                (try
                  {
                    rcases h₃ with (h₃ | h₃ | h₃) <;>
                    rcases h₄ with (h₄ | h₄ | h₄) <;>
                    rcases h₅ with (h₅ | h₅ | h₅) <;>
                    rcases h₆ with (h₆ | h₆ | h₆) <;>
                    simp [h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod] at * <;>
                    omega
                  }) <;>
                (try omega)
        exact h₂ n
      
      rcases h₁ with (h₁ | h₁ | h₁)
      · 
        have h₂ : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 2 := by
          omega
        exact Or.inl h₂
      · 
        have h₂ : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 3 := by
          omega
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl h₂)
      · 
        have h₂ : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 5 := by
          omega
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr h₂)
    
    have h₂ : (2^n + 1) % 7 = 2 ∨ (2^n + 1) % 7 = 3 ∨ (2^n + 1) % 7 = 5 := h n
    rcases h₂ with (h₂ | h₂ | h₂)
    · 
      omega
    · 
      omega
    · 
      omega
  
  have h_final : ¬ 7 ∣ (2^n + 1) := by
    intro h_div
    have h₁ : (2^n + 1) % 7 = 0 := by
      omega
    have h₂ : (2^n + 1) % 7 ≠ 0 := h_main
    contradiction
  
  exact h_final

theorem imo1964_p2
    (T : Affine.Triangle ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
    (a b c : ℝ)
    (ha : a = dist (T.points 1) (T.points 2))
    (hb : b = dist (T.points 2) (T.points 0))
    (hc : c = dist (T.points 0) (T.points 1)) :
    a^2 * (b + c - a) + b^2 * (c + a - b) + c^2 * (a + b - c) ≤
    3 * a * b * c := by 
  have h_a_nonneg : a ≥ 0 := by
    rw [ha]
    exact dist_nonneg
  
  have h_b_nonneg : b ≥ 0 := by
    rw [hb]
    exact dist_nonneg
  
  have h_c_nonneg : c ≥ 0 := by
    rw [hc]
    exact dist_nonneg
  
  have h_main : a^3 + b^3 + c^3 + 3*a*b*c ≥ a^2*b + a^2*c + b^2*a + b^2*c + c^2*a + c^2*b := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a + b - c), sq_nonneg (a + c - b), sq_nonneg (b + c - a),
      sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a),
      mul_nonneg h_a_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - b)), mul_nonneg h_a_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - c)),
      mul_nonneg h_a_nonneg (sq_nonneg (b - c)), mul_nonneg h_b_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - b)),
      mul_nonneg h_b_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - c)), mul_nonneg h_b_nonneg (sq_nonneg (b - c)),
      mul_nonneg h_c_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - b)), mul_nonneg h_c_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - c)),
      mul_nonneg h_c_nonneg (sq_nonneg (b - c)), mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - b)) h_a_nonneg,
      mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - c)) h_a_nonneg, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (b - c)) h_a_nonneg,
      mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - b)) h_b_nonneg, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - c)) h_b_nonneg,
      mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (b - c)) h_b_nonneg, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - b)) h_c_nonneg,
      mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - c)) h_c_nonneg, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (b - c)) h_c_nonneg]
  
  have h_final : a^2 * (b + c - a) + b^2 * (c + a - b) + c^2 * (a + b - c) ≤ 3 * a * b * c := by
    have h₁ : a ^ 2 * (b + c - a) + b ^ 2 * (c + a - b) + c ^ 2 * (a + b - c) = a ^ 2 * b + a ^ 2 * c + b ^ 2 * a + b ^ 2 * c + c ^ 2 * a + c ^ 2 * b - (a ^ 3 + b ^ 3 + c ^ 3) := by
      ring
    rw [h₁]
    have h₂ : a ^ 2 * b + a ^ 2 * c + b ^ 2 * a + b ^ 2 * c + c ^ 2 * a + c ^ 2 * b - (a ^ 3 + b ^ 3 + c ^ 3) ≤ 3 * a * b * c := by
      nlinarith [h_main]
    linarith
  
  exact h_final

import Mathlib

noncomputable abbrev solution (x : ℝ) : ℝ := 2*x / (1-x)

theorem singapore2019_r1_p4 (x : ℝ) (hx : Real.logb 21 3 = x) :
    Real.logb 7 9 = solution x := by 
  have h_log21 : Real.log 21 = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := by
    have h₁ : Real.log 21 = Real.log (3 * 7) := by norm_num
    rw [h₁]
    have h₂ : Real.log (3 * 7) = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    rw [h₂]
    <;>
    norm_num
  
  have h_x : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := by
    have h₁ : Real.logb 21 3 = Real.log 3 / Real.log 21 := by
      rw [Real.logb]
      <;> field_simp
    rw [h₁] at hx
    have h₂ : Real.log 21 = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := h_log21
    rw [h₂] at hx
    linarith
  
  have h_log7_ne_zero : Real.log 7 ≠ 0 := by
    have h₁ : Real.log 7 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    linarith
  
  have h_y_def : Real.log 3 / Real.log 7 = (x) / (1 - x) := by
    have h₁ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h_x
    have h₂ : Real.log 3 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h₃ : Real.log 7 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h₄ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 > 0 := by linarith
    have h₅ : 1 - x ≠ 0 := by
      have h₅₁ : x < 1 := by
        have h₅₂ : Real.log 3 < Real.log 21 := Real.log_lt_log (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        have h₅₃ : Real.log 21 = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := h_log21
        have h₅₄ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h_x
        have h₅₅ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 > 0 := by linarith [h₂, h₃]
        have h₅₆ : Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) < 1 := by
          rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]
          nlinarith [h₂, h₃]
        linarith
      have h₅₂ : x > 0 := by
        have h₅₃ : Real.log 3 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
        have h₅₄ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 > 0 := by linarith [h₃]
        have h₅₅ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h_x
        have h₅₆ : Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) > 0 := by positivity
        linarith
      linarith
    
    have h₆ : Real.log 3 / Real.log 7 = (x) / (1 - x) := by
      have h₆₁ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h_x
      have h₆₂ : Real.log 3 / Real.log 7 = (x) / (1 - x) := by
        have h₆₃ : 1 - x = (Real.log 7) / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := by
          have h₆₄ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h_x
          have h₆₅ : 1 - x = 1 - (Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7)) := by rw [h₆₄]
          rw [h₆₅]
          field_simp [h₄.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₄.ne']
          <;> nlinarith [h₂, h₃]
        have h₆₆ : (x : ℝ) = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := by rw [h_x]
        calc
          Real.log 3 / Real.log 7 = (Real.log 3 / Real.log 7) := by rfl
          _ = (Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7)) / (Real.log 7 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7)) := by
            field_simp [h₃.ne', h₄.ne']
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp [h₃.ne', h₄.ne']
            <;> nlinarith [h₂, h₃]
          _ = x / (Real.log 7 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7)) := by
            rw [h₆₆]
            <;> field_simp [h₄.ne']
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp [h₄.ne']
            <;> nlinarith [h₂, h₃]
          _ = x / (1 - x) := by
            rw [h₆₃]
            <;> field_simp [h₅]
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp [h₅]
            <;> nlinarith [h₂, h₃]
      exact h₆₂
    exact h₆
  
  have h_1_minus_x_ne_zero : (1 : ℝ) - x ≠ 0 := by
    have h₁ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h_x
    have h₂ : Real.log 3 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h₃ : Real.log 7 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h₄ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 > 0 := by linarith
    have h₅ : x < 1 := by
      have h₅₁ : Real.log 3 < Real.log 21 := Real.log_lt_log (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      have h₅₂ : Real.log 21 = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := h_log21
      have h₅₃ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h_x
      have h₅₄ : Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) < 1 := by
        rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]
        nlinarith [h₂, h₃]
      linarith
    have h₆ : x > 0 := by
      have h₆₁ : Real.log 3 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
      have h₆₂ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 > 0 := by linarith [h₃]
      have h₆₃ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h_x
      have h₆₄ : Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) > 0 := by positivity
      linarith
    have h₇ : (1 : ℝ) - x > 0 := by linarith
    linarith
  
  have h_logb7_9 : Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * (Real.log 3 / Real.log 7) := by
    have h₁ : Real.logb 7 9 = Real.log 9 / Real.log 7 := by
      rw [Real.logb]
      <;> field_simp
    rw [h₁]
    have h₂ : Real.log 9 = 2 * Real.log 3 := by
      have h₃ : Real.log 9 = Real.log (3 ^ 2) := by norm_num
      rw [h₃]
      have h₄ : Real.log (3 ^ 2) = 2 * Real.log 3 := by
        rw [Real.log_pow] <;> norm_num
      rw [h₄]
    rw [h₂]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> field_simp [h_log7_ne_zero]
    <;> ring_nf
  
  have h_main : Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * x / (1 - x) := by
    have h₁ : Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * (Real.log 3 / Real.log 7) := h_logb7_9
    rw [h₁]
    have h₂ : Real.log 3 / Real.log 7 = x / (1 - x) := by
      rw [h_y_def]
    rw [h₂]
    <;> field_simp [h_1_minus_x_ne_zero]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> field_simp [h_1_minus_x_ne_zero]
    <;> ring_nf
  
  have h_final : Real.logb 7 9 = solution x := by
    rw [h_main]
    <;> simp [solution]
    <;> field_simp [h_1_minus_x_ne_zero]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> field_simp [h_1_minus_x_ne_zero]
    <;> linarith
  
  exact h_final
